import { USLotteryCalculator } from './components/tools/lottery/USLotteryCalculator';

// Helper to parse tool ID from clean path or hash
const parseToolFromUrl = (): ToolId => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'basic';

  const parts = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '').split('/').filter(Boolean);
  
  // 1. Check path with language prefix (e.g. /en/bmi, /vi/salary, /ja/loan)
  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    const candidate = parts[1].toLowerCase();
    if (TOOLS_CONFIG[candidate as ToolId]) {
      return candidate as ToolId;
    }
  }

  // 2. Check path without language prefix (e.g. /bmi, /salary, /loan)
  if (parts.length === 1) {
    const candidate = parts[0].toLowerCase();
    if (TOOLS_CONFIG[candidate as ToolId]) {
      return candidate as ToolId;
    }
  }

  // 3. Fallback to hash (e.g. #salary, #bmi)
  const hash = window.location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, '').toLowerCase() as ToolId;
  if (hash && TOOLS_CONFIG[hash]) {
    return hash;
  }

  return 'basic';
};

export default function App() {
  const { language, t } = useLanguage();

  // Initialize tool from clean path or URL hash
  const [currentToolId, setCurrentToolId] = useState<ToolId>(() => parseToolFromUrl());

  const [isSidebarOpen, setIsSidebarOpen] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [resetKey, setResetKey] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isGeminiDrawerOpen, setIsGeminiDrawerOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [geminiToolKey, setGeminiToolKey] = useState<ToolId>('basic');
  const [isTermsOpen, setIsTermsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleOpenGeminiDrawer = (toolKey?: ToolId) => {
    if (toolKey) {
      setGeminiToolKey(toolKey);
    } else {
      setGeminiToolKey(currentToolId);
    }
    setIsGeminiDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  // Sync tool change with clean path URL: /${language}/${toolId}
  const handleSelectTool = (id: ToolId) => {
    setCurrentToolId(id);
    const cleanPath = id === 'basic' ? `/${language}/` : `/${language}/${id}`;
    const search = window.location.search || '';
    const fullUrl = `${cleanPath}${search}`;
    if (window.location.pathname !== cleanPath) {
      window.history.pushState({ lang: language, toolId: id }, '', fullUrl);
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  // Listen to popstate (browser back/forward) and hashchange
  useEffect(() => {
    const onLocationChange = () => {
      const toolId = parseToolFromUrl();
      if (toolId !== currentToolId) {
        setCurrentToolId(toolId);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('popstate', onLocationChange);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', onLocationChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', onLocationChange);
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onLocationChange);
    };
  }, [currentToolId]);

  const handleResetTool = () => {
    setResetKey(prev => prev + 1);
  };

  const currentTool = TOOLS_CONFIG[currentToolId] || TOOLS_CONFIG.basic;

  const renderToolComponent = () => {
    switch (currentToolId) {
      case 'basic':
        return <BasicCalculator initialMode="standard" key={resetKey} />;
      case 'ai':

      case 'bmi':

  const [isMoreMenuOpen, setIsMoreMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  const primaryToolIds: ToolId[] = ['basic', 'ai', 'bmi', 'loan', 'percentage'];

  // 5 primary tier 1 tools for mobile bottom bar
  const primaryTools: { id: ToolId; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    { id: 'basic', label: t.toolShortNames.basic || 'Cơ bản', icon: <Calculator className="w-5 h-5" /> },
    { id: 'ai', label: t.toolShortNames.ai || 'AI Tool', icon: <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-violet-400" /> },
    { id: 'bmi', label: t.toolShortNames.bmi || 'BMI', icon: <Activity className="w-5 h-5" /> },
    { id: 'loan', label: t.toolShortNames.loan || 'Lãi vay', icon: <Banknote className="w-5 h-5" /> },
    { id: 'percentage', label: t.toolShortNames.percentage || 'Phần trăm', icon: <Percent className="w-5 h-5" /> },
  ];

  // All remaining tools for "More" modal
  const secondaryTools = Object.values(TOOLS_CONFIG)
    .filter(tc => !primaryToolIds.includes(tc.id))
    .map(tc => ({
      id: tc.id,
      label: t.toolNames[tc.id] || tc.name,
      desc: t.toolDescriptions[tc.id] || tc.description,
      icon: getToolIcon(tc.id)
    }));

  const isCurrentInSecondary = secondaryTools.some(t => t.id === currentToolId);

  return (
    <>
      <nav 
        id="mobile-bottom-tab-bar"
        className="md:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-lg border-t pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)] shadow-[0_-8px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--app-header-bg, rgba(20, 21, 38, 0.95))',
          borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)'
        }}
      >
        <div className="grid grid-cols-6 items-center h-16 px-1">
          {primaryTools.map((tool) => {
            const isActive = currentToolId === tool.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tool.id}
                id={`bottom-tab-${tool.id}`}
                onClick={() => {
                  onSelectTool(tool.id);
                  setIsMoreMenuOpen(false);
                }}
                className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full min-h-[48px] py-1 transition-all ${
                  isActive 
                    ? 'text-[#3B82F6] font-bold scale-105'

                }`}
              >
                <div className={`p-1 rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                  isActive ? 'bg-blue-500/15 text-[#3B82F6]' : ''
                }`}>
                  {tool.icon}

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useCurrency, CurrencyCode } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { ChevronDown, Check, Coins } from 'lucide-react';

interface CurrencySelectorProps {
  variant?: 'header' | 'inline' | 'compact';
  className?: string;
}

export const CurrencySelector: React.FC<CurrencySelectorProps> = ({
  variant = 'header',
  className = ''
}) => {
  const { currency, setCurrency, currencyInfo, currencies } = useCurrency();
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSelect = (code: CurrencyCode) => {
    setCurrency(code);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  if (variant === 'compact') {
    return (
      <div className={`relative inline-block ${className}`} ref={dropdownRef}>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
          className="currency-compact-btn flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          title={isVi ? 'Đổi đơn vị tiền tệ' : 'Change Currency'}
        >
          <span>{currencyInfo.flag}</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-emerald-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-300">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
          <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
        </button>

        {isOpen && (
          <div className="currency-compact-dropdown absolute right-0 mt-1.5 w-56 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 shadow-2xl z-50 p-1.5 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-700">
            <div className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-slate-400 uppercase border-b border-slate-800">
              {isVi ? 'Chọn tiền tệ (Gốc: $ USD)' : 'Select Currency (Base: $ USD)'}
            </div>
            {currencies.map((curr) => {
              const isSelected = curr.code === currency;
              return (
                <button
                  key={curr.code}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(curr.code)}
                  className={`currency-option-btn w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer text-left ${
                    isSelected ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-base">{curr.flag}</span>
                    <div>
                      <span className={`currency-code-text font-bold mr-1.5 ${isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-200'}`}>{curr.code}</span>
                      <span className="text-emerald-400 font-mono">({curr.symbol})</span>
                      <div className="currency-subtext text-[10px] text-slate-400 leading-tight">
                        {isVi ? curr.nameVi : curr.nameEn}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {isSelected && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (variant === 'inline') {
    return (
      <div className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
        {currencies.map((curr) => {
          const isSelected = curr.code === currency;
          return (
            <button
              key={curr.code}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleSelect(curr.code)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                isSelected
                  ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm ring-1 ring-blue-400'
                  : 'bg-slate-800/70 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white border border-slate-700/60'
              }`}
            >
              <span>{curr.flag}</span>
              <span className="font-mono">{curr.symbol}</span>
              <span className="text-[11px] opacity-80">{curr.code}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Default 'header' variant
  return (
    <div className={`relative ${className}`} ref={dropdownRef}>
      <button
        id="header-currency-selector-btn"
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        aria-label="Select Currency"
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1.5 sm:py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 hover:text-white bg-slate-800/60 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700/60 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50"
      >
        <span className="text-sm leading-none">{currencyInfo.flag}</span>
        <span className="font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 hidden sm:inline">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div 
          id="header-currency-dropdown"
          className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-64 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-700/80 shadow-2xl z-50 p-2 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-700 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
        >
          <div className="px-3 py-2 border-b border-slate-800 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
                {isVi ? 'Đơn vị tiền tệ (Gốc: $ USD)' : 'Currency (Base: $ USD)'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-500/20">
              13 Quốc gia
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            {currencies.map((curr) => {
              const isSelected = curr.code === currency;
              return (
                <button
                  key={curr.code}
                  id={`currency-option-${curr.code}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(curr.code)}
                  className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer text-left ${
                    isSelected 
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-sm' 
                      : 'text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span className="text-base shrink-0">{curr.flag}</span>
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-bold">{curr.code}</span>
                        <span className={`font-mono text-xs font-bold ${isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-emerald-400'}`}>
                          ({curr.symbol})
                        </span>
                        {curr.code === 'USD' && (
                          <span className="text-[9px] px-1 py-0.2 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 font-medium">
                            {isVi ? 'Gốc' : 'Base'}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className={`text-[11px] truncate max-w-[150px] ${isSelected ? 'text-blue-100' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
                        {isVi ? curr.nameVi : curr.nameEn}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {isSelected && (
                    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                      <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

  Bot,

} from 'lucide-react';

interface GeminiDrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  currentToolId: ToolId;
  onSelectTool: (id: ToolId) => void;
  initialToolKey?: ToolId;
}

interface CalculatorInsightItem {
  id: ToolId;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  title: string;
  content: string;
}

// Full domain insights covering all 8 calculator tools of this web application
const CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS: Partial<Record<ToolId, CalculatorInsightItem>> = {
  basic: {
    id: 'basic',
    name: 'Máy tính khoa học',
    category: 'MÁY TÍNH KHOA HỌC & ĐẠI SỐ',
    title: 'Máy Tính Khoa Học 10 Cột: Nguyên Lý Số Học & Giải Thuật Chuẩn Xác',
    content: `Giới thiệu chuyên sâu về Máy tính Khoa học & Hàm số đa năng

**Nguyên lý hoạt động:** Thiết bị sử dụng bộ giải thuật toán chuyển đổi biểu thức trung tố sang hậu tố (Shunting-yard Algorithm) kết hợp bộ xử lý số học dấu phẩy động độ chính xác cao IEEE 754. Hệ thống tính toán tức thời thứ tự ưu tiên các phép toán đại số (nhân chia trước, cộng trừ sau, trong ngoặc trước), các hàm lượng giác (Deg/Rad), hàm mũ, căn bậc n và lưu trữ giá trị bộ nhớ đệm (MC, MR, M+, M-).

export const GeminiDrawer: React.FC<GeminiDrawerProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentToolId,
  onSelectTool,
  initialToolKey
}) => {
  const [selectedKey, setSelectedKey] = useState<ToolId>(initialToolKey || currentToolId || 'basic');
  const [customQuestion, setCustomQuestion] = useState('');
  const [dynamicAiContent, setDynamicAiContent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // Sync initialToolKey when updated from outside
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialToolKey) {
      setSelectedKey(initialToolKey);
      setDynamicAiContent(null);
    }
  }, [initialToolKey]);

  // If tool changed from primary app
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialToolKey && CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS[currentToolId]) {
      setSelectedKey(currentToolId);
    }
  }, [currentToolId, initialToolKey]);

  const currentInsight = CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS[selectedKey] || CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS.basic;

  // Ask Gemini AI dynamic questions
  const handleFetchAiAnalysis = async (customPrompt?: string) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const promptToSend = customPrompt || `Hãy phân tích chuyên sâu, nguyên lý hoạt động và ứng dụng thực tế chuẩn xác nhất của công cụ ${currentInsight.name}. Trình bày bố cục chuyên nghiệp theo cấu trúc: Giới thiệu chuyên sâu, Nguyên lý hoạt động, Ứng dụng thực tế, Mẹo sử dụng chuẩn xác.`;

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/gemini/answer', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          prompt: promptToSend,
          toolName: currentInsight.name,
          context: `Người dùng đang xem công cụ tính toán: ${currentInsight.name} (${currentInsight.title})`
        })
      });

      const data = await response.json();
      if (response.ok && data.answer) {
        setDynamicAiContent(data.answer);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Lỗi tải phân tích Gemini:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setCustomQuestion('');
    }
  };

  const handleShare = () => {
    if (navigator.share) {
      navigator.share({
        title: `Phân tích Gemini AI - ${currentInsight.name}`,
        url: window.location.href
      }).catch(() => {});
    } else {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* BACKDROP SHADOW WHEN DRAWER IS OPEN */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div
          onClick={onClose}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity duration-300"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}

      {/* 
        RIGHT SLIDE-OVER DRAWER (Matches user's Image 2):
        Clean Light theme: bg-white, border-slate-200, crisp slate-900 typography
      */}
      <aside
        id="gemini-right-drawer"
        aria-label="Khối phân tích Gemini AI và Quảng cáo"
        className={`fixed top-0 right-0 bottom-0 z-50 w-full sm:w-[500px] md:w-[540px] lg:w-[580px] bg-white border-l border-slate-200 shadow-2xl text-slate-800 flex flex-col transition-transform duration-300 ease-out transform ${
          isOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full'
        }`}
      >
        {/* 1. Header (Icon hoa mai vàng + Tên công cụ + "✨ Do Gemini tạo" + Nút Share & Close) */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-5 py-3.5 bg-white border-b border-slate-200/90 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {/* Sparkles Yellow Badge Icon matching Image 2 */}
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm shrink-0">
              <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-950 fill-slate-950/20" />
            </div>
            <div className="leading-tight">
              <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm sm:text-base line-clamp-1">
                {currentInsight.name}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                <span>✨ Do Gemini tạo</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action buttons (Share & Close) matching Image 2 */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              onClick={handleShare}
              title="Chia sẻ phân tích"
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              title="Đóng bảng phân tích"
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Horizontal Scrollable Tool/Pills Tags Bar matching Image 2 */}
        <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50/90 border-b border-slate-200 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2">
          {Object.values(CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS).map((item) => {
            const isActive = item.id === selectedKey;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedKey(item.id);
                  setDynamicAiContent(null);
                  if (TOOLS_CONFIG[item.id]) {
                    onSelectTool(item.id);
                  }
                }}
                className={`shrink-0 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90'
                }`}
              >
                {item.name}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* 3. Main Scrollable Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-5 scrollbar-thin">

          {/* 
            TOP ADVERTISEMENT BLOCK - GOOGLE ADSENSE READY (Matches Image 2 exactly) 
            "QUẢNG CÁO BÊN TRÊN"
          */}
          <div 
            id="drawer-top-adsense-card" 
            className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xs relative overflow-hidden"
          >
            {/* Ad Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase mb-3">
              <span className="text-slate-400">QUẢNG CÁO • GOOGLE ADSENSE</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-600">ĐƯỢC TÀI TRỢ</span>
            </div>

            {/* Ad Body: Glowing Blue Circle Icon + Title + Description + Button */}
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-2.5 pt-1 pb-1">
              {/* Blue Orb / Tech Icon */}
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20">
                <Globe className="w-6 h-6 text-white" />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <h3 className="text-slate-900 font-bold text-sm sm:text-base">
                  Tối Ưu Hiển Thị Quảng Cáo Google (AdSense Ready)
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 leading-relaxed max-w-sm">
                  Hệ sinh thái máy tính và công cụ số học thế hệ mới, tối ưu hóa 100% trên Điện thoại, Tablet và Máy tính.
                </p>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono pt-0.5">
                  ID: {AD_CLIENT_ID}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Blue CTA Button */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => window.open('https://adsense.google.com/start/', '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer mt-1"
              >
                <span>Khám phá ngay</span>
                <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ORANGE CATEGORY TAG & H2 TITLE matching Image 2 */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-600">
              {currentInsight.category}
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 leading-snug">
              {currentInsight.title}
            </h2>
          </div>

          {/* AI ANALYSIS CONTENT CONTAINER matching Image 2 */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
            
            {/* Sub-Header: ✨ Nội dung phân tích từ Gemini AI + 🔄 Làm mới button */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-amber-600">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
                <span>Nội dung phân tích từ Gemini AI</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleFetchAiAnalysis()}
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                <span>Làm mới</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Analysis Text Body with High-Contrast Typography */}
            <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 text-sm text-slate-700 leading-relaxed font-sans space-y-3">
              {isLoading ? (
                <div className="py-8 text-center space-y-2">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-amber-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto" />
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Gemini AI đang tổng hợp và phân tích dữ liệu chuyên sâu...</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="prose max-w-none text-sm text-slate-700 prose-p:my-2 prose-strong:text-slate-900 prose-strong:font-bold prose-ul:my-2 prose-li:my-1">
                  <Markdown>
                    {dynamicAiContent || currentInsight.content}
                  </Markdown>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

          </div>

          {/* 
            BOTTOM ADVERTISEMENT BLOCK - AS REQUESTED BY USER
            "QUẢNG CÁO BÊN DƯỚI"
          */}
          <div 
            id="drawer-bottom-adsense-card" 
            className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-blue-50/30 p-4 shadow-xs relative overflow-hidden"
          >
            {/* Ad Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase mb-2.5">
              <span className="text-slate-400">QUẢNG CÁO TÀI TRỢ • GOOGLE ADS</span>
              <span className="text-blue-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>XÁC MINH CHUẨN SEO</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Ad Content */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-0.5">
                <h4 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Nền Tảng Tiện Ích & Toán Học Trực Tuyến
                </h4>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 line-clamp-1">
                  Khám phá thêm hàng chục công cụ chuẩn xác và giải pháp thông minh
                </p>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                  Pub ID: {AD_CLIENT_ID}
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => window.open('https://google.com', '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')}
                className="shrink-0 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>Xem thêm</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* INTERACTIVE QUESTION FORM: User can ask Gemini anything */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white p-3.5 space-y-2.5 shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
              <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
              <span>Hỏi Gemini thêm về công cụ này:</span>
            </div>
            <form
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (customQuestion.trim()) {
                  handleFetchAiAnalysis(customQuestion);
                }
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <input
                type="text"
                value={customQuestion}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomQuestion(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Nhập câu hỏi bạn muốn giải đáp..."
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="flex-1 px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 outline-none focus:border-amber-500 focus:bg-white transition-colors"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!customQuestion.trim() || isLoading}
                className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-500 disabled:opacity-40 text-slate-950 font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
              >
                <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Gửi</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* 4. Footer */}
        <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200 text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <span>Công nghệ Gemini 3.8 Flash • Google Cloud</span>
          <span className="text-slate-400">Hỗ trợ 24/7</span>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Calculator, 
  Search, 
  Share2, 
  Check, 
  Command, 
  X, 
  ShieldCheck 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ToolId } from '../../types';
import { TOOLS_CONFIG } from '../../data/toolsData';
import { LanguageSelector } from './LanguageSelector';
import { ThemeSelector } from './ThemeSelector';
import { CurrencySelector } from './CurrencySelector';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';

interface HeaderProps {
  currentToolId: ToolId;
  onSelectTool: (id: ToolId) => void;
  isSidebarOpen: boolean;
  onToggleSidebar: () => void;
  onOpenTerms?: () => void;
}

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  currentToolId,
  onSelectTool,
  isSidebarOpen,
  onToggleSidebar,
  onOpenTerms,
}) => {
  const [isSearchOpen, setIsSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [copiedNotification, setCopiedNotification] = useState(false);
  const { t, language } = useLanguage();

  const filteredTools = Object.values(TOOLS_CONFIG).filter(tool => {
    const localizedName = t.toolNames[tool.id] || tool.name;
    const localizedShort = t.toolShortNames[tool.id] || tool.shortName;
    const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return (
      tool.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      tool.shortName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      localizedName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      localizedShort.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      tool.description.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
  });

  const getTestUrl = () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.href && !window.location.href.includes('about:blank')) {
      return window.location.href;
    }
    return 'https://ais-pre-k6khfyf4sc6x3tvba3nvkt-241826408007.asia-southeast1.run.app';
  };

  const handleShare = () => {
    const url = getTestUrl();
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      setCopiedNotification(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedNotification(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <header 
        id="main-header" 
        className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-between px-3 sm:px-6 h-16 backdrop-blur-md border-b transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--app-header-bg, rgba(20, 21, 38, 0.95))',
          borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)'
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
          <button
            id="sidebar-toggle-btn"
            onClick={onToggleSidebar}
            aria-label="Toggle Sidebar"
            className="hidden md:flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800/80 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
          >
            <div className="w-5 flex flex-col gap-1 items-start">
              <span className={`h-0.5 bg-current rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${isSidebarOpen ? 'w-5' : 'w-5'}`} />
              <span className={`h-0.5 bg-current rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${isSidebarOpen ? 'w-3.5' : 'w-5'}`} />
              <span className={`h-0.5 bg-current rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${isSidebarOpen ? 'w-4' : 'w-5'}`} />
            </div>
          </button>

          {/* Logo branding */}
          <div 
            onClick={() => onSelectTool('basic')}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-2.5 cursor-pointer group"
          >
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <Calculator className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
                <span className="font-extrabold text-base sm:text-lg tracking-tight text-white">Calculator Pro</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 hidden sm:block -mt-0.5">{t.siteSubtitle}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Search, Language Switcher (16 Languages), Terms & Share */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
          <button
            id="quick-search-trigger"
            onClick={() => setIsSearchOpen(true)}
            aria-label="Tìm kiếm công cụ"
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 px-2.5 sm:px-3.5 py-1.5 sm:py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400 bg-slate-800/60 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-slate-200 border border-slate-700/60 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-inner focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50"
          >
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 text-slate-400" />
            <span className="hidden md:inline">{t.searchPlaceholder}</span>
            <span className="inline md:hidden text-xs">Tìm</span>
            <kbd className="hidden lg:inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono bg-slate-900/80 text-slate-400 rounded border border-slate-700">
              <Command className="w-3 h-3" /> K
            </kbd>
          </button>

          {/* Currency Selector (USD Base) */}
          <CurrencySelector variant="header" />

          {/* 16 Major Languages Selector */}
          <LanguageSelector variant="header" />

          {/* Color Themes Switcher */}
          <ThemeSelector variant="header" />

          {/* Terms button */}
          {onOpenTerms && (
            <button
              id="header-terms-btn"
              onClick={onOpenTerms}
              title={t.termsTitle}
              className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800/60 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700/60 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
              <span>{t.termsTitle}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Share tool link */}
          <button
            id="share-app-btn"
            onClick={handleShare}
            title={t.shareButton}
            aria-label={t.shareButton}
            className="flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800/40 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700/60 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            {copiedNotification ? (
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-[#10B981]" />
            ) : (
              <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Quick Search Modal */}
      {isSearchOpen && (
        <div 
          id="search-modal-backdrop"
          onClick={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-start justify-center pt-20 px-4 transition-all"
        >
          <div 
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            className="w-full max-w-xl border rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--app-surface, #1b1d33)',
              borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)'
            }}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/50">
              <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-400" />
              <input
                id="search-input"
                type="text"
                autoFocus
                placeholder={t.searchPlaceholder || "Search tools..."}
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-white placeholder-slate-400 text-sm focus:outline-none"
              />
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto p-2 divide-y divide-slate-800/40">
              {filteredTools.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-8 text-center text-slate-400 text-sm">
                  {language === 'vi' ? `Không tìm thấy công cụ phù hợp với từ khóa "${searchQuery}"` : `No matching tools found for "${searchQuery}"`}
                </div>
              ) : (
                filteredTools.map((tool) => (
                  <button
                    key={tool.id}
                    id={`search-item-${tool.id}`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      onSelectTool(tool.id);
                      setIsSearchOpen(false);
                      setSearchQuery('');
                    }}
                    className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl text-left transition-colors ${

                    }`}
                  >
                    <div>

                        <span className="font-semibold text-white text-sm">
                          {t.toolNames[tool.id] || tool.name}

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Check, ChevronDown, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { LanguageItem } from '../../i18n/languages';

interface LanguageSelectorProps {
  variant?: 'header' | 'footer';
}

export const LanguageSelector: React.FC<LanguageSelectorProps> = ({ variant = 'header' }) => {
  const { language, setLanguage, languages, currentLanguageItem } = useLanguage();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close dropdown on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const filteredLanguages = languages.filter((l: LanguageItem) => 
    l.nativeName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
    l.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
    l.code.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block text-left" ref={dropdownRef}>
      {/* Trigger Button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        id={`language-selector-btn-${variant}`}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-label={`Chọn ngôn ngữ (Đang chọn: ${currentLanguageItem.nativeName})`}
        className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer select-none ${
          variant === 'header'
            ? 'px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-700/80 border border-slate-700/70 hover:border-slate-600 shadow-2xs'
            : 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 bg-slate-800/50 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-slate-200 border border-slate-700/60'
        }`}
      >
        <span className="text-sm">{currentLanguageItem.flag}</span>
        <span className="hidden sm:inline font-medium">{currentLanguageItem.nativeName}</span>
        <span className="sm:hidden font-mono uppercase text-[11px]">{currentLanguageItem.code}</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {/* Dropdown Menu (16 Major Languages) */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div 
          id="header-language-dropdown"
          role="listbox"
          className="absolute right-0 bottom-auto mt-2 w-64 max-h-80 overflow-hidden bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl z-50 flex flex-col animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
        >
          {/* Header / Search input */}
          <div className="p-2.5 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/90 language-search-header">
            <div className="relative flex items-center">
              <Search className="absolute left-2.5 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                id="language-search-input"
                type="text"
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={`${languages.length} languages...`}
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
                autoFocus
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Languages List */}
          <div className="overflow-y-auto p-1.5 space-y-0.5 scrollbar-thin">
            {filteredLanguages.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
                {language === 'vi' ? 'Không tìm thấy ngôn ngữ' : 'No language found'}
              </div>
            ) : (
              filteredLanguages.map((langItem) => {
                const isSelected = langItem.code === language;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={langItem.code}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={isSelected}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setLanguage(langItem.code as any);
                      setIsOpen(false);
                      setSearch('');
                    }}
                    className={`language-option-btn w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'is-selected bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold shadow-xs'
                        : 'text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <span className="text-base shrink-0">{langItem.flag}</span>
                      <div className="text-left">
                        <div className="lang-native-name font-semibold leading-tight">{langItem.nativeName}</div>
                        <div className={`lang-sub-name text-[10px] ${isSelected ? 'text-blue-100' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
                          {langItem.name}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {isSelected && <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-white shrink-0" />}
                  </button>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Footer of Dropdown */}
          <div className="language-dropdown-footer px-3 py-2 bg-slate-950/60 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>{languages.length} {language === 'vi' ? 'Ngôn ngữ' : 'Languages'}</span>
            <span className="font-mono">AC Studio i18n</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { ToolMeta, ToolId } from '../../types';
import { LanguageCode } from '../../i18n/languages';
import { getToolSEO } from '../../data/internationalSEO';
import { getLocalizedToolContent } from '../../data/localizedToolContent';

interface SEOManagerProps {
  tool: ToolMeta;
  lang: LanguageCode;
}

export const SUPPORTED_SEO_MARKETS: { code: string; hreflang: string }[] = [
  { code: 'en', hreflang: 'en' },
  { code: 'vi', hreflang: 'vi' },
  { code: 'ja', hreflang: 'ja' },
  { code: 'ko', hreflang: 'ko' },
  { code: 'zh', hreflang: 'zh-Hans' },
  { code: 'es', hreflang: 'es' },
  { code: 'fr', hreflang: 'fr' },
  { code: 'de', hreflang: 'de' },
  { code: 'pt', hreflang: 'pt' },
  { code: 'ru', hreflang: 'ru' },
  { code: 'id', hreflang: 'id' },
  { code: 'th', hreflang: 'th' },
  { code: 'hi', hreflang: 'hi' },
  { code: 'ar', hreflang: 'ar' },
  { code: 'it', hreflang: 'it' },
  { code: 'nl', hreflang: 'nl' },
  { code: 'tr', hreflang: 'tr' },
  { code: 'pl', hreflang: 'pl' },
  { code: 'ms', hreflang: 'ms' },
  { code: 'sv', hreflang: 'sv' }
];

const getEffectiveDomain = () => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'https://web-calculator.com';
  const customUrl = (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_APP_URL;
  if (customUrl) return customUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const origin = window.location.origin;
  if (!origin.includes('localhost') && !origin.includes('127.0.0.1')) {
    return origin;
  }
  return 'https://web-calculator.com';
};

const getApplicationCategory = (toolId: ToolId): string => {
  switch (toolId) {
    case 'bmi':
    case 'calorie':
    case 'bodyfat':
    case 'ovulation':
    case 'pace':
      return 'HealthApplication';
    case 'salary':
    case 'loan':
    case 'compound':
    case 'mortgage':
    case 'tax':
    case 'tip':
    case 'discount':
    case 'percentage':
      return 'FinanceApplication';
    case 'trigonometry':
    case 'gpa':
    case 'concrete':
      return 'EducationalApplication';
    case 'basic':
    case 'unit':
    case 'age':
    case 'time':
    case 'date':
    case 'random':
    case 'password':
    case 'ai':
    default:
      return 'UtilitiesApplication';
  }
};

export const SEOManager: React.FC<SEOManagerProps> = ({ tool, lang }) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    const DOMAIN = getEffectiveDomain();
    const prevTitle = document.title;
    const isBasic = tool.id === 'basic';
    const toolSlug = isBasic ? '' : tool.id;
    const currentCanonicalUrl = isBasic ? `${DOMAIN}/${lang}/` : `${DOMAIN}/${lang}/${tool.id}`;
    const isRtl = lang === 'ar';
    const localizedSEO = getToolSEO(tool.id, lang);
    const localizedContent = getLocalizedToolContent(tool.id, lang);

    // 1. Update HTML language & direction attributes
    document.documentElement.lang = lang;
    document.documentElement.dir = isRtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';

    // 2. Update Title
    const fullTitle = `${localizedSEO.title} | Web Calculator`;
    document.title = fullTitle;

    // 3. Update Meta Description
    let metaDesc = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]') as HTMLMetaElement | null;
    if (!metaDesc) {
      metaDesc = document.createElement('meta');
      metaDesc.name = 'description';
      document.head.appendChild(metaDesc);
    }
    metaDesc.content = localizedSEO.description;

    // 3b. Update Meta Keywords
    let metaKeywords = document.querySelector('meta[name="keywords"]') as HTMLMetaElement | null;
    if (!metaKeywords) {
      metaKeywords = document.createElement('meta');
      metaKeywords.name = 'keywords';
      document.head.appendChild(metaKeywords);
    }
    metaKeywords.content = localizedSEO.keywords.join(', ');

    // 4. Update OpenGraph & Twitter
    const updateOrCreateMeta = (property: string, content: string, isName = false) => {
      const selector = isName ? `meta[name="${property}"]` : `meta[property="${property}"]`;
      let el = document.querySelector(selector) as HTMLMetaElement | null;
      if (!el) {
        el = document.createElement('meta');
        if (isName) {
          el.name = property;
        } else {
          el.setAttribute('property', property);
        }
        document.head.appendChild(el);
      }
      el.content = content;
    };

    updateOrCreateMeta('og:title', fullTitle);
    updateOrCreateMeta('og:description', localizedSEO.description);
    updateOrCreateMeta('og:url', currentCanonicalUrl);
    updateOrCreateMeta('og:type', 'website');
    updateOrCreateMeta('og:image', `${DOMAIN}/og-image.png`);
    updateOrCreateMeta('twitter:card', 'summary_large_image', true);
    updateOrCreateMeta('twitter:title', fullTitle, true);
    updateOrCreateMeta('twitter:description', localizedSEO.description, true);
    updateOrCreateMeta('twitter:image', `${DOMAIN}/og-image.png`, true);

    // 5. Update Canonical Link
    let canonical = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]') as HTMLLinkElement | null;
    if (!canonical) {
      canonical = document.createElement('link');
      canonical.rel = 'canonical';
      document.head.appendChild(canonical);
    }
    canonical.href = currentCanonicalUrl;

    // 6. Dynamic Hreflang Alternates (20 International Markets + x-default) directly in <head>
    document.querySelectorAll('link[data-dynamic-hreflang="true"]').forEach(el => el.remove());

    // x-default points to English
    const xDefaultLink = document.createElement('link');
    xDefaultLink.rel = 'alternate';
    xDefaultLink.hreflang = 'x-default';
    xDefaultLink.href = `${DOMAIN}/en/${toolSlug}`;
    xDefaultLink.setAttribute('data-dynamic-hreflang', 'true');
    document.head.appendChild(xDefaultLink);

    // 20 markets
    SUPPORTED_SEO_MARKETS.forEach(market => {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'alternate';
      link.hreflang = market.hreflang;
      link.href = `${DOMAIN}/${market.code}/${toolSlug}`;
      link.setAttribute('data-dynamic-hreflang', 'true');
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    });

    // 7. Dynamic JSON-LD Structured Data Schema (WebApplication, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, HowTo)
    const schemaData = {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@graph": [
        {
          "@type": "WebApplication",
          "@id": `${currentCanonicalUrl}#webapp`,
          "url": currentCanonicalUrl,
          "name": localizedSEO.title,
          "alternateName": localizedContent.name,
          "applicationCategory": getApplicationCategory(tool.id),
          "operatingSystem": "All modern browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Android, iOS)",
          "browserRequirements": "Requires JavaScript. Requires HTML5.",
          "inLanguage": lang,
          "description": localizedSEO.description,
          "featureList": localizedContent.usageSteps,
          "offers": {
            "@type": "Offer",
            "price": "0",
            "priceCurrency": "USD"
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
          "@id": `${currentCanonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
          "itemListElement": [
            {
              "@type": "ListItem",
              "position": 1,
              "name": "Web Calculator",
              "item": `${DOMAIN}/${lang}/`
            },
            ...(!isBasic ? [{
              "@type": "ListItem",
              "position": 2,
              "name": localizedContent.name,
              "item": currentCanonicalUrl
            }] : [])
          ]
        },
        {
          "@type": "FAQPage",
          "@id": `${currentCanonicalUrl}#faq`,
          "mainEntity": localizedContent.faqs.map(faq => ({
            "@type": "Question",
            "name": faq.question,
            "acceptedAnswer": {
              "@type": "Answer",
              "text": faq.answer
            }
          }))
        },
        {
          "@type": "HowTo",
          "@id": `${currentCanonicalUrl}#howto`,
          "name": `How to use ${localizedContent.name}`,
          "description": localizedSEO.description,
          "step": localizedContent.usageSteps.map((step, idx) => ({
            "@type": "HowToStep",
            "position": idx + 1,
            "name": `${localizedContent.name} - Step ${idx + 1}`,
            "text": step
          }))
        }
      ]
    };

    const schemaId = 'dynamic-tool-schema-jsonld';
    let scriptTag = document.getElementById(schemaId) as HTMLScriptElement | null;
    if (!scriptTag) {
      scriptTag = document.createElement('script');
      scriptTag.id = schemaId;
      scriptTag.type = 'application/ld+json';
      document.head.appendChild(scriptTag);
    }
    scriptTag.text = JSON.stringify(schemaData);

    return () => {
      document.title = prevTitle;
    };
  }, [tool, lang]);

  return null;
};

export const Sidebar: React.FC<SidebarProps> = ({
  currentToolId,
  onSelectTool,
  isOpen
}) => {
  const { language, t } = useLanguage();
  const secUi = getSectionUi(language);
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  // Category filter state ('all' or specific category)
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<ToolCategory | 'all'>('all');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  
  // Track open/collapsed categories
  const [collapsedCategories, setCollapsedCategories] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  const toggleCategory = (catId: string) => {
    setCollapsedCategories(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [catId]: !prev[catId]
    }));
  };

  const tools = useMemo(() => Object.values(TOOLS_CONFIG), []);

  // Filter tools by search query if any
  const filteredTools = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return tools;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return tools.filter(tool => {
      const name = (t.toolNames[tool.id] || tool.name).toLowerCase();
      const short = (t.toolShortNames[tool.id] || tool.shortName || '').toLowerCase();
      const id = tool.id.toLowerCase();
      return name.includes(q) || short.includes(q) || id.includes(q);
    });
  }, [tools, searchQuery, t]);

  const renderToolButton = (tool: typeof tools[0]) => {
    const isActive = currentToolId === tool.id;
    const localizedName = t.toolNames[tool.id] || tool.name;
    return (
      <button
        key={tool.id}
        id={`sidebar-nav-${tool.id}`}
        onClick={() => onSelectTool(tool.id)}
        title={localizedName}
        className={`w-full group flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-left transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer ${
          isActive 
            ? 'sidebar-tool-active bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-500/25 ring-1 ring-blue-400/40' 
            : 'sidebar-tool-inactive text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800/80'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1 pr-2">
          <span className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg shrink-0 transition-colors ${
            isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-blue-400 group-hover:bg-slate-700'
          }`}>
            {getIcon(tool.id)}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[14.5px] font-medium leading-snug break-words">
            {localizedName}
          </span>
        </div>
        
        {isActive ? (
          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#10B981] ring-2 ring-white/20 shrink-0" />
        ) : (
          <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0" />
        )}
      </button>
    );
  };

  return (
    <aside 
      id="desktop-sidebar"
      className={`hidden md:flex flex-col shrink-0 border-r transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${
        isOpen ? 'w-80' : 'w-0 -translate-x-full overflow-hidden'
      }`}
      style={{
        backgroundColor: 'var(--app-bg, #141526)',
        borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)'
      }}
    >
      {/* Search & Category Filter Header */}
      <div className="p-3 border-b border-slate-800 space-y-2.5 shrink-0">
        {/* Quick Search */}
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={isVi ? 'Tìm nhanh công cụ...' : 'Search tools...'}
            className="w-full pl-8 pr-7 py-1.5 text-xs bg-slate-800/90 text-white rounded-lg border border-slate-700/80 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
            >
              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Category Pill Filters */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none text-[11px]">
          <button
            onClick={() => setSelectedCategory('all')}
            className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer font-medium ${
              selectedCategory === 'all'
                ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700'
            }`}
          >
            {isVi ? 'Tất cả' : 'All'} ({tools.length})
          </button>
          {CATEGORIES.map(cat => {
            const count = tools.filter(t => t.category === cat.id).length;
            const isSel = selectedCategory === cat.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat.id)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer font-medium ${
                  isSel
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                    : 'bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                {isVi ? cat.nameVi.split(' ')[0] : cat.nameEn.split(' ')[0]} ({count})
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Scrollable Tool Categories */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-4 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-800">
        {CATEGORIES.map(cat => {
          // If a category filter is active and this isn't it, hide
          if (selectedCategory !== 'all' && selectedCategory !== cat.id) {
            return null;
          }

          const catTools = filteredTools.filter(t => t.category === cat.id);
          if (catTools.length === 0) return null;

          const isCollapsed = collapsedCategories[cat.id];
          const hasActiveTool = catTools.some(t => t.id === currentToolId);

          return (
            <div key={cat.id} className="space-y-1">
              {/* Category Group Header */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleCategory(cat.id)}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-left hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className={`text-[12.5px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase ${cat.color} group-hover:brightness-110`}>
                    {isVi ? cat.nameVi : cat.nameEn}
                  </span>
                  {hasActiveTool && (
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center">
                  {isCollapsed ? (
                    <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-slate-200" />
                  ) : (
                    <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-slate-200" />
                  )}
                </div>
              </button>

              {/* Tool Buttons in this Category */}
              {!isCollapsed && (
                <div className="space-y-0.5 pt-0.5">
                  {catTools.map(renderToolButton)}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}

        {/* SEO Trust Guarantee Badge */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 text-[13.5px] text-slate-400 space-y-1.5 mt-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-300 font-semibold">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#10B981]" />
            <span>{secUi.sidebarGuaranteeTitle}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed">
            {secUi.sidebarGuaranteeText}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Moon, Sun, Check, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme, ThemeConfig } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface ThemeSelectorProps {
  variant?: 'header' | 'sidebar' | 'modal';
  onClose?: () => void;
}

export const ThemeSelector: React.FC<ThemeSelectorProps> = ({ variant = 'header', onClose }) => {
  const { themeId, currentTheme, setTheme, themes, isDark } = useTheme();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close dropdown on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    if (variant === 'modal') return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [variant]);

  const handleSelect = (id: typeof themeId) => {
    setTheme(id);
    if (variant === 'header') {
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
    if (onClose) {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  const renderIcon = (id: string, className = "w-4 h-4") => {
    if (id === 'light') {
      return <Sun className={`${className} text-amber-500`} />;
    }
    return <Moon className={`${className} text-cyan-400`} />;
  };

  // If used inside a modal or drawer
  if (variant === 'modal') {
    return (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
        {themes.map((t: ThemeConfig) => {
          const isSelected = t.id === themeId;
          return (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleSelect(t.id)}
              style={isSelected ? { borderColor: t.dotColor, boxShadow: `0 0 12px ${t.dotColor}33` } : undefined}
              className={`text-left p-3 rounded-2xl flex flex-col justify-between transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer ${
                isSelected
                  ? 'border-2 bg-slate-900/90 shadow-lg'
                  : 'border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/50 hover:bg-slate-800/80 hover:border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full mb-2">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  {renderIcon(t.id, "w-4 h-4")}
                </div>
                {isSelected && (
                  <Check
                    className="w-4 h-4 font-bold"
                    style={{ color: t.checkColor }}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white block">
                  {t.name}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 line-clamp-1">
                  {t.tag}
                </span>
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block text-left" ref={dropdownRef}>
      {/* Header Button Trigger */}
      <button
        type="button"
        id="theme-selector-btn"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-label="Chọn giao diện Sáng / Tối"
        title={`Đang dùng: ${currentTheme.name} (Bấm để đổi)`}
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer select-none shadow-2xs"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: isDark ? 'rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8)' : '#FFFFFF',
          borderColor: isDark ? 'rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.7)' : '#CBD5E1',
          color: isDark ? '#F1F5F9' : '#0F172A',
        }}
      >
        {isDark ? (
          <Moon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
        ) : (
          <Sun className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />
        )}
        <span className="font-medium">{currentTheme.tag}</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {/* Dropdown Popup with 2 Themes: Dark & Light */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div
          role="dialog"
          aria-label="Bảng chọn chế độ giao diện"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--app-surface, #1b1d33)',
            borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)',
          }}
          className="absolute right-0 bottom-auto mt-2 w-72 sm:w-80 p-3 border rounded-2xl shadow-2xl z-50 flex flex-col gap-2.5 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 backdrop-blur-xl"
        >
          <div className="px-1.5 pt-1 pb-1 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800/80">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
              {isDark ? <Moon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" /> : <Sun className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />}
              <span>Chế độ hiển thị</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-normal">
              2 chế độ
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            {themes.map((t: ThemeConfig) => {
              const isSelected = t.id === themeId;
              return (
                <button
                  key={t.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(t.id)}
                  style={isSelected ? { borderColor: t.dotColor, boxShadow: `0 0 12px ${t.dotColor}33` } : undefined}
                  className={`w-full text-left p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer ${
                    isSelected
                      ? isDark ? 'border-2 bg-slate-900/90 shadow-md' : 'border-2 bg-slate-100 shadow-md'
                      : isDark ? 'border border-slate-800/90 bg-slate-900/60 hover:bg-slate-800/90 hover:border-slate-700' : 'border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 hover:border-slate-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1 pr-2">
                    {/* Icon Box */}
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-inner">
                      {renderIcon(t.id, "w-5 h-5")}
                    </div>

                    {/* Theme Name & Description */}
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white tracking-tight truncate">
                          {t.name}
                        </span>
                        <span className={`text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border shrink-0 ${t.tagClass}`}>
                          {t.tag}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5 truncate">
                        {t.description}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Active Indicator Checkmark */}
                  {isSelected && (
                    <div className="shrink-0">
                      <Check
                        className="w-5 h-5 font-bold"
                        style={{ color: t.checkColor }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ChevronRight,
  HelpCircle,
  BookOpen,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  ChevronDown,
  Check,
  Share2,
  RotateCcw,
  Sparkles,
  ArrowRight,
  Compass
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ToolId, ToolMeta } from '../../types';
import { TOOLS_CONFIG } from '../../data/toolsData';
import { AdBanner } from './AdBanner';
import { ExploreMoreSection } from './ExploreMoreSection';
import { SEOManager } from './SEOManager';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { getToolSEO } from '../../data/internationalSEO';
import { getKeywordDirectory } from '../../data/keywordDirectory';
import { getSectionUi } from '../../data/internationalSections';

interface ToolLayoutProps {
  tool: ToolMeta;
  onSelectTool: (id: ToolId) => void;
  onResetTool?: () => void;
  onOpenGemini?: (toolKey?: ToolId) => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export const ToolLayout: React.FC<ToolLayoutProps> = ({
  tool,
  onSelectTool,
  onResetTool,
  onOpenGemini,
  children
}) => {
  const { language, t } = useLanguage();
  const toolSEO = getToolSEO(tool.id, language);
  const secUi = getSectionUi(language);
  const [openFaqIndex, setOpenFaqIndex] = useState<number | null>(0);
  const [copiedLink, setCopiedLink] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setToastMessage(null);
    }, 2500);
  };

  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    const search = window.location.search || '';
    const cleanToolUrl = `${window.location.origin}/${language}/${tool.id}${search}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(cleanToolUrl);
    setCopiedLink(true);
    showToast(t.copiedToast || secUi.shareCopied);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedLink(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleResetWithToast = () => {
    if (onResetTool) {
      onResetTool();
      showToast(secUi.resetButton);
    }
  };

        {/* Breadcrumb Navigation */}
        <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className="flex items-center text-xs text-slate-400 space-x-1.5 overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap py-0.5">
          <button 
            onClick={() => onSelectTool('basic')} 
            className="hover:text-blue-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            {secUi.homeBreadcrumb}
          </button>
          <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
          <span className="text-slate-500">{secUi.toolsBreadcrumb}</span>
          <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
          <span 
            className="font-bold"

        {/* Desktop Action buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          {onResetTool && (

              id={`reset-btn-${tool.id}`}
              onClick={handleResetWithToast}

          >

            <h2>{secUi.formulaTitle}</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
            {tool.formulaDescription}
          </p>
          {tool.formulaEquation && (
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-emerald-400 font-mono text-sm tracking-wide overflow-x-auto text-center font-bold">

          )}

          </div>

                  <span className="pr-4">{faq.question}</span>

            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 6. Internal Linking (Cross links between related tools) */}
      <section id="internal-links-section" className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-300">
          <LinkIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
          <span>{secUi.relatedTitle}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {tool.relatedToolIds.map((relId) => {
            const relTool = TOOLS_CONFIG[relId];
            if (!relTool) return null;
            const relName = t.toolNames[relId] || relTool.name;
            return (
              <button
                key={relId}
                id={`related-tool-${relId}`}
                onClick={() => {
                  onSelectTool(relId);
                  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });

              >
                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors">
                    {relName}
                  </h4>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{relTool.badge}</span>
                </div>
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-blue-400 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-all" />
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 7. Semantic Search Keywords & Navigational Internal Links (Core UX & Anti-Stuffing Crawlability) */}
      <section id="semantic-seo-keywords" aria-label="Khám phá nhanh chủ đề và công cụ liên quan" className="bg-slate-900/40 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
            <Compass className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
            <span>{secUi.keywordsTitle} ({language.toUpperCase()})</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-medium">{secUi.keywordsSubtitle}</span>
        </div>
        
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
          {secUi.keywordsIntro}
        </p>

        <nav aria-label="Chủ đề tính toán liên quan" className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">
          {getKeywordDirectory(language).map((item, idx) => {
            const isCurrentTool = item.toolId === tool.id;
            const targetUrl = `/${language}/${item.toolId === 'basic' ? '' : item.toolId}`;
            return (
              <a
                key={idx}
                id={`keyword-link-${item.toolId}-${idx}`}
                href={targetUrl}
                title={item.label}
                aria-current={isCurrentTool ? 'page' : undefined}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  onSelectTool(item.toolId);
                }}
                className={`inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                  isCurrentTool
                    ? 'bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-300 border-blue-500/50 shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-slate-800/70 text-slate-300 border-slate-700/60 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white hover:border-blue-500/40'
                }`}
              >
                <span>{item.tag}</span>
              </a>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
      </section>

      {/* Bottom spacer for mobile bar */}
      <div className="h-16 md:hidden" />

      {/* Floating Toast Notification */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-20 md:bottom-20 right-4 md:right-8 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/95 text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-2xl border border-blue-500/40 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 duration-200">
          <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
