import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Shield,
  RotateCcw,
  User,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2
} from 'lucide-react';

export const ArmyBodyFatCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [gender, setGender] = useState<'male' | 'female'>('male');
  const [age, setAge] = useState<number>(24);
  const [heightCm, setHeightCm] = useState<number>(178);
  const [neckCm, setNeckCm] = useState<number>(38);
  const [waistCm, setWaistCm] = useState<number>(84);
  const [hipCm, setHipCm] = useState<number>(96); // only for females

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    // Convert cm to inches for standard DoD/Army formula:
    // Men: %BF = 86.010 * log10(waist - neck) - 70.041 * log10(height) + 36.76
    // Women: %BF = 163.205 * log10(waist + hip - neck) - 97.684 * log10(height) - 78.387
    const heightIn = heightCm / 2.54;
    const neckIn = neckCm / 2.54;
    const waistIn = waistCm / 2.54;
    const hipIn = hipCm / 2.54;

    let bodyFat = 0;
    if (gender === 'male') {
      const diff = waistIn - neckIn;
      if (diff > 0 && heightIn > 0) {
        bodyFat = 86.010 * Math.log10(diff) - 70.041 * Math.log10(heightIn) + 36.76;
      }
    } else {
      const sum = waistIn + hipIn - neckIn;
      if (sum > 0 && heightIn > 0) {
        bodyFat = 163.205 * Math.log10(sum) - 97.684 * Math.log10(heightIn) - 78.387;
      }
    }

    bodyFat = Math.max(2, Math.min(60, bodyFat));

    // Army Max Allowable BF Standards by age:
    // 17-20: M: 20%, F: 30%
    // 21-27: M: 22%, F: 32%
    // 28-39: M: 24%, F: 34%
    // 40+:   M: 26%, F: 36%
    let maxAllowed = 22;
    if (gender === 'male') {
      if (age <= 20) maxAllowed = 20;
      else if (age <= 27) maxAllowed = 22;
      else if (age <= 39) maxAllowed = 24;
      else maxAllowed = 26;
    } else {
      if (age <= 20) maxAllowed = 30;
      else if (age <= 27) maxAllowed = 32;
      else if (age <= 39) maxAllowed = 34;
      else maxAllowed = 36;
    }

    const passesStandard = bodyFat <= maxAllowed;

    return {
      bodyFat: Math.round(bodyFat * 10) / 10,
      maxAllowed,
      passesStandard
    };
  }, [gender, age, heightCm, neckCm, waistCm, hipCm]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950/50 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30">
            <Shield className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Army Body Fat Calculator – Tiêu Chuẩn Quân Đội Hoa Kỳ</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Đo tỷ lệ phần trăm mỡ cơ thể theo chuẩn Army Regulation 600-9 (Băng đo chu vi)</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="army-fat-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setGender('male'); setAge(24); setHeightCm(178); setNeckCm(38); setWaistCm(84); setHipCm(96); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <User className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            Số đo chu vi cơ thể (cm)
          </h2>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              id="army-gender-male"
              onClick={() => setGender('male')}
              className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
                gender === 'male' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              Nam quân nhân
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              id="army-gender-female"
              onClick={() => setGender('female')}
              className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
                gender === 'female' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              Nữ quân nhân
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Tuổi</label>
              <input
                id="army-age"
                type="number"
                value={age}
                onChange={(e) => setAge(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Chiều cao (cm)</label>
              <input
                id="army-height"
                type="number"
                value={heightCm}
                onChange={(e) => setHeightCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Vòng cổ (cm)</label>
              <input
                id="army-neck"
                type="number"
                value={neckCm}
                onChange={(e) => setNeckCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Vòng bụng/eo (cm)</label>
              <input
                id="army-waist"
                type="number"
                value={waistCm}
                onChange={(e) => setWaistCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {gender === 'female' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Vòng mông (Hip - cm)</label>
              <input
                id="army-hip"
                type="number"
                value={hipCm}
                onChange={(e) => setHipCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300 font-semibold">Tỷ lệ mỡ cơ thể ước tính (Body Fat)</span>
            <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {calculations.bodyFat}%
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Giới hạn tối đa cho phép theo độ tuổi ({age} tuổi): <span className="text-white font-semibold font-sans">{calculations.maxAllowed}%</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-3 ${
            calculations.passesStandard
              ? 'bg-emerald-950/30 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300'
              : 'bg-rose-950/30 border-rose-500/40 text-rose-300'
          }`}>
            {calculations.passesStandard ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            ) : (
              <AlertCircle className="w-6 h-6 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
            )}
            <div>
              <div className="font-bold text-sm">
                {calculations.passesStandard ? 'Đạt tiêu chuẩn thể lực quân đội' : 'Chưa đạt tiêu chuẩn quân đội'}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs opacity-80">
                {calculations.passesStandard
                  ? `Mức mỡ của bạn nằm trong giới hạn an toàn quy định của U.S. Army AR 600-9.`
                  : `Tỷ lệ mỡ vượt quá ngưỡng ${calculations.maxAllowed}% cho phép, cần tập luyện và điều chỉnh dinh dưỡng.`}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Car, DollarSign, RotateCcw, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

export const AutoLoanCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [vehiclePrice, setVehiclePrice] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 800000000 : 35000;
  });
  const [loanTermMonths, setLoanTermMonths] = useState<number>(60);
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState<number>(5.5);
  const [downPayment, setDownPayment] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 150000000 : 5000;
  });
  const [tradeInValue, setTradeInValue] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 50000000 : 2000;
  });
  const [salesTaxRate, setSalesTaxRate] = useState<number>(6.5);
  const [otherFees, setOtherFees] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 20000000 : 800;
  });

  // Synchronize when switching currency
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      setVehiclePrice((prev) => (prev < 100000 ? 800000000 : prev));
      setDownPayment((prev) => (prev < 10000 ? 150000000 : prev));
      setTradeInValue((prev) => (prev < 5000 ? 50000000 : prev));
      setOtherFees((prev) => (prev < 2000 ? 20000000 : prev));
    } else {
      setVehiclePrice((prev) => (prev >= 1000000 ? 35000 : prev));
      setDownPayment((prev) => (prev >= 100000 ? 5000 : prev));
      setTradeInValue((prev) => (prev >= 100000 ? 2000 : prev));
      setOtherFees((prev) => (prev >= 100000 ? 800 : prev));
    }
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const netPrice = Math.max(0, vehiclePrice - tradeInValue);
    const salesTaxAmount = (netPrice * salesTaxRate) / 100;
    const totalPurchaseCost = vehiclePrice + salesTaxAmount + otherFees;
    const totalCredits = downPayment + tradeInValue;
    const loanAmount = Math.max(0, totalPurchaseCost - totalCredits);

    const monthlyRate = interestRate / 100 / 12;
    let monthlyPayment = 0;
    let totalInterest = 0;

    if (monthlyRate > 0 && loanTermMonths > 0) {
      monthlyPayment = (loanAmount * (monthlyRate * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, loanTermMonths))) / 
                       (Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, loanTermMonths) - 1);
      totalInterest = (monthlyPayment * loanTermMonths) - loanAmount;
    } else if (loanTermMonths > 0) {
      monthlyPayment = loanAmount / loanTermMonths;
      totalInterest = 0;
    }

    const totalLoanCost = loanAmount + totalInterest;

    // First 12 months amortization preview
    const schedule = [];
    let balance = loanAmount;
    for (let m = 1; m <= Math.min(12, loanTermMonths); m++) {
      const interestForMonth = balance * monthlyRate;
      const principalForMonth = monthlyPayment - interestForMonth;
      balance = Math.max(0, balance - principalForMonth);
      schedule.push({
        month: m,
        principal: principalForMonth,
        interest: interestForMonth,
        balance
      });
    }

    return {
      salesTaxAmount,
      loanAmount,
      monthlyPayment,
      totalInterest,
      totalLoanCost,
      totalPurchaseCost,
      schedule
    };
  }, [vehiclePrice, loanTermMonths, interestRate, downPayment, tradeInValue, salesTaxRate, otherFees]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setVehiclePrice(currency === 'VND' ? 800000000 : 35000);
    setLoanTermMonths(60);
    setInterestRate(5.5);
    setDownPayment(currency === 'VND' ? 150000000 : 5000);
    setTradeInValue(currency === 'VND' ? 50000000 : 2000);
    setSalesTaxRate(6.5);
    setOtherFees(currency === 'VND' ? 20000000 : 800);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="tool-header-banner p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="banner-icon-box p-3 bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30">
            <Car className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Auto Loan Calculator – Tính Khoản Vay Mua Ô Tô</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Dự toán tiền trả hàng tháng, thuế trước bạ, lãi suất và tổng chi phí mua xe</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="autoloan-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Form: Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            Thông số khoản vay &amp; Xe
          </h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Giá xe niêm yết ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                id="autoloan-vehicle-price"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 20000000 : 500}
                value={vehiclePrice}
                onChange={(e) => setVehiclePrice(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Thời hạn vay (tháng)</label>
              <select
                id="autoloan-term-select"
                value={loanTermMonths}
                onChange={(e) => setLoanTermMonths(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              >
                <option value={24}>24 tháng (2 năm)</option>
                <option value={36}>36 tháng (3 năm)</option>
                <option value={48}>48 tháng (4 năm)</option>
                <option value={60}>60 tháng (5 năm)</option>
                <option value={72}>72 tháng (6 năm)</option>
                <option value={84}>84 tháng (7 năm)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Lãi suất năm (%/năm)</label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-rate"
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                value={interestRate}
                onChange={(e) => setInterestRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Tiền trả trước ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-down-payment"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 250}
                value={downPayment}
                onChange={(e) => setDownPayment(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Đổi xe cũ (Trade-in {currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-trade-in"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 250}
                value={tradeInValue}
                onChange={(e) => setTradeInValue(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Thuế bán hàng / trước bạ (%)</label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-tax-rate"
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                value={salesTaxRate}
                onChange={(e) => setSalesTaxRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Phí biển số &amp; Đăng kiểm ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-other-fees"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 1000000 : 50}
                value={otherFees}
                onChange={(e) => setOtherFees(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output: Key Metrics */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="tool-hero-banner p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-950/30 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400 font-semibold">Khoản thanh toán ước tính hàng tháng</span>
            <div className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {formatMoney(calculations.monthlyPayment)}
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-400 font-normal"> /tháng</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Trong vòng {loanTermMonths} tháng với lãi suất {interestRate}%/năm
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Số tiền vay gốc</span>
              <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-white font-sans tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.loanAmount)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Tổng tiền lãi</span>
              <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-rose-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.totalInterest)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Thuế trước bạ</span>
              <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-amber-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.salesTaxAmount)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 12 Months Amortization Preview */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
                Lịch trả nợ năm đầu tiên (12 tháng)
              </h3>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-thin">
              <table className="w-full text-xs text-left text-slate-300">
                <thead className="text-[11px] uppercase bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 sticky top-0">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-2">Tháng</th>
                    <th className="p-2">Tiền gốc</th>
                    <th className="p-2">Tiền lãi</th>
                    <th className="p-2 text-right">Dư nợ còn lại</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.schedule.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.month} className="hover:bg-slate-800/40">
                      <td className="p-2 font-medium">#{row.month}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-emerald-400">{formatMoney(row.principal)}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-rose-400">{formatMoney(row.interest)}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-right text-slate-200">{formatMoney(row.balance)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Calculator, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const AverageCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [dataInput, setDataInput] = useState<string>('8, 9, 7.5, 10, 8.5');

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const numbers = dataInput
      .split(/[\s,;]+/)
      .map(Number)
      .filter((n) => !isNaN(n));

    const count = numbers.length;
    if (count === 0) return null;

    const sum = numbers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const arithmeticMean = sum / count;

    // Geometric mean (only for positive numbers)
    let geometricMean: number | null = null;
    const allPositive = numbers.every((n) => n > 0);
    if (allPositive) {
      const product = numbers.reduce((a, b) => a * b, 1);
      geometricMean = Math.pow(product, 1 / count);
    }

    // Harmonic mean (only for positive numbers)
    let harmonicMean: number | null = null;
    if (allPositive) {
      const sumInv = numbers.reduce((a, b) => a + (1 / b), 0);
      harmonicMean = count / sumInv;
    }

    // Median
    const sorted = [...numbers].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const mid = Math.floor(count / 2);
    const median = count % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;

    return {
      count,
      sum,
      arithmeticMean: arithmeticMean.toFixed(4),
      geometricMean: geometricMean !== null ? geometricMean.toFixed(4) : 'N/A (Cần số > 0)',
      harmonicMean: harmonicMean !== null ? harmonicMean.toFixed(4) : 'N/A (Cần số > 0)',
      median,
      min: Math.min(...numbers),
      max: Math.max(...numbers)
    };
  }, [dataInput]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Calculator className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Average Calculator – Tính Trung Bình Cộng</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính trung bình số học (Arithmetic), trung bình nhân (Geometric) và trung bình điều hòa</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="avg-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => setDataInput('8, 9, 7.5, 10, 8.5')}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Dữ liệu số</h2>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Nhập các giá trị (ngăn cách bởi dấu phẩy, khoảng trắng):
            </label>
            <textarea
              id="avg-data-input"
              rows={5}
              value={dataInput}
              onChange={(e) => setDataInput(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {calculations && (
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">Trung bình cộng (Arithmetic Mean)</span>
              <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                {calculations.arithmeticMean}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Tổng cộng: <span className="text-white font-bold font-sans">{calculations.sum}</span> chia cho <span className="text-white font-bold font-sans">{calculations.count} phần tử</span>
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Trung bình nhân (Geometric)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.geometricMean}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Trung bình điều hòa (Harmonic)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.harmonicMean}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Trung vị (Median)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.median}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Nhỏ nhất / Lớn nhất</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.min} / {calculations.max}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
