import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Activity,
  Check,
  Copy
} from 'lucide-react';

export const BodyFatCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [gender, setGender] = useState<'male' | 'female'>('male');
  const age = 28;
  const [unitSystem, setUnitSystem] = useState<'metric' | 'imperial'>('metric');

  // Metric inputs (cm & kg)
  const [heightCm, setHeightCm] = useState<number>(175);
  const [weightKg, setWeightKg] = useState<number>(72);
  const [neckCm, setNeckCm] = useState<number>(38);
  const [waistCm, setWaistCm] = useState<number>(84);
  const [hipCm, setHipCm] = useState<number>(96); // only for female

  // Imperial inputs
  const [heightIn, setHeightIn] = useState<number>(69);
  const [weightLbs, setWeightLbs] = useState<number>(158);
  const [neckIn, setNeckIn] = useState<number>(15);
  const [waistIn, setWaistIn] = useState<number>(33);
  const [hipIn, setHipIn] = useState<number>(38);

  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Normalization to cm and kg for calculation
  const { hCm, wKg, nCm, wsCm, hpCm } = useMemo(() => {
    if (unitSystem === 'metric') {
      return {
        hCm: heightCm,
        wKg: weightKg,
        nCm: neckCm,
        wsCm: waistCm,
        hpCm: hipCm
      };
    } else {
      return {
        hCm: heightIn * 2.54,
        wKg: weightLbs * 0.45359237,
        nCm: neckIn * 2.54,
        wsCm: waistIn * 2.54,
        hpCm: hipIn * 2.54
      };
    }
  }, [unitSystem, heightCm, weightKg, neckCm, waistCm, hipCm, heightIn, weightLbs, neckIn, waistIn, hipIn]);

  // US Navy Formula Calculation
  const result = useMemo(() => {
    let bodyFatPercent = 0;

    if (gender === 'male') {
      const diff = wsCm - nCm;
      if (diff > 0 && hCm > 0) {
        bodyFatPercent = 495 / (1.0324 - 0.19077 * Math.log10(diff) + 0.15456 * Math.log10(hCm)) - 450;
      }
    } else {
      const sum = wsCm + hpCm - nCm;
      if (sum > 0 && hCm > 0) {
        bodyFatPercent = 495 / (1.29579 - 0.35004 * Math.log10(sum) + 0.22100 * Math.log10(hCm)) - 450;
      }
    }

    bodyFatPercent = Math.max(3, Math.min(60, Number(bodyFatPercent.toFixed(1))));

    const fatMassKg = Number(((wKg * bodyFatPercent) / 100).toFixed(1));
    const leanMassKg = Number((wKg - fatMassKg).toFixed(1));

    // Category according to ACE (American Council on Exercise)
    let category = '';
    let categoryColor = '';
    if (gender === 'male') {
      if (bodyFatPercent < 6) {
        category = 'Mỡ thiết yếu (Cực thấp)';
        categoryColor = 'text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200';
      } else if (bodyFatPercent <= 13) {
        category = 'Vận động viên (Athletes)';
        categoryColor = 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200';
      } else if (bodyFatPercent <= 17) {
        category = 'Thể hình cân đối (Fitness)';
        categoryColor = 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 border-blue-200';
      } else if (bodyFatPercent <= 24) {
        category = 'Trung bình chấp nhận được (Average)';
        categoryColor = 'text-slate-700 bg-slate-100 border-slate-200';
      } else {
        category = 'Thừa mỡ / Nguy cơ béo phì (Obese)';
        categoryColor = 'text-rose-600 bg-rose-50 border-rose-200';
      }
    } else {
      if (bodyFatPercent < 14) {
        category = 'Mỡ thiết yếu (Cực thấp)';
        categoryColor = 'text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200';
      } else if (bodyFatPercent <= 20) {
        category = 'Vận động viên (Athletes)';
        categoryColor = 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200';
      } else if (bodyFatPercent <= 24) {
        category = 'Thể hình cân đối (Fitness)';
        categoryColor = 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 border-blue-200';
      } else if (bodyFatPercent <= 31) {
        category = 'Trung bình chấp nhận được (Average)';
        categoryColor = 'text-slate-700 bg-slate-100 border-slate-200';
      } else {
        category = 'Thừa mỡ / Nguy cơ béo phì (Obese)';
        categoryColor = 'text-rose-600 bg-rose-50 border-rose-200';
      }
    }

    return {
      bodyFatPercent,
      fatMassKg,
      leanMassKg,
      category,
      categoryColor
    };
  }, [gender, hCm, wKg, nCm, wsCm, hpCm]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const text = `Kết quả đo tỷ lệ mỡ cơ thể (US Navy Method):
- Giới tính: ${gender === 'male' ? 'Nam' : 'Nữ'} (${age} tuổi)
- Tỷ lệ mỡ (Body Fat): ${result.bodyFatPercent}%
- Phân loại: ${result.category}
- Khối lượng mỡ: ${result.fatMassKg} kg
- Khối lượng nạc (cơ bắp, xương, nước): ${result.leanMassKg} kg`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="body-fat-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-teal-50 text-teal-600 border border-teal-100">
              <Activity className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Body Fat Calculator (Tỷ Lệ Mỡ Cơ Thể)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Đo lường tỷ lệ mỡ cơ thể theo chuẩn Hải quân Hoa Kỳ (U.S. Navy Method) dựa trên chu vi các vòng cơ thể.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Controls: Gender & Units */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider block">Giới tính</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setGender('male')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    gender === 'male' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  Nam ♂
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setGender('female')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    gender === 'female' ? 'bg-rose-500 text-white' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  Nữ ♀
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider block">Hệ đơn vị</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setUnitSystem('metric')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    unitSystem === 'metric' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  Metric (cm/kg)
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setUnitSystem('imperial')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    unitSystem === 'imperial' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  Imperial (in/lbs)
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Core Body Dimensions */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Thông số chiều cao &amp; cân nặng
            </span>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-600 block mb-1">Chiều cao ({unitSystem === 'metric' ? 'cm' : 'inches'}):</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={unitSystem === 'metric' ? heightCm : heightIn}
                  onChange={(e) => unitSystem === 'metric' ? setHeightCm(Number(e.target.value)) : setHeightIn(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-600 block mb-1">Cân nặng ({unitSystem === 'metric' ? 'kg' : 'lbs'}):</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={unitSystem === 'metric' ? weightKg : weightLbs}
                  onChange={(e) => unitSystem === 'metric' ? setWeightKg(Number(e.target.value)) : setWeightLbs(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Circumference Measurements */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Số đo chu vi vòng (thước dây sát da)
            </span>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between mb-1">
                  <span className="text-slate-700 font-semibold">1. Vòng cổ (đo ngay dưới yết hầu):</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{unitSystem === 'metric' ? `${neckCm} cm` : `${neckIn} in`}</span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step={0.5}
                  value={unitSystem === 'metric' ? neckCm : neckIn}
                  onChange={(e) => unitSystem === 'metric' ? setNeckCm(Number(e.target.value)) : setNeckIn(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between mb-1">
                  <span className="text-slate-700 font-semibold">2. Vòng eo (đo ngang rốn khi thở ra bình thường):</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{unitSystem === 'metric' ? `${waistCm} cm` : `${waistIn} in`}</span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step={0.5}
                  value={unitSystem === 'metric' ? waistCm : waistIn}
                  onChange={(e) => unitSystem === 'metric' ? setWaistCm(Number(e.target.value)) : setWaistIn(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>

              {gender === 'female' && (
                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between mb-1">
                    <span className="text-slate-700 font-semibold">3. Vòng hông (đo tại điểm rộng nhất của mông):</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{unitSystem === 'metric' ? `${hipCm} cm` : `${hipIn} in`}</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    step={0.5}
                    value={unitSystem === 'metric' ? hipCm : hipIn}
                    onChange={(e) => unitSystem === 'metric' ? setHipCm(Number(e.target.value)) : setHipIn(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Main Hero Card */}
          <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-900 via-slate-900 to-emerald-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-300">
                Tỷ Lệ Mỡ Cơ Thể (Body Fat)
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-300 border border-teal-500/30 font-medium">
                U.S. Navy Standard
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-white">
                {result.bodyFatPercent}%
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-bold ${result.categoryColor}`}>
              Đánh giá: {result.category}
            </div>

            {/* Visual Gauge Bar */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                <span>Rất thấp</span>
                <span>Vận động viên</span>
                <span>Cân đối</span>
                <span>Thừa mỡ</span>
              </div>
              <div className="h-3 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden flex">
                <div className="w-1/5 bg-amber-400" title="Essential fat" />
                <div className="w-1/4 bg-emerald-500" title="Athletes" />
                <div className="w-1/4 bg-blue-500" title="Fitness" />
                <div className="w-1/4 bg-orange-400" title="Average" />
                <div className="flex-1 bg-rose-500" title="Obese" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Mass Breakdown Cards */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1">Khối lượng mỡ (Fat Mass)</span>
              <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-rose-600 font-mono">
                {result.fatMassKg} kg
              </span>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">
                Lượng mỡ dưới da &amp; mỡ nội tạng
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1">Khối lượng nạc (Lean Mass)</span>
              <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 font-mono">
                {result.leanMassKg} kg
              </span>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">
                Cơ bắp, xương, nước &amp; nội tạng
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Reference Table */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Bảng chuẩn ACE cho {gender === 'male' ? 'Nam giới' : 'Nữ giới'}:
            </span>
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-200 text-slate-600">
              <div className="py-1.5 flex justify-between">
                <span>Mỡ thiết yếu:</span>
                <span className="font-bold font-mono text-slate-800">{gender === 'male' ? '2 - 5%' : '10 - 13%'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="py-1.5 flex justify-between">
                <span>Vận động viên:</span>
                <span className="font-bold font-mono text-emerald-600">{gender === 'male' ? '6 - 13%' : '14 - 20%'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="py-1.5 flex justify-between">
                <span>Người tập thể hình (Fitness):</span>
                <span className="font-bold font-mono text-blue-600">{gender === 'male' ? '14 - 17%' : '21 - 24%'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="py-1.5 flex justify-between">
                <span>Mức trung bình:</span>
                <span className="font-bold font-mono text-slate-800">{gender === 'male' ? '18 - 24%' : '25 - 31%'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="py-1.5 flex justify-between">
                <span>Nguy cơ béo phì:</span>
                <span className="font-bold font-mono text-rose-600">{gender === 'male' ? '25%+' : '32%+'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Flame,
  Scale,
  Check,
  Copy,
  Apple,
  Dumbbell
} from 'lucide-react';

export const CalorieCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [gender, setGender] = useState<'male' | 'female'>('male');
  const [age, setAge] = useState<number>(28);
  const [unitSystem, setUnitSystem] = useState<'metric' | 'imperial'>('metric');
  
  // Metric inputs
  const [heightCm, setHeightCm] = useState<number>(172);
  const [weightKg, setWeightKg] = useState<number>(68);

  // Imperial inputs
  const [heightFt, setHeightFt] = useState<number>(5);
  const [heightIn, setHeightIn] = useState<number>(8);
  const [weightLbs, setWeightLbs] = useState<number>(150);

  // Activity level
  const [activityLevel, setActivityLevel] = useState<number>(1.375); // Light exercise
  const formula: 'mifflin' | 'harris' = 'mifflin';
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Normalize metrics
  const { normalizedWeightKg, normalizedHeightCm } = useMemo(() => {
    if (unitSystem === 'metric') {
      return { normalizedWeightKg: weightKg, normalizedHeightCm: heightCm };
    } else {
      const kg = weightLbs * 0.45359237;
      const cm = (heightFt * 12 + heightIn) * 2.54;
      return { normalizedWeightKg: kg, normalizedHeightCm: cm };
    }
  }, [unitSystem, weightKg, heightCm, weightLbs, heightFt, heightIn]);

  // BMR & TDEE Calculations
  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    let bmr = 0;
    if (formula === 'mifflin') {
      // Mifflin-St Jeor: 10*W + 6.25*H - 5*A + S (S=+5 male, -161 female)
      const s = gender === 'male' ? 5 : -161;
      bmr = 10 * normalizedWeightKg + 6.25 * normalizedHeightCm - 5 * age + s;
    } else {
      // Harris-Benedict (Revised)
      if (gender === 'male') {
        bmr = 13.397 * normalizedWeightKg + 4.799 * normalizedHeightCm - 5.677 * age + 88.362;
      } else {
        bmr = 9.247 * normalizedWeightKg + 3.098 * normalizedHeightCm - 4.330 * age + 447.593;
      }
    }

    const tdee = Math.round(bmr * activityLevel);
    const maintainCalories = tdee;
    const mildLoss = Math.max(1000, tdee - 250); // -0.25 kg/wk
    const moderateLoss = Math.max(1000, tdee - 500); // -0.5 kg/wk
    const extremeLoss = Math.max(1000, tdee - 1000); // -1.0 kg/wk
    const mildGain = tdee + 250; // +0.25 kg/wk
    const fastGain = tdee + 500; // +0.5 kg/wk

    // Macronutrients for maintain (Protein 30%, Carb 45%, Fat 25%)
    const proteinGrams = Math.round((maintainCalories * 0.30) / 4);
    const carbGrams = Math.round((maintainCalories * 0.45) / 4);
    const fatGrams = Math.round((maintainCalories * 0.25) / 9);

    return {
      bmr: Math.round(bmr),
      tdee,
      maintainCalories,
      mildLoss,
      moderateLoss,
      extremeLoss,
      mildGain,
      fastGain,
      macros: {
        proteinGrams,
        carbGrams,
        fatGrams
      }
    };
  }, [gender, age, normalizedWeightKg, normalizedHeightCm, activityLevel, formula]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const text = `Nhu cầu Calo hàng ngày (TDEE):
- Giới tính: ${gender === 'male' ? 'Nam' : 'Nữ'}, Tuổi: ${age}
- BMR (Năng lượng trao đổi chất cơ bản): ${calculations.bmr} kcal/ngày
- TDEE (Năng lượng tiêu hao giữ cân): ${calculations.tdee} kcal/ngày
- Giảm cân nhẹ (-0.25kg/tuần): ${calculations.mildLoss} kcal/ngày
- Giảm cân chuẩn (-0.5kg/tuần): ${calculations.moderateLoss} kcal/ngày
- Tăng cân chuẩn (+0.5kg/tuần): ${calculations.fastGain} kcal/ngày
- Macro giữ cân: Protein ${calculations.macros.proteinGrams}g, Carbs ${calculations.macros.carbGrams}g, Chất béo ${calculations.macros.fatGrams}g`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="calorie-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border border-orange-100">
              <Flame className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Calorie &amp; TDEE Calculator
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Ước tính lượng calo cần nạp mỗi ngày, chỉ số BMR và kế hoạch thâm hụt/dư thừa calo để tăng, giảm hoặc giữ cân.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4">
          {/* Gender & Unit Selector */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider block">Giới tính</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setGender('male')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    gender === 'male' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  Nam ♂
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setGender('female')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    gender === 'female' ? 'bg-rose-500 text-white shadow-xs' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  Nữ ♀
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider block">Hệ đơn vị</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setUnitSystem('metric')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    unitSystem === 'metric' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-xs' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  Metric (kg/cm)
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setUnitSystem('imperial')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    unitSystem === 'imperial' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-xs' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  Imperial (lbs/ft)
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Age, Height, Weight */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3.5">
            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                <span>Tuổi: {age} tuổi</span>
              </div>
              <input
                type="range"
                min={15}
                max={90}
                value={age}
                onChange={(e) => setAge(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-orange-500 cursor-pointer"
              />
            </div>

            {unitSystem === 'metric' ? (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Chiều cao (cm):</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={100}
                    max={250}
                    value={heightCm}
                    onChange={(e) => setHeightCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold text-slate-900"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Cân nặng (kg):</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={30}
                    max={250}
                    value={weightKg}
                    onChange={(e) => setWeightKg(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold text-slate-900"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Feet (ft):</span>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      value={heightFt}
                      onChange={(e) => setHeightFt(Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Inches (in):</span>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      value={heightIn}
                      onChange={(e) => setHeightIn(Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Cân nặng (lbs):</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={weightLbs}
                    onChange={(e) => setWeightLbs(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Activity Level Selector */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-2">
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Mức độ vận động hàng ngày
            </label>
            <select
              value={activityLevel}
              onChange={(e) => setActivityLevel(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500"
            >
              <option value={1.2}>Ít vận động (làm việc văn phòng, không tập thể dục)</option>
              <option value={1.375}>Vận động nhẹ (tập luyện nhẹ 1-3 ngày/tuần)</option>
              <option value={1.55}>Vận động vừa phải (tập thể thao 3-5 ngày/tuần)</option>
              <option value={1.725}>Vận động nhiều (tập cường độ cao 6-7 ngày/tuần)</option>
              <option value={1.9}>Vận động cực nhiều (vận động viên, lao động thể lực nặng)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {/* Main TDEE Hero Banner */}
          <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-600 via-orange-600 to-rose-700 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-orange-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Flame className="w-4 h-4" /> Năng lượng giữ cân (TDEE)
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 font-medium">
                BMR: {calculations.bmr} kcal
              </span>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Circle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { AreaVisualizer } from './geometry/AreaVisualizer';

export const CircleCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState<number>(5);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const r = Math.max(0, radius);
    const diameter = 2 * r;
    const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * r;
    const area = Math.PI * r * r;

    return {
      radius: r,
      diameter: diameter.toFixed(4),
      circumference: circumference.toFixed(4),
      area: area.toFixed(4)
    };
  }, [radius]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">

          </div>

            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính đường kính d, chu vi C và diện tích A từ bán kính r</p>

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  TrendingUp,
  Copy,
  Check
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

export const CompoundInterestCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // --- Compound Interest States (Base = USD) ---
  const [initialDeposit, setInitialDeposit] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 5000;
    const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('principal') || new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('initial');
    return p && !isNaN(Number(p)) ? Number(p) : 5000; // Base $5,000 USD
  });
  const [monthlyContribution, setMonthlyContribution] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 300;
    const m = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('monthly') || new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('pmt');
    return m && !isNaN(Number(m)) ? Number(m) : 300; // Base $300 USD / month
  });

  // Adjust default numbers when user toggles between VND and international currency
  useEffect(() => {
    setInitialDeposit((prev) => {
      if (currency === 'VND' && prev < 100000) return 50000000;
      if (currency !== 'VND' && prev >= 10000000) return 5000;
      return prev;
    });
    setMonthlyContribution((prev) => {
      if (currency === 'VND' && prev < 10000) return 3000000;
      if (currency !== 'VND' && prev >= 500000) return 300;
      return prev;
    });
  }, [currency]);
  const [annualRate, setAnnualRate] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 10;
    const r = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('rate');
    return r && !isNaN(Number(r)) ? Number(r) : 10; // 10% / năm
  });
  const [years, setYears] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 10;
    const y = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('years') || new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('t');
    return y && !isNaN(Number(y)) ? Number(y) : 10; // 10 năm
  });
  const compoundFreq = 12; // 12 times a year (monthly)

  // Compound Interest Calculation
  const compoundResult = useMemo(() => {
    const P = initialDeposit;
    const PMT = monthlyContribution;
    const r = annualRate / 100;
    const n = compoundFreq;
    const t = years;

    const yearlyData: { year: number; totalDeposited: number; totalValue: number; interest: number }[] = [];

    let currentBalance = P;
    let totalDeposited = P;

    for (let yr = 1; yr <= t; yr++) {
      for (let m = 1; m <= n; m++) {
        // Add interest for 1 period
        currentBalance = currentBalance * (1 + r / n) + PMT * (12 / n);
        totalDeposited += PMT * (12 / n);
      }
      yearlyData.push({
        year: yr,
        totalDeposited: Math.round(totalDeposited),
        totalValue: Math.round(currentBalance),
        interest: Math.round(currentBalance - totalDeposited),
      });
    }

    const finalValue = yearlyData[yearlyData.length - 1]?.totalValue || P;
    const finalDeposited = yearlyData[yearlyData.length - 1]?.totalDeposited || P;
    const totalInterest = finalValue - finalDeposited;

    return {
      finalValue,
      finalDeposited,
      totalInterest,
      yearlyData,
    };
  }, [initialDeposit, monthlyContribution, annualRate, years, compoundFreq]);

  const copyText = (text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 border border-blue-500/20">
            <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Lãi Kép & Tích Lũy Tài Chính</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Dự phóng tăng trưởng tài sản với mô hình lãi kép định kỳ</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 hidden sm:inline">
            Gốc: $ USD
          </span>
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Compound Interest Layout */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8">
          
          {/* Inputs (Col 1-5) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4">
            
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  Vốn gốc ban đầu ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
                </label>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono">
                  {formatMoney(initialDeposit)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <input
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 200}
                value={initialDeposit}
                onChange={(e) => setInitialDeposit(Math.max(0, parseInt(e.target.value) || 0))}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  Gửi thêm mỗi tháng ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
                </label>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono">
                  {formatMoney(monthlyContribution)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <input
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 500000 : 50}
                value={monthlyContribution}
                onChange={(e) => setMonthlyContribution(Math.max(0, parseInt(e.target.value) || 0))}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Lãi suất (% / năm)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.5"
                  min="1"
                  max="40"
                  value={annualRate}
                  onChange={(e) => setAnnualRate(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                  className="w-full h-12 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-base font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Số năm đầu tư</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  max="50"
                  value={years}
                  onChange={(e) => setYears(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
                  className="w-full h-12 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-base font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick tenure chips */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
              {[5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30].map((y) => (
                <button
                  key={y}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setYears(y)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                    years === y ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {y} năm
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Results Card (Col 6-12) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 border border-slate-200 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-5">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  Giá Trị Tương Lai Sau {years} Năm (FV)
                </span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => copyText(`Đầu tư sau ${years} năm: Tổng tiền ${formatMoney(compoundResult.finalValue)} (Gốc nộp ${formatMoney(compoundResult.finalDeposited)}, Tiền lãi ${formatMoney(compoundResult.totalInterest)}). Tính tại Web Calculator`)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-600 font-medium hover:text-blue-800"
                >
                  {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#10B981]" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copied ? 'Đã chép' : 'Sao chép'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-2">
                <span className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-[#10B981] font-mono tracking-tight">
                  {formatMoney(compoundResult.finalValue)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Breakdown Stats */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 block">Tổng vốn đã nộp</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono mt-0.5 block">
                  {formatMoney(compoundResult.finalDeposited)}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 block">Tiền lãi kép thu về</span>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Boxes,
  Check,
  Copy
} from 'lucide-react';

export const ConcreteCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [shape, setShape] = useState<'slab' | 'column' | 'footing'>('slab');
  
  // Slab / Footing dimensions (meters)
  const [length, setLength] = useState<number>(10);
  const [width, setWidth] = useState<number>(6);
  const [thicknessCm, setThicknessCm] = useState<number>(12); // cm

  // Cylinder column dimensions
  const [diameterCm, setDiameterCm] = useState<number>(30); // cm
  const [heightM, setHeightM] = useState<number>(3.5);
  const [columnCount, setColumnCount] = useState<number>(6);

  // Waste margin
  const [wastePercent, setWastePercent] = useState<number>(10); // 10% standard

  // Concrete Grade (Mac)
  const [grade, setGrade] = useState<'M200' | 'M250' | 'M300'>('M250');

  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    let rawVolumeM3 = 0;

    if (shape === 'slab' || shape === 'footing') {
      const thicknessM = thicknessCm / 100;
      rawVolumeM3 = length * width * thicknessM;
    } else {
      // Cylinder: pi * r^2 * h * count
      const radiusM = (diameterCm / 2) / 100;
      const singleColVol = Math.PI * Math.pow(radiusM, 2) * heightM;
      rawVolumeM3 = singleColVol * columnCount;
    }

    const totalVolumeM3 = rawVolumeM3 * (1 + wastePercent / 100);

    // Material Mix per 1 m3 concrete:
    // M200: ~350kg cement (7 bags), 0.48m3 sand, 0.9m3 stone, 185L water
    // M250: ~415kg cement (8.3 bags), 0.46m3 sand, 0.88m3 stone, 195L water
    // M300: ~450kg cement (9 bags), 0.44m3 sand, 0.86m3 stone, 200L water
    const gradeRates = {
      M200: { cementKg: 350, sandM3: 0.48, stoneM3: 0.90, waterL: 185 },
      M250: { cementKg: 415, sandM3: 0.46, stoneM3: 0.88, waterL: 195 },
      M300: { cementKg: 450, sandM3: 0.44, stoneM3: 0.86, waterL: 200 },
    };

    const rates = gradeRates[grade];
    const totalCementKg = Math.round(totalVolumeM3 * rates.cementKg);
    const cementBags50kg = Math.ceil(totalCementKg / 50);
    const totalSandM3 = Number((totalVolumeM3 * rates.sandM3).toFixed(2));
    const totalStoneM3 = Number((totalVolumeM3 * rates.stoneM3).toFixed(2));
    const totalWaterL = Math.round(totalVolumeM3 * rates.waterL);

    // Ready-mix concrete trucks (Xe bồn 6m3 & 9m3)
    const trucks6m3 = Math.ceil(totalVolumeM3 / 6);

    return {
      rawVolumeM3: Number(rawVolumeM3.toFixed(2)),
      totalVolumeM3: Number(totalVolumeM3.toFixed(2)),
      cementBags50kg,
      totalCementKg,
      totalSandM3,
      totalStoneM3,
      totalWaterL,
      trucks6m3
    };
  }, [shape, length, width, thicknessCm, diameterCm, heightM, columnCount, wastePercent, grade]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const text = `Dự toán khối lượng Bê Tông (Mác ${grade}):
- Khối lượng thực tế: ${calculations.totalVolumeM3} m³ (đã cộng ${wastePercent}% hao hụt)
- Số lượng xi măng: ${calculations.cementBags50kg} bao (loại 50kg) ~ ${calculations.totalCementKg} kg
- Cát vàng: ${calculations.totalSandM3} m³
- Đá 1x2: ${calculations.totalStoneM3} m³
- Nước sạch: ${calculations.totalWaterL} lít
- Nếu gọi bê tông tươi: ~${calculations.trucks6m3} chuyến xe bồn (loại 6m³)`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="concrete-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-100">
              <Boxes className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Concrete Calculator (Dự Toán Khối Lượng Bê Tông)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính số khối bê tông m³ cho sàn, móng, cột và cấp phối vật tư xi măng, cát, đá tương ứng.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Shape Selector */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 p-1.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl w-fit">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShape('slab')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            shape === 'slab' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Đổ sàn bê tông phẳng
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShape('column')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            shape === 'column' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Cột tròn / Trụ tròn
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShape('footing')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            shape === 'footing' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Móng băng / Tường chắn
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Kích thước hình học
            </span>

            {shape !== 'column' ? (
              <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Chiều dài (mét):</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step={0.5}
                      min={0.1}
                      value={length}
                      onChange={(e) => setLength(Math.max(0.1, Number(e.target.value)))}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Chiều rộng (mét):</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step={0.5}
                      min={0.1}
                      value={width}
                      onChange={(e) => setWidth(Math.max(0.1, Number(e.target.value)))}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between font-semibold mb-1 text-slate-600">
                    <span>Độ dày sàn/móng:</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{thicknessCm} cm</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min={5}
                    max={50}
                    value={thicknessCm}
                    onChange={(e) => setThicknessCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-amber-600 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Đường kính cột (cm):</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      value={diameterCm}
                      onChange={(e) => setDiameterCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Chiều cao cột (mét):</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step={0.1}
                      value={heightM}
                      onChange={(e) => setHeightM(Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Số lượng cột:</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={1}
                    value={columnCount}
                    onChange={(e) => setColumnCount(Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Waste Factor & Mac Concrete */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-bold block mb-1 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Mác Bê Tông (Mac)
                </label>
                <select
                  value={grade}
                  onChange={(e) => setGrade(e.target.value as any)}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                >
                  <option value="M200">Mác 200 (Công trình thông thường)</option>
                  <option value="M250">Mác 250 (Nhà phố tiêu chuẩn)</option>
                  <option value="M300">Mác 300 (Chịu lực cao / Tầng hầm)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-bold block mb-1 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Hao hụt / Dự phòng
                </label>
                <select
                  value={wastePercent}
                  onChange={(e) => setWastePercent(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                >
                  <option value={5}>5% (Tay nghề chuẩn)</option>
                  <option value={10}>10% (Khuyến nghị chuẩn)</option>
                  <option value={15}>15% (Địa hình gồ ghề)</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Main Hero Volume */}
          <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-900 via-stone-900 to-slate-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300">
              Tổng thể tích bê tông cần đặt
            </span>

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-white">
                {calculations.totalVolumeM3}
              </span>
              <span className="text-lg font-semibold text-amber-200">m³ (khối)</span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 border border-white/20 text-xs flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-slate-300">Nếu đặt xe bồn thương phẩm:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-amber-300 font-mono text-sm">
                ~{calculations.trucks6m3} xe bồn (6m³)
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Material breakdown */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Dự toán cấp phối vật liệu rời (Mác {grade})
            </span>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[11px]">Xi măng (bao 50kg)</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 font-mono">
                  {calculations.cementBags50kg} bao
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">~{calculations.totalCementKg.toLocaleString()} kg</span>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[11px]">Cát vàng</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-black text-amber-600 font-mono">
                  {calculations.totalSandM3} m³
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">Cát bê tông rửa sạch</span>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[11px]">Đá 1x2</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-black text-blue-600 font-mono">
                  {calculations.totalStoneM3} m³
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">Đá sàng tiêu chuẩn</span>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[11px]">Nước sạch</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-black text-cyan-600 font-mono">
                  {calculations.totalWaterL.toLocaleString()} lít
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">Nước ngọt sinh hoạt</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Coins,
  RotateCcw,
  ArrowRightLeft,
  TrendingUp,
  Globe
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

interface CurrencyRateData {
  name: string;
  nameEn: string;
  symbol: string;
  rate: number; // units per 1 USD
  flag: string;
}

const RATES_TO_USD: Record<string, CurrencyRateData> = {
  USD: { name: 'Đô la Mỹ', nameEn: 'US Dollar', symbol: '$', rate: 1, flag: '🇺🇸' },
  EUR: { name: 'Đồng Euro', nameEn: 'Euro', symbol: '€', rate: 0.92, flag: '🇪🇺' },
  GBP: { name: 'Bảng Anh', nameEn: 'British Pound', symbol: '£', rate: 0.79, flag: '🇬🇧' },
  JPY: { name: 'Yên Nhật', nameEn: 'Japanese Yen', symbol: '¥', rate: 155.4, flag: '🇯🇵' },
  CAD: { name: 'Đô la Canada', nameEn: 'Canadian Dollar', symbol: 'C$', rate: 1.37, flag: '🇨🇦' },
  AUD: { name: 'Đô la Úc', nameEn: 'Australian Dollar', symbol: 'A$', rate: 1.52, flag: '🇦🇺' },
  CHF: { name: 'Franc Thụy Sĩ', nameEn: 'Swiss Franc', symbol: 'CHF', rate: 0.91, flag: '🇨🇭' },
  CNY: { name: 'Nhân dân tệ', nameEn: 'Chinese Yuan', symbol: '¥', rate: 7.24, flag: '🇨🇳' },
  SGD: { name: 'Đô la Singapore', nameEn: 'Singapore Dollar', symbol: 'S$', rate: 1.35, flag: '🇸🇬' },
  KRW: { name: 'Won Hàn Quốc', nameEn: 'South Korean Won', symbol: '₩', rate: 1380, flag: '🇰🇷' },
  VND: { name: 'Việt Nam Đồng', nameEn: 'Vietnamese Dong', symbol: '₫', rate: 25450, flag: '🇻🇳' },
  THB: { name: 'Baht Thái', nameEn: 'Thai Baht', symbol: '฿', rate: 36.8, flag: '🇹🇭' },
  INR: { name: 'Rupee Ấn Độ', nameEn: 'Indian Rupee', symbol: '₹', rate: 83.5, flag: '🇮🇳' },
  HKD: { name: 'Đô la Hồng Kông', nameEn: 'Hong Kong Dollar', symbol: 'HK$', rate: 7.82, flag: '🇭🇰' },
  BRL: { name: 'Real Brazil', nameEn: 'Brazilian Real', symbol: 'R$', rate: 5.45, flag: '🇧🇷' },
  MXN: { name: 'Peso Mexico', nameEn: 'Mexican Peso', symbol: 'Mex$', rate: 18.2, flag: '🇲🇽' }
};

export const CurrencyConverter: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency } = useCurrency();

  const [amount, setAmount] = useState<number>(100);
  const [fromCurr, setFromCurr] = useState<string>('USD');
  const [toCurr, setToCurr] = useState<string>(() => {
    return currency !== 'USD' && RATES_TO_USD[currency] ? currency : 'EUR';
  });

  // Keep target currency in sync if user changes global currency
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency !== fromCurr && RATES_TO_USD[currency]) {
      setToCurr(currency);
    }
  }, [currency, fromCurr]);

  const converted = useMemo(() => {
    const fromRate = RATES_TO_USD[fromCurr]?.rate || 1;
    const toRate = RATES_TO_USD[toCurr]?.rate || 1;

    // Convert fromCurr to USD base, then USD to toCurr
    const inUSD = amount / fromRate;
    return inUSD * toRate;
  }, [amount, fromCurr, toCurr]);

  const exchangeRateInfo = useMemo(() => {
    const fromRate = RATES_TO_USD[fromCurr]?.rate || 1;
    const toRate = RATES_TO_USD[toCurr]?.rate || 1;
    const rate1Unit = (1 / fromRate) * toRate;
    const reverseRate = (1 / toRate) * fromRate;
    return { rate1Unit, reverseRate };
  }, [fromCurr, toCurr]);

  const allConverted = useMemo(() => {
    const fromRate = RATES_TO_USD[fromCurr]?.rate || 1;
    const inUSD = amount / fromRate;
    return Object.entries(RATES_TO_USD).map(([code, data]) => ({
      code,
      name: data.name,
      symbol: data.symbol,
      flag: data.flag,
      rate: data.rate,
      val: inUSD * data.rate
    }));
  }, [amount, fromCurr]);

  const handleSwap = () => {
    const temp = fromCurr;
    setFromCurr(toCurr);
    setToCurr(temp);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setAmount(100);
    setFromCurr('USD');
    setToCurr(currency !== 'USD' && RATES_TO_USD[currency] ? currency : 'EUR');
  };

  const formatNumberWithDecimals = (val: number, maxDecimals = 2) => {
    if (val >= 1000) {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: maxDecimals }).format(val);
    }
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 4 }).format(val);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Coins className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Currency Converter – Chuyển Đổi Ngoại Tệ Quốc Tế</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tỷ giá tham chiếu chuẩn quốc tế (USD Base) giữa hơn 16 đồng tiền phổ biến toàn cầu</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="curr-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-7 gap-3 items-center">
          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Số tiền chuyển đổi</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-bold">{RATES_TO_USD[fromCurr]?.symbol}</span>
              <input
                id="curr-val-input"
                type="number"
                value={amount}
                onChange={(e) => setAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans text-lg font-semibold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <select
              id="curr-from-select"
              value={fromCurr}
              onChange={(e) => setFromCurr(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              {Object.entries(RATES_TO_USD).map(([code, item]) => (
                <option key={code} value={code}>
                  {item.flag} {code} - {item.name} ({item.symbol})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-1 flex justify-center">
            <button
              id="curr-swap-btn"
              onClick={handleSwap}
              className="p-3 rounded-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-500 text-blue-400 hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
              title="Đảo chiều ngoại tệ"
            >
              <ArrowRightLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Quy đổi tương đương</label>
            <div className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-emerald-400 font-bold font-sans text-xl tabular-nums truncate flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{formatNumberWithDecimals(converted, toCurr === 'VND' || toCurr === 'JPY' || toCurr === 'KRW' ? 0 : 2)}</span>
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-300">{RATES_TO_USD[toCurr]?.symbol} {toCurr}</span>
            </div>
            <select
              id="curr-to-select"
              value={toCurr}
              onChange={(e) => setToCurr(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              {Object.entries(RATES_TO_USD).map(([code, item]) => (
                <option key={code} value={code}>
                  {item.flag} {code} - {item.name} ({item.symbol})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Live exchange rate display */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-slate-800/50 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-300 gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            <span>
              1 {fromCurr} = <strong className="text-white font-sans">{formatNumberWithDecimals(exchangeRateInfo.rate1Unit, 4)} {toCurr}</strong>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-slate-400">
            1 {toCurr} = <strong className="text-slate-200 font-sans">{formatNumberWithDecimals(exchangeRateInfo.reverseRate, 4)} {fromCurr}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Global Multi-Currency Grid */}
        <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
              Bảng quy đổi tương đương các đồng tiền chính toàn cầu
            </h3>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Gốc: {amount.toLocaleString()} {fromCurr}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
            {allConverted.map((item) => (
              <button
                key={item.code}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setToCurr(item.code)}
                className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  toCurr === item.code
                    ? 'bg-blue-950/50 border-blue-500/50 ring-1 ring-blue-400/30'
                    : 'bg-slate-800/40 hover:bg-slate-800/80 border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Check,
  Copy,
  Plus,
  Minus,
  CalendarDays,
  Clock,
  Briefcase
} from 'lucide-react';

export const DateCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'difference' | 'add_subtract'>('difference');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Mode 1: Difference
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState<string>(todayStr);
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState<string>(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + 45);
    return d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  });
  const [includeEndDate, setIncludeEndDate] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Mode 2: Add/Subtract
  const [baseDate, setBaseDate] = useState<string>(todayStr);
  const [op, setOp] = useState<'add' | 'subtract'>('add');
  const [addYears, setAddYears] = useState<number>(0);
  const [addMonths, setAddMonths] = useState<number>(1);
  const [addWeeks, setAddWeeks] = useState<number>(0);
  const [addDays, setAddDays] = useState<number>(15);

  // Calculation for Difference
  const diffResult = useMemo(() => {
    const start = new Date(startDate);
    const end = new Date(endDate);

    if (isNaN(start.getTime()) || isNaN(end.getTime())) {
      return null;
    }

    let diffMs = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
    const isReversed = diffMs < 0;
    if (isReversed) diffMs = Math.abs(diffMs);

    let totalDays = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    if (includeEndDate && !isReversed) totalDays += 1;

    const weeks = Math.floor(totalDays / 7);
    const remainingDays = totalDays % 7;

    // Working days (business days excluding Saturday & Sunday)
    let businessDays = 0;
    const cur = new Date(isReversed ? end : start);
    const target = new Date(isReversed ? start : end);
    while (cur < target) {
      const dayOfWeek = cur.getDay();
      if (dayOfWeek !== 0 && dayOfWeek !== 6) {
        businessDays++;
      }
      cur.setDate(cur.getDate() + 1);
    }
    if (includeEndDate) {
      const endDayOfWeek = target.getDay();
      if (endDayOfWeek !== 0 && endDayOfWeek !== 6) businessDays++;
    }

    const hours = totalDays * 24;
    const minutes = hours * 60;

    return {
      totalDays,
      weeks,
      remainingDays,
      businessDays,
      hours,
      minutes,
      isReversed
    };
  }, [startDate, endDate, includeEndDate]);

  // Calculation for Add/Subtract
  const calcDateResult = useMemo(() => {
    const d = new Date(baseDate);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;

    const sign = op === 'add' ? 1 : -1;
    d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() + sign * addYears);
    d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + sign * addMonths);
    const daysOffset = (addWeeks * 7 + addDays) * sign;
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + daysOffset);

    const dayOfWeekNames = ['Chủ Nhật', 'Thứ Hai', 'Thứ Ba', 'Thứ Tư', 'Thứ Năm', 'Thứ Sáu', 'Thứ Bảy'];
    const dayOfWeek = dayOfWeekNames[d.getDay()];
    const formatted = d.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric'
    });

    return {
      dateObj: d,
      dayOfWeek,
      formatted,
      iso: d.toISOString().split('T')[0]
    };
  }, [baseDate, op, addYears, addMonths, addWeeks, addDays]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    let text = '';
    if (tab === 'difference' && diffResult) {
      text = `Khoảng cách giữa ${startDate} và ${endDate}:
- Tổng số ngày: ${diffResult.totalDays} ngày
- Quy đổi: ${diffResult.weeks} tuần và ${diffResult.remainingDays} ngày
- Số ngày làm việc (không tính T7, CN): ${diffResult.businessDays} ngày`;
    } else if (tab === 'add_subtract' && calcDateResult) {
      text = `Kết quả tính ngày: ${baseDate} ${op === 'add' ? '+' : '-'} (${addYears} năm, ${addMonths} tháng, ${addDays} ngày) = ${calcDateResult.formatted} (${calcDateResult.dayOfWeek})`;
    }
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="date-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 border border-rose-100">
              <CalendarDays className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Date Calculator (Tính Số Ngày)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính khoảng cách số ngày, tuần, tháng giữa 2 mốc thời gian và cộng/trừ ngày tháng năm chính xác.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 p-1.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl w-fit">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setTab('difference')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            tab === 'difference' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          Đếm số ngày giữa 2 ngày
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setTab('add_subtract')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            tab === 'add_subtract' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          Cộng / Trừ ngày tháng
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Mode 1: Difference */}
      {tab === 'difference' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Chọn mốc ngày bắt đầu và kết thúc
            </h3>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Ngày bắt đầu:</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={startDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setStartDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Ngày kết thúc:</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={endDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none text-slate-700 font-medium">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={includeEndDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setIncludeEndDate(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-rose-600 focus:ring-rose-500 accent-rose-600"
                  />
                  <span>Bao gồm cả ngày kết thúc (+1 ngày)</span>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
            {diffResult && (
              <>
                <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-rose-900 via-slate-900 to-pink-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-300">
                    Tổng số ngày cách biệt
                  </span>

                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                    <span className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-white">
                      {diffResult.totalDays.toLocaleString()}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-rose-200">ngày</span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-rose-200 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800">
                    Tương đương: <strong className="text-white">{diffResult.weeks} tuần</strong> và <strong className="text-white">{diffResult.remainingDays} ngày</strong>.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Briefcase className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" /> Ngày làm việc (T2-T6)

                    <span className="text-2xl font-black text-blue-600 font-mono">
