import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Tag,
  Check,
  Copy
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

export const DiscountCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  // Base price in current currency (Base = $100 USD)
  const [originalPrice, setOriginalPrice] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 500000 : 100;
  });
  const [discountPercent, setDiscountPercent] = useState<number>(30);
  const [extraDiscountPercent, setExtraDiscountPercent] = useState<number>(10);
  const [enableExtraDiscount, setEnableExtraDiscount] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const taxPercent = 0;
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Sync default price when switching between VND and international
  useEffect(() => {
    setOriginalPrice((prev) => {
      if (currency === 'VND' && prev < 1000) return 500000;
      if (currency !== 'VND' && prev >= 10000) return 100;
      return prev;
    });
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    // 1. First discount
    const firstDiscountAmount = (originalPrice * discountPercent) / 100;
    const priceAfterFirst = originalPrice - firstDiscountAmount;

    // 2. Extra discount (stacked on discounted price)
    let extraDiscountAmount = 0;
    if (enableExtraDiscount) {
      extraDiscountAmount = (priceAfterFirst * extraDiscountPercent) / 100;
    }
    const priceAfterDiscounts = priceAfterFirst - extraDiscountAmount;

    // 3. Tax / VAT
    const taxAmount = (priceAfterDiscounts * taxPercent) / 100;
    const finalPrice = Math.round(priceAfterDiscounts + taxAmount);

    const totalSavings = Math.round(originalPrice - priceAfterDiscounts);
    const effectiveDiscountPercent = originalPrice > 0 
      ? Number(((totalSavings / originalPrice) * 100).toFixed(1)) 
      : 0;

    return {
      firstDiscountAmount: Math.round(firstDiscountAmount),
      extraDiscountAmount: Math.round(extraDiscountAmount),
      taxAmount: Math.round(taxAmount),
      finalPrice,
      totalSavings,
      effectiveDiscountPercent
    };
  }, [originalPrice, discountPercent, extraDiscountPercent, enableExtraDiscount, taxPercent]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const text = `Tính giá khuyến mãi:
- Giá gốc: ${formatMoney(originalPrice)}
- Mức giảm giá: ${discountPercent}% ${enableExtraDiscount ? `+ giảm thêm ${extraDiscountPercent}%` : ''}
- Số tiền tiết kiệm: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalSavings)} (giảm ${calculations.effectiveDiscountPercent}%)
- Giá thực tế phải trả: ${formatMoney(calculations.finalPrice)}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const pricePresets = useMemo(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      return [
        { label: '100k', val: 100000 },
        { label: '250k', val: 250000 },
        { label: '500k', val: 500000 },
        { label: '1 Triệu', val: 1000000 },
        { label: '2 Triệu', val: 2000000 },
      ];
    }
    return [
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}25`, val: 25 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}50`, val: 50 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}100`, val: 100 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}250`, val: 250 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}500`, val: 500 },
    ];
  }, [currency, currencyInfo.symbol]);

  return (
    <div id="discount-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-pink-50 text-pink-600 border border-pink-100">
              <Tag className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Discount Calculator (Tính Giảm Giá)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính toán giá sau giảm, chiết khấu kép (mã voucher thêm) và số tiền thực tế bạn tiết kiệm được.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            onClick={handleCopy}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
            <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* 1. Original Price */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Giá niêm yết ban đầu ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
              </label>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-pink-600 font-mono">
                {formatMoney(originalPrice)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-4 top-3 text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 10000 : 5}
                value={originalPrice}
                onChange={(e) => setOriginalPrice(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value)))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-2xl text-lg font-black text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-4 top-3 text-slate-400 font-bold text-xs">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pt-1">
              {pricePresets.map((p) => (
                <button
                  key={p.val}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOriginalPrice(p.val)}
                  className={`text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    originalPrice === p.val
                      ? 'bg-pink-600 text-white border-pink-600'
                      : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {p.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 2. Primary Discount Percent */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Mức giảm giá chính
              </label>
              <span className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 font-mono">
                {discountPercent}%
              </span>
            </div>

            <input
              type="range"
              min={0}
              max={99}
              step={1}
              value={discountPercent}
              onChange={(e) => setDiscountPercent(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full accent-pink-600 cursor-pointer"
            />

            <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1.5 pt-1">
              {[10, 20, 30, 50, 70].map(p => (
                <button
                  key={p}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setDiscountPercent(p)}
                  className={`py-1.5 text-xs rounded-xl font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    discountPercent === p ? 'bg-pink-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {p}%
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 3. Extra Voucher Stack */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer select-none">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Áp dụng thêm mã giảm giá thứ 2 (Voucher / Thẻ thành viên)
              </span>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={enableExtraDiscount}
                onChange={(e) => setEnableExtraDiscount(e.target.checked)}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-pink-600 accent-pink-600 cursor-pointer"
              />
            </label>

            {enableExtraDiscount && (
              <div className="space-y-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Giảm thêm:</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-purple-600 font-mono">{extraDiscountPercent}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                  {[5, 10, 15, 20].map(p => (
                    <button
                      key={p}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setExtraDiscountPercent(p)}
                      className={`py-1.5 text-xs rounded-xl font-bold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                        extraDiscountPercent === p ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {p}%
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Main Price Card */}
          <div className="hero-result-card bg-gradient-to-br from-pink-900 via-slate-900 to-rose-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-pink-300">
                Giá thực tế phải trả (Final Price)
              </span>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-pink-500/20 text-pink-300 border border-pink-500/30">
                Tiết kiệm {calculations.effectiveDiscountPercent}%
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-white">
                {formatMoney(calculations.finalPrice)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 border border-white/20 text-xs flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-slate-300">Số tiền bạn tiết kiệm được:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400 text-sm font-mono">
                {formatMoney(calculations.totalSavings)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Breakdown stats */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Chi tiết các khoản giảm
            </span>

            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-600">Giá niêm yết ban đầu:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono">{formatMoney(originalPrice)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-600">Giảm đợt 1 ({discountPercent}%):</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-pink-600 font-mono">-{formatMoney(calculations.firstDiscountAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              {enableExtraDiscount && (
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                  <span className="text-slate-600">Voucher bổ sung ({extraDiscountPercent}%):</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-purple-600 font-mono">-{formatMoney(calculations.extraDiscountAmount)}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Superscript, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const ExponentCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [base, setBase] = useState<number>(2);
  const [exponent, setExponent] = useState<number>(8);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const b = base;
    const exp = exponent;

    let result = 0;
    let isUndefined = false;

    if (b === 0 && exp <= 0) {
      isUndefined = true;
    } else {
      result = Math.pow(b, exp);
    }

    return {
      isUndefined,
      result,
      scientific: result.toExponential(4)
    };
  }, [base, exponent]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Superscript className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Exponent Calculator – Máy Tính Lũy Thừa</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính giá trị lũy thừa x^y với số mũ nguyên dương, nguyên âm hoặc số thập phân</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="exponent-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setBase(2); setExponent(8); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Nhập cơ số & số mũ</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cơ số (Base x)</label>
            <input
              id="exp-base"
              type="number"
              value={base}
              onChange={(e) => setBase(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Số mũ (Exponent y)</label>
            <input
              id="exp-exponent"
              type="number"
              value={exponent}
              onChange={(e) => setExponent(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {calculations.isUndefined ? (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200 text-sm">
              Không xác định (0^0 hoặc 0 với số mũ âm không có nghĩa trong toán học).
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">
                {base} ^ {exponent}
              </span>
              <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums break-all">
                {Math.abs(calculations.result) > 1e12 || (Math.abs(calculations.result) < 1e-4 && calculations.result !== 0)
                  ? calculations.scientific
                  : calculations.result.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Ký hiệu khoa học (Scientific): <span className="text-white font-mono">{calculations.scientific}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

>>> TỆP TIN: /src/components/tools/FinanceCalculator.tsx  (300 dòng)

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Sliders, DollarSign, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

type SolveTarget = 'fv' | 'pv' | 'pmt' | 'n' | 'rate';

export const FinanceCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [solveFor, setSolveFor] = useState<SolveTarget>('fv');
  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<number>(60); // N
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState<number>(6.0); // I/Y (%)
  const [presentValue, setPresentValue] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? -250000000 : -10000;
  }); // PV
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? -5000000 : -200;
  }); // PMT
  const [futureValue, setFutureValue] = useState<number>(0); // FV
  const [timing, setTiming] = useState<'end' | 'beginning'>('end');

  // Synchronize defaults on currency switch
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      setPresentValue((prev) => (Math.abs(prev) < 100000 ? -250000000 : prev));
      setPayment((prev) => (Math.abs(prev) < 5000 ? -5000000 : prev));
    } else {
      setPresentValue((prev) => (Math.abs(prev) >= 1000000 ? -10000 : prev));
      setPayment((prev) => (Math.abs(prev) >= 50000 ? -200 : prev));
    }
  }, [currency]);

  // Compute solved value
  const solvedResult = React.useMemo(() => {
    const r = (interestRate / 100) / 12; // monthly rate
    const n = periods;
    const pv = presentValue;
    const pmt = payment;
    const type = timing === 'beginning' ? 1 : 0;

    try {
      if (solveFor === 'fv') {
        if (r === 0) {
          return -(pv + pmt * n);
        }
        const fv = - (pv * Math.pow(1 + r, n) + pmt * (1 + r * type) * ((Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1) / r));
        return fv;
      } else if (solveFor === 'pv') {
        if (r === 0) {
          return -(futureValue + pmt * n);
        }
        const pvCalc = - (futureValue + pmt * (1 + r * type) * ((Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1) / r)) / Math.pow(1 + r, n);
        return pvCalc;
      } else if (solveFor === 'pmt') {
        if (r === 0) {
          return -(futureValue + pv) / n;
        }
        const pmtCalc = - (futureValue + pv * Math.pow(1 + r, n)) / ((1 + r * type) * ((Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1) / r));
        return pmtCalc;
      } else if (solveFor === 'n') {
        if (r === 0) {
          return -(futureValue + pv) / pmt;
        }
        const num = (futureValue * r - pmt * (1 + r * type)) / (-pv * r - pmt * (1 + r * type));
        if (num <= 0) return 0;
        return Math.log(num) / Math.log(1 + r);
      } else if (solveFor === 'rate') {
        // Newton-Raphson approximation for rate
        let guess = 0.05 / 12;
        for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
          const f = pv * Math.pow(1 + guess, n) + pmt * (1 + guess * type) * ((Math.pow(1 + guess, n) - 1) / guess) + futureValue;
          const df = n * pv * Math.pow(1 + guess, n - 1) + pmt * ((Math.pow(1 + guess, n) - 1) / guess);
          const nextGuess = guess - f / (df || 1);
          if (Math.abs(nextGuess - guess) < 1e-6) {
            guess = nextGuess;
            break;
          }
          guess = nextGuess;
        }
        return guess * 12 * 100;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      return 0;
    }
    return 0;
  }, [solveFor, periods, interestRate, presentValue, payment, futureValue, timing]);

  const formatNumber = (num: number, decimals = 2) => {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: decimals }).format(num);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setPeriods(60);
    setInterestRate(6.0);
    setPresentValue(currency === 'VND' ? -250000000 : -10000);
    setPayment(currency === 'VND' ? -5000000 : -200);
    setFutureValue(0);
    setTiming('end');
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="tool-header-banner p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="banner-icon-box p-3 bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30">
            <Sliders className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Finance Calculator – Máy Tính Tài Chính Tổng Hợp (TVM)</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Giải phương trình Giá trị thời gian của tiền tệ (Time Value of Money: PV, FV, PMT, N, Rate)</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="finance-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Target selector buttons */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-2">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider block">Chọn đại lượng bạn cần tìm:</span>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
          {[
            { id: 'fv', label: 'Tương lai (FV)', desc: 'Future Value' },
            { id: 'pv', label: 'Hiện tại (PV)', desc: 'Present Value' },
            { id: 'pmt', label: 'Kỳ trả (PMT)', desc: 'Payment' },
            { id: 'n', label: 'Số kỳ (N)', desc: 'Number of periods' },
            { id: 'rate', label: 'Lãi suất (I/Y)', desc: 'Interest rate' },
          ].map((item) => (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              id={`solve-for-${item.id}`}
              onClick={() => setSolveFor(item.id as SolveTarget)}
              className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                solveFor === item.id
                  ? 'bg-blue-600 border-blue-400 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30 ring-1 ring-blue-300'
                  : 'bg-slate-800/80 border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              <span className="block font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">{item.label}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] opacity-75">{item.desc}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Form Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            Nhập các thông số đã biết ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
          </h2>

          {solveFor !== 'n' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Số kỳ hạn (N - Tháng/Kỳ)</label>
              <input
                id="tvm-n"
                type="number"
                value={periods}
                onChange={(e) => setPeriods(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {solveFor !== 'rate' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Lãi suất hàng năm (I/Y - %/năm)</label>
              <input
                id="tvm-rate"
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                value={interestRate}
                onChange={(e) => setInterestRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {solveFor !== 'pv' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Giá trị hiện tại (PV - âm nếu là tiền đầu tư/gửi ra) ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="tvm-pv"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 100}
                value={presentValue}
                onChange={(e) => setPresentValue(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {solveFor !== 'pmt' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Thanh toán định kỳ mỗi tháng (PMT) ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="tvm-pmt"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 500000 : 25}
                value={payment}
                onChange={(e) => setPayment(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {solveFor !== 'fv' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Giá trị tương lai (FV) ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="tvm-fv"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 100}
                value={futureValue}
                onChange={(e) => setFutureValue(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Thời điểm trả lãi/gửi tiền</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                id="timing-end"
                onClick={() => setTiming('end')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  timing === 'end' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 font-bold' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Cuối kỳ (End / Ordinary)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="timing-beginning"
                onClick={() => setTiming('beginning')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  timing === 'beginning' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 font-bold' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Đầu kỳ (Beginning / Due)
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Result */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="tool-hero-banner p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-950/30 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
              KẾT QUẢ ĐẠI LƯỢNG {solveFor.toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <div className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {solveFor === 'rate' 
                ? `${formatNumber(solvedResult, 2)}% /năm`
                : solveFor === 'n'
                ? `${formatNumber(solvedResult, 1)} kỳ`
                : formatMoney(Math.abs(solvedResult))}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              {solveFor === 'fv' && 'Giá trị tài sản tích lũy được trong tương lai sau thời hạn N.'}
              {solveFor === 'pv' && 'Giá trị quy đổi về thời điểm hiện tại của dòng tiền tương lai.'}
              {solveFor === 'pmt' && 'Khoản thanh toán cố định cần trả hoặc gửi định kỳ mỗi tháng.'}
              {solveFor === 'n' && 'Thời gian (số tháng) cần thiết để đạt mục tiêu tài chính.'}
              {solveFor === 'rate' && 'Tỷ suất lợi nhuận nội bộ hàng năm tương ứng.'}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-2">
            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">Quy ước dấu dòng tiền (+ / -):</div>
            <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-slate-400">
              <li>Dấu âm (-): Tiền bạn bỏ ra (chi tiền, nạp tiền gửi tiết kiệm, đầu tư).</li>
              <li>Dấu dương (+): Tiền bạn thu về (nhận lại tiền, vay được tiền).</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Divide,
  RotateCcw,
  Plus,
  Minus,
  X
} from 'lucide-react';

export const FractionCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [num1, setNum1] = useState<number>(3);
  const [den1, setDen1] = useState<number>(4);
  const [num2, setNum2] = useState<number>(2);
  const [den2, setDen2] = useState<number>(5);
  const [operation, setOperation] = useState<'+' | '-' | '*' | '/'>('+');

  const gcd = (a: number, b: number): number => {
    return b === 0 ? Math.abs(a) : gcd(b, a % b);
  };

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const d1 = den1 === 0 ? 1 : den1;
    const d2 = den2 === 0 ? 1 : den2;
    const n1 = num1;
    const n2 = num2;

    let resNum = 0;
    let resDen = 1;
    let steps: string[] = [];

    if (operation === '+') {
      resNum = n1 * d2 + n2 * d1;
      resDen = d1 * d2;
      steps = [
        `Quy đồng mẫu số: ${n1}/${d1} = (${n1} × ${d2}) / (${d1} × ${d2}) = ${n1 * d2}/${d1 * d2}`,
        `Quy đồng mẫu số: ${n2}/${d2} = (${n2} × ${d1}) / (${d2} × ${d1}) = ${n2 * d1}/${d1 * d2}`,
        `Cộng tử số: (${n1 * d2} + ${n2 * d1}) / ${d1 * d2} = ${resNum}/${resDen}`
      ];
    } else if (operation === '-') {
      resNum = n1 * d2 - n2 * d1;
      resDen = d1 * d2;
      steps = [
        `Quy đồng mẫu số: ${n1}/${d1} = (${n1} × ${d2}) / (${d1} × ${d2}) = ${n1 * d2}/${d1 * d2}`,
        `Quy đồng mẫu số: ${n2}/${d2} = (${n2} × ${d1}) / (${d2} × ${d1}) = ${n2 * d1}/${d1 * d2}`,
        `Trừ tử số: (${n1 * d2} - ${n2 * d1}) / ${d1 * d2} = ${resNum}/${resDen}`
      ];
    } else if (operation === '*') {
      resNum = n1 * n2;
      resDen = d1 * d2;
      steps = [
        `Nhân tử với tử: ${n1} × ${n2} = ${resNum}`,
        `Nhân mẫu với mẫu: ${d1} × ${d2} = ${resDen}`,
        `Phân số kết quả: ${resNum}/${resDen}`
      ];
    } else if (operation === '/') {
      resNum = n1 * d2;
      resDen = d1 * n2;
      steps = [
        `Đảo ngược phân số thứ hai: ${d2}/${n2}`,
        `Nhân với phân số nghịch đảo: (${n1} × ${d2}) / (${d1} × ${n2}) = ${resNum}/${resDen}`
      ];
    }

    // Simplification
    const common = gcd(resNum, resDen);
    let simpNum = resNum / (common || 1);
    let simpDen = resDen / (common || 1);

    if (simpDen < 0) {
      simpNum = -simpNum;
      simpDen = -simpDen;
    }

    // Mixed number
    const whole = Math.floor(Math.abs(simpNum) / simpDen);
    const remainder = Math.abs(simpNum) % simpDen;
    const isNegative = simpNum < 0;

    return {
      rawNum: resNum,
      rawDen: resDen,
      simpNum,
      simpDen,
      decimal: resDen !== 0 ? resNum / resDen : 0,
      whole,
      remainder,
      isNegative,
      steps
    };
  }, [num1, den1, num2, den2, operation]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Divide className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Fraction Calculator – Máy Tính Phân Số</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Cộng, trừ, nhân, chia phân số với các bước rút gọn tối giản và đổi sang hỗn số</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="fraction-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setNum1(3); setDen1(4); setNum2(2); setDen2(5); setOperation('+'); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Main Interactive Expression Box */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-4 sm:gap-6">
        {/* Fraction 1 */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center w-24">
          <input
            id="fraction-num1"
            type="number"
            value={num1}
            onChange={(e) => setNum1(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full text-center py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-white font-bold text-lg font-sans outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
          />
          <div className="w-full h-0.5 bg-slate-500 my-1.5 rounded" />
          <input
            id="fraction-den1"
            type="number"
            value={den1}
            onChange={(e) => setDen1(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full text-center py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-white font-bold text-lg font-sans outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Operators */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 bg-slate-800 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
            <button
              type="button"
              id="op-add"
              onClick={() => setOperation('+')}
              className={`p-2 rounded-lg transition-all ${operation === '+' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'}`}
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              id="op-sub"
              onClick={() => setOperation('-')}
              className={`p-2 rounded-lg transition-all ${operation === '-' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'}`}
            >
              <Minus className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              id="op-mul"
              onClick={() => setOperation('*')}
              className={`p-2 rounded-lg transition-all ${operation === '*' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'}`}
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              id="op-div"
              onClick={() => setOperation('/')}
              className={`p-2 rounded-lg transition-all ${operation === '/' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'}`}
            >
              <Divide className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Fraction 2 */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center w-24">
          <input
            id="fraction-num2"
            type="number"
            value={num2}
            onChange={(e) => setNum2(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full text-center py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-white font-bold text-lg font-sans outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
          />
          <div className="w-full h-0.5 bg-slate-500 my-1.5 rounded" />
          <input
            id="fraction-den2"
            type="number"
            value={den2}
            onChange={(e) => setDen2(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full text-center py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-white font-bold text-lg font-sans outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
          />
        </div>

        <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-400">=</span>

        {/* Result Fraction */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-slate-800/80 p-4 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/50">
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center min-w-16">
            <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{calculations.simpNum}</span>
            {calculations.simpDen !== 1 && (
              <>
                <div className="w-full h-0.5 bg-blue-400 my-1 rounded" />
                <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{calculations.simpDen}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          {calculations.whole > 0 && calculations.remainder > 0 && (
            <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 border-l border-slate-700 pl-3">
              <span>Hỗn số: </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-white font-sans">
                {calculations.isNegative ? '-' : ''}{calculations.whole} {calculations.remainder}/{calculations.simpDen}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Steps breakdown */}
      <div className="p-5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
        <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">Các bước giải thích chi tiết</h2>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {calculations.steps.map((step, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-700/60 text-xs text-slate-200 font-mono">
              Bước {idx + 1}: {step}
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-950/30 border border-blue-500/30 text-xs text-blue-200">
            Giá trị số thập phân tương đương: <span className="font-bold font-sans">{calculations.decimal.toFixed(6)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  GraduationCap,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Check,
  Copy
} from 'lucide-react';

interface CourseRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  grade: string;
  credits: number;
}

const GRADE_MAP_4: Record<string, number> = {
  'A+': 4.0,
  'A': 4.0,
  'A-': 3.7,
  'B+': 3.5,
  'B': 3.0,
  'B-': 2.7,
  'C+': 2.5,
  'C': 2.0,
  'C-': 1.7,
  'D+': 1.5,
  'D': 1.0,
  'F': 0.0,
};

const GRADE_MAP_10: Record<string, number> = {
  'A+': 9.5,
  'A': 8.8,
  'A-': 8.2,
  'B+': 7.8,
  'B': 7.2,
  'B-': 6.7,
  'C+': 6.2,
  'C': 5.7,
  'C-': 5.2,
  'D+': 4.5,
  'D': 4.0,
  'F': 2.0,
};

export const GpaCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [courses, setCourses] = useState<CourseRow[]>([
    { id: '1', name: 'Toán cao cấp', grade: 'A', credits: 4 },
    { id: '2', name: 'Lập trình căn bản', grade: 'A+', credits: 3 },
    { id: '3', name: 'Xác suất thống kê', grade: 'B+', credits: 3 },
    { id: '4', name: 'Tiếng Anh chuyên ngành', grade: 'A-', credits: 2 },
    { id: '5', name: 'Kinh tế vi mô', grade: 'B', credits: 3 },
  ]);

  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const addCourse = () => {
    const newCourse: CourseRow = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `Môn học ${courses.length + 1}`,
      grade: 'B+',
      credits: 3
    };
    setCourses([...courses, newCourse]);
  };

  const removeCourse = (id: string) => {
    if (courses.length <= 1) return;
    setCourses(courses.filter(c => c.id !== id));
  };

  const updateCourse = (id: string, field: keyof CourseRow, value: any) => {
    setCourses(courses.map(c => c.id === id ? { ...c, [field]: value } : c));
  };

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    let totalCredits = 0;
    let totalPoints4 = 0;
    let totalPoints10 = 0;

    courses.forEach(c => {
      const cr = Number(c.credits) || 0;
      const pt4 = GRADE_MAP_4[c.grade] ?? 0;
      const pt10 = GRADE_MAP_10[c.grade] ?? 0;

      totalCredits += cr;
      totalPoints4 += pt4 * cr;
      totalPoints10 += pt10 * cr;
    });

    const gpa4 = totalCredits > 0 ? Number((totalPoints4 / totalCredits).toFixed(2)) : 0;
    const gpa10 = totalCredits > 0 ? Number((totalPoints10 / totalCredits).toFixed(2)) : 0;

    // Classification
    let honors = '';
    let honorsColor = '';
    if (gpa4 >= 3.6) {
      honors = 'Xuất sắc (Summa Cum Laude)';
      honorsColor = 'text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200';
    } else if (gpa4 >= 3.2) {
      honors = 'Giỏi (Magna Cum Laude)';
      honorsColor = 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200';
    } else if (gpa4 >= 2.5) {
      honors = 'Khá (Good)';
      honorsColor = 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 border-blue-200';
    } else if (gpa4 >= 2.0) {
      honors = 'Trung bình (Average)';
      honorsColor = 'text-slate-700 bg-slate-100 border-slate-200';
    } else {
      honors = 'Yếu / Kém (Academic Warning)';
      honorsColor = 'text-rose-600 bg-rose-50 border-rose-200';
    }

    return {
      totalCredits,
      gpa4,
      gpa10,
      honors,
      honorsColor
    };
  }, [courses]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const text = `Kết quả tính điểm GPA:
- Tổng số tín chỉ: ${calculations.totalCredits} tín chỉ
- Điểm GPA hệ 4.0: ${calculations.gpa4} / 4.0
- Điểm GPA hệ 10.0: ${calculations.gpa10} / 10.0
- Xếp loại học lực: ${calculations.honors}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="gpa-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 border border-purple-100">
              <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              GPA Calculator (Tính Điểm Trung Bình Tích Lũy)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính điểm GPA theo thang điểm 4.0 chuẩn quốc tế và thang điểm 10.0, tự động xếp hạng học lực.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Table */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Danh sách môn học ({courses.length} môn)
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={addCourse}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all active:scale-95"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Thêm môn học
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              {courses.map((c, idx) => (
                <div key={c.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 text-xs">
                  <span className="w-5 text-center font-bold text-slate-400">#{idx + 1}</span>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={c.name}
                    onChange={(e) => updateCourse(c.id, 'name', e.target.value)}
                    className="flex-1 p-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl font-semibold text-slate-800"
                    placeholder="Tên môn học"
                  />
                  <select
                    value={c.grade}
                    onChange={(e) => updateCourse(c.id, 'grade', e.target.value)}
                    className="w-20 p-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono"
                  >
                    {Object.keys(GRADE_MAP_4).map(g => (
                      <option key={g} value={g}>{g} ({GRADE_MAP_4[g]})</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={12}
                      value={c.credits}
                      onChange={(e) => updateCourse(c.id, 'credits', Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-14 p-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl font-bold text-center text-slate-900"
                      title="Số tín chỉ"
                    />
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 hidden sm:inline">tín</span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => removeCourse(c.id)}
                    disabled={courses.length <= 1}
                    className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 disabled:opacity-30"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4">
          {/* Main Hero GPA */}
          <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-900 via-slate-900 to-indigo-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-300">
              Điểm GPA Hệ 4.0
            </span>

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-5xl sm:text-7xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-white">
                {calculations.gpa4}
              </span>
              <span className="text-lg font-semibold text-purple-200">/ 4.0</span>
            </div>

            <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-bold ${calculations.honorsColor}`}>
              Xếp loại: {calculations.honors}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Secondary Stats */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1">GPA Thang Điểm 10</span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-indigo-600 font-mono">
                {calculations.gpa10}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">/ 10.0</span>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1">Tổng số tín chỉ</span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono">
                {calculations.totalCredits}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">tín chỉ tích lũy</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Scale Guidance */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-600 space-y-1.5">
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wider block">Thang điểm chuẩn:</span>
            <div className="flex justify-between"><span>A (3.6 - 4.0):</span><span className="font-semibold text-emerald-600">Xuất sắc / Giỏi</span></div>
            <div className="flex justify-between"><span>B (2.5 - 3.5):</span><span className="font-semibold text-blue-600">Khá</span></div>
            <div className="flex justify-between"><span>C (2.0 - 2.4):</span><span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">Trung bình</span></div>
            <div className="flex justify-between"><span>D (&lt; 2.0):</span><span className="font-semibold text-rose-600">Cảnh báo học vụ</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
