import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Ruler, RotateCcw, ArrowRightLeft } from 'lucide-react';

const UNITS: Record<string, { name: string; factor: number }> = {
  m: { name: 'Mét (m)', factor: 1 },
  km: { name: 'Kilômét (km)', factor: 1000 },
  cm: { name: 'Xentimét (cm)', factor: 0.01 },
  mm: { name: 'Milimét (mm)', factor: 0.001 },
  mi: { name: 'Dặm (Mile)', factor: 1609.344 },
  yd: { name: 'Thước (Yard)', factor: 0.9144 },
  ft: { name: 'Bộ (Foot / Feet)', factor: 0.3048 },
  in: { name: 'Phao (Inch)', factor: 0.0254 },
  nmi: { name: 'Hải lý (Nautical Mile)', factor: 1852 },
};

export const LengthConverter: React.FC = () => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<number>(100);
  const [fromUnit, setFromUnit] = useState<string>('m');
  const [toUnit, setToUnit] = useState<string>('ft');

  const result = useMemo(() => {
    const fromFactor = UNITS[fromUnit]?.factor || 1;
    const toFactor = UNITS[toUnit]?.factor || 1;
    const inMeters = value * fromFactor;
    return inMeters / toFactor;
  }, [value, fromUnit, toUnit]);

  const allConversions = useMemo(() => {
    const fromFactor = UNITS[fromUnit]?.factor || 1;
    const inMeters = value * fromFactor;
    return Object.entries(UNITS).map(([key, item]) => ({
      key,
      name: item.name,
      val: inMeters / item.factor
    }));
  }, [value, fromUnit]);

  const handleSwap = () => {
    setFromUnit(toUnit);
    setToUnit(fromUnit);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Ruler className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Length Converter – Chuyển Đổi Đơn Vị Độ Dài</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Chuyển đổi tức thì giữa mét, km, inch, foot, yard, dặm và hải lý</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="length-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setValue(100); setFromUnit('m'); setToUnit('ft'); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-7 gap-3 items-center">
          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Giá trị ban đầu</label>
            <input
              id="length-val-input"
              type="number"
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => setValue(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
            <select
              id="length-from-select"
              value={fromUnit}
              onChange={(e) => setFromUnit(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            >
              {Object.entries(UNITS).map(([k, u]) => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>{u.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-1 flex justify-center">
            <button
              id="length-swap-btn"
              onClick={handleSwap}
              className="p-3 rounded-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 text-blue-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Đảo chiều"
            >
              <ArrowRightLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Đơn vị đích</label>
            <div className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-blue-400 font-bold font-sans tabular-nums truncate">
              {result.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 6 })}
            </div>
            <select
              id="length-to-select"
              value={toUnit}
              onChange={(e) => setToUnit(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            >
              {Object.entries(UNITS).map(([k, u]) => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>{u.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* All units grid */}
        <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-800">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-3">
            Quy đổi đồng thời sang các đơn vị khác

                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Check,
  Copy,
  Table,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  TrendingDown
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

type LoanMethod = 'emi' | 'reducing';
type TenureUnit = 'years' | 'months';

export const LoanCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [principal, setPrincipal] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 25000;
    const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('amount') || new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('principal');
    return p && !isNaN(Number(p)) ? Number(p) : 25000; // Base $25,000
  });

  // When currency changes, automatically adjust principal if it was at a default scale
  useEffect(() => {
    setPrincipal((prev) => {
      if (currency === 'VND' && prev < 1000000) {
        return 500000000;
      } else if (currency !== 'VND' && prev >= 10000000 && (currency === 'USD' || currency === 'EUR' || currency === 'GBP')) {
        return 25000;
      }
      return prev;
    });
  }, [currency]);
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 8.5;
    const r = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('rate');
    return r && !isNaN(Number(r)) ? Number(r) : 8.5; // 8.5% / năm
  });
  const [tenureValue, setTenureValue] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 5;
    const y = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('years') || new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('tenure');
    return y && !isNaN(Number(y)) ? Number(y) : 5; // 5 năm
  });
  const [tenureUnit, setTenureUnit] = useState<TenureUnit>('years');
  const [method, setMethod] = useState<LoanMethod>('emi');
  const [showSchedule, setShowSchedule] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Total months
  const totalMonths = useMemo(() => {
    return tenureUnit === 'years' ? tenureValue * 12 : tenureValue;
  }, [tenureValue, tenureUnit]);

  // Calculations
  const loanSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const P = principal;
    const r = interestRate / 100 / 12; // monthly rate
    const n = totalMonths;

    if (P <= 0 || n <= 0) {
      return {
        monthlyPayment: 0,
        firstMonthPayment: 0,
        lastMonthPayment: 0,
        totalInterest: 0,
        totalPayment: 0,
        schedule: [],
      };
    }

    if (method === 'emi') {
      // Fixed monthly EMI formula: [P * r * (1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1]
      let emi = 0;
      if (r === 0) {
        emi = P / n;
      } else {
        emi = (P * r * Math.pow(1 + r, n)) / (Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1);
      }

      const totalPayment = emi * n;
      const totalInterest = totalPayment - P;

      // Generate schedule
      const schedule = [];
      let balance = P;
      for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        const interestM = balance * r;
        const principalM = emi - interestM;
        balance = Math.max(0, balance - principalM);
        schedule.push({
          month: i,
          payment: emi,
          principalPaid: principalM,
          interestPaid: interestM,
          balance: balance,
        });
      }

      return {
        monthlyPayment: emi,
        firstMonthPayment: emi,
        lastMonthPayment: emi,
        totalInterest,
        totalPayment,
        schedule,
      };
    } else {
      // Reducing balance: Fixed principal per month + interest on remaining balance
      const fixedPrincipalMonthly = P / n;
      let totalInterest = 0;
      const schedule = [];
      let balance = P;

      for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        const interestM = balance * r;
        const totalMonthM = fixedPrincipalMonthly + interestM;
        totalInterest += interestM;
        balance = Math.max(0, balance - fixedPrincipalMonthly);

        schedule.push({
          month: i,
          payment: totalMonthM,
          principalPaid: fixedPrincipalMonthly,
          interestPaid: interestM,
          balance: balance,
        });
      }

      const totalPayment = P + totalInterest;
      const firstMonthPayment = schedule[0]?.payment || 0;
      const lastMonthPayment = schedule[schedule.length - 1]?.payment || 0;

      return {
        monthlyPayment: firstMonthPayment,
        firstMonthPayment,
        lastMonthPayment,
        totalInterest,
        totalPayment,
        schedule,
      };
    }
  }, [principal, interestRate, totalMonths, method]);

  const principalPercent = useMemo(() => {
    if (loanSummary.totalPayment <= 0) return 100;
    return Math.round((principal / loanSummary.totalPayment) * 100);
  }, [principal, loanSummary.totalPayment]);

  const interestPercent = 100 - principalPercent;

  const copyResult = () => {
    const text = `Ước tính vay: Gốc ${formatMoney(principal)}, Lãi suất ${interestRate}%/năm, Thời hạn ${tenureValue} ${tenureUnit === 'years' ? 'năm' : 'tháng'}. Trả hàng tháng: ${formatMoney(loanSummary.monthlyPayment)}, Tổng lãi: ${formatMoney(loanSummary.totalInterest)}. Tính tại Web Calculator`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  // Quick preset chips based on active currency
  const presetChips = useMemo(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      return [
        { label: '100 Tr', value: 100000000 },
        { label: '300 Tr', value: 300000000 },
        { label: '500 Tr', value: 500000000 },
        { label: '1 Tỷ', value: 1000000000 },
        { label: '2 Tỷ', value: 2000000000 },
      ];
    }
    if (currency === 'JPY' || currency === 'KRW') {
      return [
        { label: '1M', value: 1000000 },
        { label: '3M', value: 3000000 },
        { label: '5M', value: 5000000 },
        { label: '10M', value: 10000000 },
        { label: '20M', value: 20000000 },
      ];
    }
    // Base USD and others (EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, etc.)
    return [
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}10k`, value: 10000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}25k`, value: 25000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}50k`, value: 50000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}100k`, value: 100000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}250k`, value: 250000 },
    ];
  }, [currency, currencyInfo.symbol]);

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6">
      
      {/* Method Switcher Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-xl">
          <button
            onClick={() => setMethod('emi')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all ${
              method === 'emi' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
            }`}
          >
            Trả đều cố định (EMI)
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setMethod('reducing')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all ${
              method === 'reducing' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
            }`}
          >
            Dư nợ giảm dần
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium hidden sm:inline">
            {method === 'emi' ? 'Số tiền trả mỗi tháng cố định' : 'Gốc trả đều, tiền lãi giảm dần từng tháng'}
          </span>
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8">
        
        {/* Left Inputs (Col 1-5) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-5">
          
          {/* Principal */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Số tiền muốn vay ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
              </label>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 font-mono">
                {formatMoney(principal)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <input
              type="number"
              step={currency === 'VND' ? 10000000 : (currency === 'JPY' ? 100000 : 500)}
              min={100}
              max={currency === 'VND' ? 100000000000 : 10000000}
              value={principal}
              onChange={(e) => setPrincipal(Math.max(0, parseInt(e.target.value) || 0))}
              className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none"
            />
            {/* Quick chips */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
              {presetChips.map((chip) => (
                <button
                  key={chip.value}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPrincipal(chip.value)}
                  className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                    principal === chip.value ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold' : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {chip.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Interest Rate */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Lãi suất vay (% / năm)</label>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 font-mono">{interestRate}% / năm</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                min="1"
                max="35"
                value={interestRate}
                onChange={(e) => setInterestRate(Math.max(0.1, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0))}
                className="w-24 h-12 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-base font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none"
              />
              <input
                type="range"
                step="0.1"
                min="4"
                max="20"
                value={interestRate}
                onChange={(e) => setInterestRate(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                className="flex-1 accent-blue-600 h-2 bg-slate-200 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono px-1">

              <input
                type="number"

                  </tr>

      )}

  );

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Binary, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const LogCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<number>(100);
  const [base, setBase] = useState<number>(10);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const x = value;
    const b = base;

    if (x <= 0) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Logarit chỉ xác định với giá trị x > 0.'
      };
    }
    if (b <= 0 || b === 1) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Cơ số logarit b phải lớn hơn 0 và khác 1 (b > 0, b ≠ 1).'
      };
    }

    const logBase = Math.log(x) / Math.log(b);
    const ln = Math.log(x);
    const log10 = Math.log10(x);
    const log2 = Math.log2(x);

    return {
      isValid: true,
      logBase: Number(logBase.toFixed(6)),
      ln: Number(ln.toFixed(6)),
      log10: Number(log10.toFixed(6)),
      log2: Number(log2.toFixed(6))
    };
  }, [value, base]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Binary className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Log Calculator – Máy Tính Logarit</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính logarit cơ số bất kỳ log_b(x), logarit tự nhiên ln(x) và logarit thập phân log10(x)</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="log-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setValue(100); setBase(10); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Tham số logarit</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cơ số (Base b)</label>
            <input
              id="log-base"
              type="number"
              value={base}
              onChange={(e) => setBase(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Giá trị cần tính (x)</label>
            <input
              id="log-value"
              type="number"
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => setValue(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {!calculations.isValid ? (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200 text-sm">
              {calculations.message}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">
                  log_{base}({value})
                </span>
                <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.logBase}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">ln({value})</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.ln}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">log10({value})</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.log10}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">log2({value})</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.log2}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { BarChart3, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const MeanMedianModeCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [dataInput, setDataInput] = useState<string>('3, 7, 5, 13, 20, 23, 39, 23, 40, 23, 14, 12, 56, 23, 29');

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const numbers = dataInput
      .split(/[\s,;]+/)
      .map(Number)
      .filter((n) => !isNaN(n));

    const count = numbers.length;
    if (count === 0) return null;

    // Mean
    const sum = numbers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const mean = sum / count;

    // Median
    const sorted = [...numbers].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const mid = Math.floor(count / 2);
    const median = count % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;

    // Mode
    const freq: Record<number, number> = {};
    let maxFreq = 0;
    numbers.forEach((num) => {
      freq[num] = (freq[num] || 0) + 1;
      if (freq[num] > maxFreq) {
        maxFreq = freq[num];
      }
    });

    let modes: number[] = [];
    if (maxFreq > 1) {
      modes = Object.keys(freq)
        .filter((k) => freq[Number(k)] === maxFreq)
        .map(Number);
    }

    // Min, Max, Range
    const min = sorted[0];
    const max = sorted[sorted.length - 1];
    const range = max - min;

    return {
      count,
      sum,
      mean: mean.toFixed(3),
      median,
      modes: modes.length > 0 ? modes.join(', ') : 'Không có (Mỗi số xuất hiện 1 lần)',
      maxFreq: maxFreq > 1 ? maxFreq : 1,
      min,
      max,
      range,
      sorted: sorted.join(', ')
    };
  }, [dataInput]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-purple-600/20 text-purple-400 rounded-xl border border-purple-500/30">
            <BarChart3 className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Mean, Median, Mode Calculator – Trung Bình, Trung Vị, Yếu Vị</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Phân tích đầy đủ xu hướng tập trung của tập dữ liệu mẫu</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="mmm-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => setDataInput('3, 7, 5, 13, 20, 23, 39, 23, 40, 23, 14, 12, 56, 23, 29')}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Nhập chuỗi số</h2>
          <div>
            <textarea
              id="mmm-input"
              rows={5}
              value={dataInput}
              onChange={(e) => setDataInput(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {calculations && (
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div className="p-4 bg-gradient-to-b from-purple-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-purple-500/40 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-1">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-300 font-semibold">Trung bình (Mean)</span>
                <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-purple-300 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.mean}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-4 bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-1">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">Trung vị (Median)</span>
                <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-blue-300 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.median}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-4 bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-1">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300 font-semibold">Yếu vị (Mode)</span>
                <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-extrabold text-emerald-300 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.modes}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Số lượng (n)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.count}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Tổng (Sum)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.sum}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Khoảng (Range)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.range}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-300">
              <span className="text-slate-400 block mb-1">Dãy số đã sắp xếp tăng dần:</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-slate-200">{calculations.sorted}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Home,
  Check,
  Copy,
  TrendingUp,
  Info
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

export const MortgageCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  // Inputs (Base = USD)
  const [homePrice, setHomePrice] = useState<number>(350000);
  const [downPaymentPercent, setDownPaymentPercent] = useState<number>(20);
  const [loanTermYears, setLoanTermYears] = useState<number>(30);
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState<number>(6.5);
  const [propertyTaxRate, setPropertyTaxRate] = useState<number>(1.2); // % per year
  const [homeInsuranceYearly, setHomeInsuranceYearly] = useState<number>(1200); // per year
  const [hoaMonthly, setHoaMonthly] = useState<number>(0);
  const [pmiRate, setPmiRate] = useState<number>(0.75); // % per year if down payment < 20%
  const [showAmortization, setShowAmortization] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Derived loan values
  const downPaymentAmount = useMemo(() => {
    return Math.round((homePrice * downPaymentPercent) / 100);
  }, [homePrice, downPaymentPercent]);

  const loanAmount = useMemo(() => {
    return Math.max(0, homePrice - downPaymentAmount);
  }, [homePrice, downPaymentAmount]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const totalMonths = loanTermYears * 12;
    const monthlyRate = (interestRate / 100) / 12;

    // Monthly Principal & Interest (P&I)
    let monthlyPI = 0;
    if (monthlyRate > 0 && loanAmount > 0) {
      monthlyPI = loanAmount * (monthlyRate * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, totalMonths)) / 
        (Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, totalMonths) - 1);
    } else if (totalMonths > 0) {
      monthlyPI = loanAmount / totalMonths;
    }

    // Monthly taxes & insurance
    const monthlyTax = (homePrice * (propertyTaxRate / 100)) / 12;
    const monthlyInsurance = homeInsuranceYearly / 12;
    
    // PMI applies only if down payment < 20%
    const isPmiApplicable = downPaymentPercent < 20;
    const monthlyPmi = isPmiApplicable ? (loanAmount * (pmiRate / 100)) / 12 : 0;

    const totalMonthlyPayment = monthlyPI + monthlyTax + monthlyInsurance + monthlyPmi + hoaMonthly;

    // Total cost over life of loan
    const totalPIPaid = monthlyPI * totalMonths;
    const totalInterest = Math.max(0, totalPIPaid - loanAmount);
    const totalLoanCost = totalMonthlyPayment * totalMonths;

    // Amortization Schedule (Yearly sample)
    const yearlySchedule: {
      year: number;
      principalPaid: number;
      interestPaid: number;
      remainingBalance: number;
    }[] = [];

    let currentBalance = loanAmount;
    for (let year = 1; year <= loanTermYears; year++) {
      let yearPrincipal = 0;
      let yearInterest = 0;

      for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
        if (currentBalance <= 0) break;
        const interestForMonth = currentBalance * monthlyRate;
        const principalForMonth = Math.min(currentBalance, monthlyPI - interestForMonth);
        yearInterest += interestForMonth;
        yearPrincipal += principalForMonth;
        currentBalance -= principalForMonth;
      }

      yearlySchedule.push({
        year,
        principalPaid: Math.round(yearPrincipal),
        interestPaid: Math.round(yearInterest),
        remainingBalance: Math.max(0, Math.round(currentBalance))
      });
    }

    return {
      monthlyPI: Math.round(monthlyPI),
      monthlyTax: Math.round(monthlyTax),
      monthlyInsurance: Math.round(monthlyInsurance),
      monthlyPmi: Math.round(monthlyPmi),
      hoaMonthly: Math.round(hoaMonthly),
      totalMonthlyPayment: Math.round(totalMonthlyPayment),
      totalInterest: Math.round(totalInterest),
      totalLoanCost: Math.round(totalLoanCost),
      isPmiApplicable,
      yearlySchedule
    };
  }, [homePrice, downPaymentPercent, loanAmount, loanTermYears, interestRate, propertyTaxRate, homeInsuranceYearly, hoaMonthly, pmiRate]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const summary = `Ước tính vay mua nhà:
- Giá nhà: ${formatMoney(homePrice)}
- Trả trước: ${formatMoney(downPaymentAmount)} (${downPaymentPercent}%)
- Vay: ${formatMoney(loanAmount)} trong ${loanTermYears} năm, lãi ${interestRate}%
- Thanh toán hàng tháng: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalMonthlyPayment)}/tháng
  + Gốc & Lãi (P&I): ${formatMoney(calculations.monthlyPI)}
  + Thuế nhà đất: ${formatMoney(calculations.monthlyTax)}
  + Bảo hiểm: ${formatMoney(calculations.monthlyInsurance)}
  ${calculations.monthlyPmi > 0 ? `+ PMI: ${formatMoney(calculations.monthlyPmi)}\n` : ''}
- Tổng lãi suất cả kỳ: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalInterest)}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(summary);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const piRatio = calculations.totalMonthlyPayment > 0 ? (calculations.monthlyPI / calculations.totalMonthlyPayment) * 100 : 0;
  const taxRatio = calculations.totalMonthlyPayment > 0 ? (calculations.monthlyTax / calculations.totalMonthlyPayment) * 100 : 0;
  const insRatio = calculations.totalMonthlyPayment > 0 ? (calculations.monthlyInsurance / calculations.totalMonthlyPayment) * 100 : 0;
  const pmiRatio = calculations.totalMonthlyPayment > 0 ? (calculations.monthlyPmi / calculations.totalMonthlyPayment) * 100 : 0;
  const hoaRatio = calculations.totalMonthlyPayment > 0 ? (calculations.hoaMonthly / calculations.totalMonthlyPayment) * 100 : 0;

  const homePricePresets = useMemo(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      return [
        { label: '2 Tỷ', val: 2000000000 },
        { label: '3.5 Tỷ', val: 3500000000 },
        { label: '5 Tỷ', val: 5000000000 },
        { label: '7.5 Tỷ', val: 7500000000 },
        { label: '10 Tỷ', val: 10000000000 },
      ];
    }
    if (currency === 'JPY' || currency === 'KRW') {
      return [
        { label: '25M', val: 25000000 },
        { label: '35M', val: 35000000 },
        { label: '50M', val: 50000000 },
        { label: '75M', val: 75000000 },
        { label: '100M', val: 100000000 },
      ];
    }
    return [
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}200k`, val: 200000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}350k`, val: 350000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}500k`, val: 500000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}750k`, val: 750000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}1M`, val: 1000000 },
    ];
  }, [currency, currencyInfo.symbol]);

  return (
    <div id="mortgage-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Top Header Card */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 border border-blue-100">
              <Home className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Mortgage Calculator (Vay Mua Nhà)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính toán khoản trả góp hàng tháng, phân bổ gốc/lãi, thuế tài sản, bảo hiểm và PMI.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            onClick={handleCopy}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
            <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Grid: Inputs on Left, Output & Visuals on Right */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Column: Form Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* 1. Home Price */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Giá trị bất động sản / Giá nhà ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
              </label>
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-600 font-mono">
                {formatMoney(homePrice)}

            </div>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-semibold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1000}
                max={50000000000}
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 50000000 : 5000}
                value={homePrice}
                onChange={(e) => setHomePrice(Math.max(1000, Number(e.target.value)))}
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 pt-1 overflow-x-auto">
              {homePricePresets.map(preset => (
                <button
                  key={preset.val}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setHomePrice(preset.val)}
                  className={`text-[11px] px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    homePrice === preset.val ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600 font-bold' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >

          {/* 2. Down payment */}

              </label>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono">
                {formatMoney(downPaymentAmount)} ({downPaymentPercent}%)
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                />

                Ước tính trả hàng tháng

                <div style={{ width: `${piRatio}%` }} className="bg-blue-500 transition-all" title="Gốc & Lãi" />
                <div style={{ width: `${taxRatio}%` }} className="bg-amber-500 transition-all" title="Thuế tài sản" />
                <div style={{ width: `${insRatio}%` }} className="bg-emerald-500 transition-all" title="Bảo hiểm" />
                <div style={{ width: `${pmiRatio}%` }} className="bg-rose-500 transition-all" title="PMI" />
                <div style={{ width: `${hoaRatio}%` }} className="bg-purple-500 transition-all" title="HOA" />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Breakdown List */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 pt-2 text-xs border-t border-slate-800">

                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-300">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />

                </span>

              <span className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono">
                {formatMoney(calculations.totalLoanCost)}
              </span>
            </div>

          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Amortization Table */}
      {showAmortization && (
        <div className="mt-4 border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="bg-slate-100 px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-200">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Lịch trình trả nợ gốc và lãi theo từng năm
            </h3>
          </div>
          <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-xs text-left">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 font-semibold border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0">
                <tr>
                  <th className="p-3">Năm</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Gốc đã trả</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Lãi đã trả</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Dư nợ còn lại</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {calculations.yearlySchedule.map((item) => (

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Heart,
  Check,
  Copy,
  Baby
} from 'lucide-react';

export const OvulationCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  const [lastPeriodDate, setLastPeriodDate] = useState<string>(todayStr);
  const [cycleLength, setCycleLength] = useState<number>(28);
  const [lutealPhase, setLutealPhase] = useState<number>(14);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const lmp = new Date(lastPeriodDate);
    if (isNaN(lmp.getTime())) return null;

    // Ovulation date: LMP + (cycleLength - lutealPhase)
    const ovulationOffsetDays = cycleLength - lutealPhase;
    const ovulationDate = new Date(lmp);
    ovulationDate.setDate(ovulationDate.getDate() + ovulationOffsetDays);

    // Fertile window: 5 days before ovulation up to 1 day after
    const fertileStart = new Date(ovulationDate);
    fertileStart.setDate(fertileStart.getDate() - 5);

    const fertileEnd = new Date(ovulationDate);
    fertileEnd.setDate(fertileEnd.getDate() + 1);

    // Next period: LMP + cycleLength
    const nextPeriod = new Date(lmp);
    nextPeriod.setDate(nextPeriod.getDate() + cycleLength);

    // Due date (Naegele's rule: LMP + 280 days)
    const dueDate = new Date(lmp);
    dueDate.setDate(dueDate.getDate() + 280);

    // Next 3 cycles
    const futureCycles = [1, 2, 3].map(i => {
      const futureLmp = new Date(lmp);
      futureLmp.setDate(futureLmp.getDate() + (cycleLength * i));
      const futureOvu = new Date(futureLmp);
      futureOvu.setDate(futureOvu.getDate() + ovulationOffsetDays);
      return {
        cycleNum: i + 1,
        ovulationStr: futureOvu.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }),
        periodStr: futureLmp.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }),
      };
    });

    const formatDate = (d: Date) => d.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', { 
      weekday: 'long', 
      year: 'numeric', 
      month: 'long', 
      day: 'numeric' 
    });

    return {
      ovulationDateStr: formatDate(ovulationDate),
      fertileWindowStr: `${fertileStart.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'numeric' })} - ${fertileEnd.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}`,
      nextPeriodStr: formatDate(nextPeriod),
      dueDateStr: formatDate(dueDate),
      futureCycles
    };
  }, [lastPeriodDate, cycleLength, lutealPhase]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (!calculations) return;
    const text = `Dự đoán ngày rụng trứng & Chu kỳ sinh sản:
- Ngày đầu chu kỳ kinh cuối: ${lastPeriodDate} (độ dài chu kỳ ${cycleLength} ngày)
- Ngày rụng trứng dự kiến: ${calculations.ovulationDateStr}
- Khoảng thời gian dễ thụ thai nhất: ${calculations.fertileWindowStr}
- Ngày bắt đầu chu kỳ kinh tiếp theo: ${calculations.nextPeriodStr}
- Ngày dự sinh (nếu thụ thai kỳ này): ${calculations.dueDateStr}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="ovulation-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 border border-rose-100">
              <Heart className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Ovulation Calculator (Dự Đoán Rụng Trứng)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính toán ngày rụng trứng, khoảng thời gian dễ thụ thai và dự đoán các chu kỳ sắp tới.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1.5">
                Ngày đầu tiên của kỳ kinh gần nhất
              </label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={lastPeriodDate}
                onChange={(e) => setLastPeriodDate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                <span>Độ dài chu kỳ trung bình:</span>
                <span className="text-rose-600 font-mono text-sm">{cycleLength} ngày</span>
              </div>
              <input
                type="range"
                min={21}
                max={45}
                value={cycleLength}
                onChange={(e) => setCycleLength(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-rose-600 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                <span>21 ngày (ngắn)</span>
                <span>28 ngày (tiêu chuẩn)</span>
                <span>45 ngày (dài)</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">
                <span>Độ dài pha hoàng thể (Luteal phase):</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-slate-900 font-bold">{lutealPhase} ngày</span>
              </div>
              <input
                type="range"
                min={10}
                max={16}
                value={lutealPhase}
                onChange={(e) => setLutealPhase(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-rose-500"
              />
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">
                * Thường dao động từ 12 - 14 ngày đối với đa số phụ nữ.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {calculations && (
            <>
              {/* Ovulation Hero Card */}
              <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-rose-900 via-pink-900 to-slate-900 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-300">
                  Ngày rụng trứng ước tính
                </span>

                <div className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black tracking-tight text-white py-1">
                  {calculations.ovulationDateStr}
                </div>

                <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 border border-white/20 text-xs space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-rose-200 block font-semibold">Cửa sổ thụ thai cao nhất (Fertile Window):</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-mono">{calculations.fertileWindowStr}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Extra milestones */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1">Kỳ kinh tiếp theo</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 block">
                    {calculations.nextPeriodStr}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Baby className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-pink-600" /> Ngày dự sinh (nếu đậu thai)
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-pink-600 block">
                    {calculations.dueDateStr}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Upcoming Cycles Forecast */}
              <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-2 text-xs">
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                  Dự báo 3 chu kỳ kế tiếp
                </span>
                <div className="divide-y divide-slate-200 text-slate-600">
                  {calculations.futureCycles.map(c => (
                    <div key={c.cycleNum} className="py-2 flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span>Chu kỳ #{c.cycleNum}:</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-slate-800">
                        Kinh nguyệt: <strong>{c.periodStr}</strong> | Rụng trứng: <strong className="text-rose-600">{c.ovulationStr}</strong>
                      </span>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Footprints,
  Trophy,
  Check,
  Copy
} from 'lucide-react';

export const PaceCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [calcMode, setCalcMode] = useState<'pace' | 'time' | 'distance'>('pace');

  // Time: Hours, Minutes, Seconds
  const [timeH, setTimeH] = useState<number>(0);
  const [timeM, setTimeM] = useState<number>(45);
  const [timeS, setTimeS] = useState<number>(0);

  // Distance
  const [distance, setDistance] = useState<number>(10); // 10 km
  const [distUnit, setDistUnit] = useState<'km' | 'mile'>('km');

  // Target Pace: Minutes & Seconds per unit
  const [paceM, setPaceM] = useState<number>(5);
  const [paceS, setPaceS] = useState<number>(30);

  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Calculations
  const result = useMemo(() => {
    const totalTimeSeconds = timeH * 3600 + timeM * 60 + timeS;
    const targetPaceSeconds = paceM * 60 + paceS;

    let computedDistanceKm = 0;
    let computedTimeSeconds = 0;
    let computedPaceSecPerKm = 0;

    if (calcMode === 'pace') {
      computedDistanceKm = distUnit === 'km' ? distance : distance * 1.609344;
      computedTimeSeconds = totalTimeSeconds;
      if (computedDistanceKm > 0) {
        computedPaceSecPerKm = totalTimeSeconds / computedDistanceKm;
      }
    } else if (calcMode === 'time') {
      computedDistanceKm = distUnit === 'km' ? distance : distance * 1.609344;
      const pacePerKm = distUnit === 'km' ? targetPaceSeconds : targetPaceSeconds / 1.609344;
      computedPaceSecPerKm = pacePerKm;
      computedTimeSeconds = computedDistanceKm * pacePerKm;
    } else {
      // mode: distance
      computedTimeSeconds = totalTimeSeconds;
      const pacePerKm = distUnit === 'km' ? targetPaceSeconds : targetPaceSeconds / 1.609344;
      computedPaceSecPerKm = pacePerKm;
      if (pacePerKm > 0) {
        computedDistanceKm = totalTimeSeconds / pacePerKm;
      }
    }

    // Format pace min:sec per km
    const paceKmMin = Math.floor(computedPaceSecPerKm / 60);
    const paceKmSec = Math.round(computedPaceSecPerKm % 60);
    const paceKmStr = `${paceKmMin}:${String(paceKmSec).padStart(2, '0')} /km`;

    // Format pace per mile
    const paceSecPerMile = computedPaceSecPerKm * 1.609344;
    const paceMileMin = Math.floor(paceSecPerMile / 60);
    const paceMileSec = Math.round(paceSecPerMile % 60);
    const paceMileStr = `${paceMileMin}:${String(paceMileSec).padStart(2, '0')} /mi`;

    // Speed km/h
    const speedKmh = computedPaceSecPerKm > 0 ? Number((3600 / computedPaceSecPerKm).toFixed(2)) : 0;
    const speedMph = Number((speedKmh / 1.609344).toFixed(2));

    // Formatted time
    const resH = Math.floor(computedTimeSeconds / 3600);
    const resM = Math.floor((computedTimeSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const resS = Math.round(computedTimeSeconds % 60);
    const formattedTime = `${String(resH).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(resM).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(resS).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    // Race finish times at this pace
    const racePredictions = [
      { name: '5K', km: 5 },
      { name: '10K', km: 10 },
      { name: 'Half Marathon', km: 21.0975 },
      { name: 'Marathon', km: 42.195 },
    ].map(race => {
      const sec = race.km * computedPaceSecPerKm;
      const h = Math.floor(sec / 3600);
      const m = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60);
      const s = Math.round(sec % 60);
      return {
        name: race.name,
        timeStr: `${h > 0 ? `${h}h ` : ''}${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}s`
      };
    });

    return {
      paceKmStr,
      paceMileStr,
      speedKmh,
      speedMph,
      formattedTime,
      computedDistanceKm: Number(computedDistanceKm.toFixed(2)),
      racePredictions
    };
  }, [calcMode, timeH, timeM, timeS, distance, distUnit, paceM, paceS]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const text = `Kết quả tính tốc độ Pace chạy bộ:
- Cự ly: ${distance} ${distUnit}
- Tốc độ Pace: ${result.paceKmStr} (${result.paceMileStr})
- Vận tốc: ${result.speedKmh} km/h (${result.speedMph} mph)
- Dự đoán thành tích các cự ly:
  + 5K: ${result.racePredictions[0].timeStr}
  + 10K: ${result.racePredictions[1].timeStr}
  + Half Marathon (21km): ${result.racePredictions[2].timeStr}
  + Full Marathon (42km): ${result.racePredictions[3].timeStr}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="pace-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-cyan-50 text-cyan-600 border border-cyan-100">
              <Footprints className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Pace Calculator (Tốc Độ Chạy Bộ)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính tốc độ Pace (phút/km), vận tốc km/h và ước tính thời gian hoàn thành cự ly 5K, 10K, 21K, 42K.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Mode Switcher */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 p-1.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl w-fit">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setCalcMode('pace')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            calcMode === 'pace' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Tính Tốc độ (Pace)
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setCalcMode('time')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            calcMode === 'time' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Tính Thời gian (Time)
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setCalcMode('distance')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            calcMode === 'distance' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Tính Quãng đường (Distance)
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Time Inputs (if mode is pace or distance) */}
          {calcMode !== 'time' && (
            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                Tổng thời gian (Time)
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-500 block mb-1">Giờ:</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    value={timeH}
                    onChange={(e) => setTimeH(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-500 block mb-1">Phút:</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    max={59}
                    value={timeM}
                    onChange={(e) => setTimeM(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-500 block mb-1">Giây:</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    max={59}
                    value={timeS}
                    onChange={(e) => setTimeS(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Distance Input (if mode is pace or time) */}
          {calcMode !== 'distance' && (
            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Cự ly quãng đường
                </label>

                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDistUnit('km')}
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${distUnit === 'km' ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-600'}`}
                  >
                    Kilometers
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDistUnit('mile')}
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${distUnit === 'mile' ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-600'}`}
                  >
                    Miles
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step={0.1}
                  min={0.1}
                  value={distance}
                  onChange={(e) => setDistance(Math.max(0.1, Number(e.target.value)))}
                  className="w-full pl-4 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-2xl text-lg font-black text-slate-900"
                />
                <span className="absolute right-4 top-3 text-slate-400 font-bold text-xs uppercase">{distUnit}</span>

                  { label: '42.2K (Full)', val: 42.195 },

                      setDistUnit('km');

                    className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 font-semibold"

                    {r.label}

          {calcMode !== 'pace' && (

        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">

                <span className="text-base font-bold text-cyan-300 font-mono">
                  {result.paceMileStr}
                </span>
              </div>

                <span className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-400 font-mono">
                  {result.speedKmh} km/h
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{r.timeStr}</span>
                </div>
              ))}

    </div>
  );

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  KeyRound,
  ShieldCheck,
  RefreshCw,
  Check,
  Copy,
  Eye,
  EyeOff
} from 'lucide-react';

export const PasswordGenerator: React.FC = () => {
  const [length, setLength] = useState<number>(16);
  const [includeUpper, setIncludeUpper] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [includeLower, setIncludeLower] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [includeNumbers, setIncludeNumbers] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [includeSymbols, setIncludeSymbols] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [excludeAmbiguous, setExcludeAmbiguous] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [password, setPassword] = useState<string>('');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Bulk generated list
  const [bulkList, setBulkList] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const generate = () => {
    let upper = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    let lower = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
    let numbers = '0123456789';
    let symbols = '!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:,.<>?';

    if (excludeAmbiguous) {
      upper = upper.replace(/[IO]/g, '');
      lower = lower.replace(/[lo]/g, '');
      numbers = numbers.replace(/[01]/g, '');
    }

    let charPool = '';
    const guaranteed: string[] = [];

    if (includeUpper) {
      charPool += upper;
      guaranteed.push(upper[Math.floor(Math.random() * upper.length)]);
    }
    if (includeLower) {
      charPool += lower;
      guaranteed.push(lower[Math.floor(Math.random() * lower.length)]);
    }
    if (includeNumbers) {
      charPool += numbers;
      guaranteed.push(numbers[Math.floor(Math.random() * numbers.length)]);
    }
    if (includeSymbols) {
      charPool += symbols;
      guaranteed.push(symbols[Math.floor(Math.random() * symbols.length)]);
    }

    if (charPool.length === 0) {
      setPassword('');
      return;
    }

    const genOne = () => {
      let pwd = [...guaranteed];
      for (let i = pwd.length; i < length; i++) {
        pwd.push(charPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * charPool.length)]);
      }
      // Shuffle
      return pwd.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).join('');
    };

    const main = genOne();
    setPassword(main);

    // Generate 4 bulk alternatives
    setBulkList(Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => genOne()));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    generate();
  }, [length, includeUpper, includeLower, includeNumbers, includeSymbols, excludeAmbiguous]);

  // Calculate entropy and strength
  const { entropy, strengthLabel, strengthColor, strengthWidth } = (() => {
    let poolSize = 0;
    if (includeUpper) poolSize += 26;
    if (includeLower) poolSize += 26;
    if (includeNumbers) poolSize += 10;
    if (includeSymbols) poolSize += 30;

    const bits = length * (poolSize > 0 ? Math.log2(poolSize) : 0);
    const roundedBits = Math.round(bits);

    if (roundedBits < 40) {
      return { entropy: roundedBits, strengthLabel: 'Yếu (Dễ bị bẻ khóa)', strengthColor: 'bg-rose-500', strengthWidth: '25%' };
    } else if (roundedBits < 60) {
      return { entropy: roundedBits, strengthLabel: 'Trung bình', strengthColor: 'bg-amber-500', strengthWidth: '50%' };
    } else if (roundedBits < 80) {
      return { entropy: roundedBits, strengthLabel: 'Mạnh (An toàn cao)', strengthColor: 'bg-blue-500', strengthWidth: '75%' };
    } else {
      return { entropy: roundedBits, strengthLabel: 'Cực kỳ an toàn (Chuẩn quân sự)', strengthColor: 'bg-emerald-500', strengthWidth: '100%' };
    }
  })();

  const handleCopy = (textToCopy?: string) => {
    const txt = textToCopy || password;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(txt);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="password-generator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 border border-emerald-100">
              <KeyRound className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Password Generator (Tạo Mật Khẩu An Toàn)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tạo mật khẩu ngẫu nhiên độ bảo mật cao, chống dò quét brute-force với đo lường entropy thời gian thực.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => handleCopy()}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép mật khẩu'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Main Password Showcase Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-slate-800 to-emerald-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" /> Mật khẩu tạo ngẫu nhiên
          </span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white transition-colors"
              title={showPassword ? 'Ẩn mật khẩu' : 'Hiện mật khẩu'}
            >
              {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-300" />}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={generate}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white transition-colors"
              title="Tạo lại"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Display String */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-3.5 bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl">
          <span className="font-mono text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-wider break-all text-emerald-400 select-all">
            {showPassword ? password : '•'.repeat(password.length)}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleCopy()}
            className="p-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl transition-all shrink-0 active:scale-95"
            title="Sao chép"
          >
            <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Strength Bar */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-400">Độ mạnh: <strong className="text-white">{strengthLabel}</strong></span>
            <span className="text-emerald-300 font-mono font-bold">{entropy} bits entropy</span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className={`h-full ${strengthColor} transition-all duration-300`}
              style={{ width: strengthWidth }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Settings */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">Cấu hình ký tự</h3>

          {/* Length Slider */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
              <span>Độ dài mật khẩu:</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-600 font-mono text-sm">{length} ký tự</span>
            </div>
            <input
              type="range"
              min={6}
              max={64}
              value={length}
              onChange={(e) => setLength(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full accent-emerald-600 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400">
              <span>6 (Ngắn)</span>
              <span>16 (Khuyến nghị)</span>
              <span>64 (Tối đa)</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Checkboxes */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs pt-2">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={includeUpper}
                onChange={(e) => setIncludeUpper(e.target.checked)}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-emerald-600 accent-emerald-600"
              />
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">Chữ hoa (A-Z)</span>

            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl cursor-pointer">
