import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { CreditCard, DollarSign, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

export const PaymentCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [loanAmount, setLoanAmount] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 500000000 : 20000;
  });
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState<number>(6.0);
  const [termYears, setTermYears] = useState<number>(4);
  const [frequency, setFrequency] = useState<'monthly' | 'biweekly' | 'weekly'>('monthly');

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoanAmount((prev) => {
      if (currency === 'VND' && prev < 100000) return 500000000;
      if (currency !== 'VND' && prev >= 1000000) return 20000;
      return prev;
    });
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const P = Math.max(0, loanAmount);
    const annualRate = interestRate / 100;
    
    let periodsPerYear = 12;
    if (frequency === 'biweekly') periodsPerYear = 26;
    if (frequency === 'weekly') periodsPerYear = 52;

    const totalPeriods = termYears * periodsPerYear;
    const ratePerPeriod = annualRate / periodsPerYear;

    let payment = 0;
    let totalPaid = 0;
    let totalInterest = 0;

    if (ratePerPeriod > 0 && totalPeriods > 0) {
      payment = (P * (ratePerPeriod * Math.pow(1 + ratePerPeriod, totalPeriods))) /
                (Math.pow(1 + ratePerPeriod, totalPeriods) - 1);
      totalPaid = payment * totalPeriods;
      totalInterest = totalPaid - P;
    } else if (totalPeriods > 0) {
      payment = P / totalPeriods;
      totalPaid = P;
      totalInterest = 0;
    }

    return {
      payment,
      totalPaid,
      totalInterest,
      totalPeriods,
      periodsPerYear
    };
  }, [loanAmount, interestRate, termYears, frequency]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setLoanAmount(currency === 'VND' ? 500000000 : 20000);
    setInterestRate(6.0);
    setTermYears(4);
    setFrequency('monthly');
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-indigo-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-600/20 text-indigo-400 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/30">
            <CreditCard className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Payment Calculator – Tính Khoản Thanh Toán Định Kỳ</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính số tiền cần trả theo tháng, 2 tuần một lần hoặc hàng tuần cho mọi khoản vay</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="payment-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-400" />
            Chi tiết khoản vay
          </h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Số tiền vay ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                id="payment-loan-amount"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 10000000 : 500}
                value={loanAmount}
                onChange={(e) => setLoanAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Lãi suất (%/năm)</label>
              <input
                id="payment-interest-rate"
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                value={interestRate}
                onChange={(e) => setInterestRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Thời hạn (năm)</label>
              <input
                id="payment-term-years"
                type="number"
                value={termYears}
                onChange={(e) => setTermYears(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Tần suất thanh toán</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                id="freq-monthly"
                onClick={() => setFrequency('monthly')}
                className={`py-2 px-2 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  frequency === 'monthly'
                    ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-500 font-bold'
                    : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Hàng tháng (12)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="freq-biweekly"
                onClick={() => setFrequency('biweekly')}
                className={`py-2 px-2 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  frequency === 'biweekly'
                    ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-500 font-bold'
                    : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                2 tuần/lần (26)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="freq-weekly"
                onClick={() => setFrequency('weekly')}
                className={`py-2 px-2 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  frequency === 'weekly'
                    ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-500 font-bold'
                    : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Hàng tuần (52)
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-indigo-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-300 font-semibold">
              Khoản thanh toán mỗi kỳ ({frequency === 'monthly' ? 'Mỗi tháng' : frequency === 'biweekly' ? 'Mỗi 2 tuần' : 'Mỗi tuần'})
            </span>
            <div className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-indigo-300 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {formatMoney(calculations.payment)}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Tổng cộng {calculations.totalPeriods} kỳ thanh toán trong {termYears} năm
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Tổng tiền trả gốc & lãi</span>
              <div className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white font-sans tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.totalPaid)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Tổng tiền lãi phải trả</span>
              <div className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-bold text-rose-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.totalInterest)}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/40 border border-slate-700/60 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-2">
            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">Mẹo tài chính thông minh:</div>
            <p>
              Chọn thanh toán 2 tuần một lần (Bi-weekly) giúp bạn trả thêm tương đương 1 tháng tiền gốc mỗi năm, rút ngắn thời gian vay và tiết kiệm đáng kể chi phí lãi suất.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Copy,
  Check,
  Tag,
  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown
} from 'lucide-react';

type PercentMode = 'percent_of' | 'is_what_percent' | 'change' | 'discount';

export const PercentageCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [activeMode, setActiveMode] = useState<PercentMode>('percent_of');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Mode 1: What is X% of Y?
  const [m1Percent, setM1Percent] = useState<number>(25);
  const [m1Total, setM1Total] = useState<number>(480000);

  // Mode 2: X is what % of Y?
  const [m2Part, setM2Part] = useState<number>(120000);
  const [m2Total, setM2Total] = useState<number>(480000);

  // Mode 3: % Increase / Decrease from X to Y
  const [m3From, setM3From] = useState<number>(500000);
  const [m3To, setM3To] = useState<number>(650000);

  // Mode 4: Discount & Tax
  const [m4Price, setM4Price] = useState<number>(1200000);
  const [m4Discount, setM4Discount] = useState<number>(15);
  const [m4Tax, setM4Tax] = useState<number>(8); // 8% VAT

  // Calculations
  const m1Result = useMemo(() => {
    return (m1Percent / 100) * m1Total;
  }, [m1Percent, m1Total]);

  const m2Result = useMemo(() => {
    if (m2Total === 0) return 0;
    return Number(((m2Part / m2Total) * 100).toFixed(2));
  }, [m2Part, m2Total]);

  const m3Result = useMemo(() => {
    if (m3From === 0) return { percent: 0, isIncrease: true, diff: 0 };
    const diff = m3To - m3From;
    const pct = Number(((diff / m3From) * 100).toFixed(2));
    return {
      percent: Math.abs(pct),
      isIncrease: diff >= 0,
      diff: Math.abs(diff),
    };
  }, [m3From, m3To]);

  const m4Result = useMemo(() => {
    const discountAmount = (m4Price * m4Discount) / 100;
    const priceAfterDiscount = m4Price - discountAmount;
    const taxAmount = (priceAfterDiscount * m4Tax) / 100;
    const finalPrice = priceAfterDiscount + taxAmount;
    return {
      discountAmount,
      priceAfterDiscount,
      taxAmount,
      finalPrice,
    };
  }, [m4Price, m4Discount, m4Tax]);

  const formatNumber = (val: number) => {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(Math.round(val * 100) / 100);
  };

  const copyResult = (text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6">
      
      {/* 4 Mode Tabs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveMode('percent_of')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all ${
            activeMode === 'percent_of' 
              ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' 
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          X% của Y là gì?
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveMode('is_what_percent')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all ${
            activeMode === 'is_what_percent' 
              ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' 
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          X là bao nhiêu % của Y?
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveMode('change')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all ${
            activeMode === 'change' 
              ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' 
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          % Tăng / Giảm
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveMode('discount')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all ${
            activeMode === 'discount' 
              ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' 
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          Giảm giá & Thuế
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Mode 1: What is X% of Y? */}
      {activeMode === 'percent_of' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
              Tính giá trị khi biết phần trăm
            </h3>
            
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Phần trăm (%)</label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={m1Percent}
                  onChange={(e) => setM1Percent(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                  className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
                />
                <span className="w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-700">%</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Của tổng số (Y)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={m1Total}
                onChange={(e) => setM1Total(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Quick chips */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
              {[5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 50, 75].map((pct) => (
                <button
                  key={pct}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setM1Percent(pct)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                    m1Percent === pct ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {pct}%
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col justify-between bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Kết quả tính toán</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => copyResult(`${m1Percent}% của ${formatNumber(m1Total)} = ${formatNumber(m1Result)}`)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-600 font-medium hover:text-blue-800"
                >
                  {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#10B981]" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copied ? 'Đã chép' : 'Sao chép'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1">
                  {m1Percent}% của {formatNumber(m1Total)} là:
                </span>
                <span className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-[#10B981] font-mono tracking-tight">
                  {formatNumber(m1Result)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-600 mt-4 font-mono">
              Công thức: ({m1Percent} ÷ 100) × {formatNumber(m1Total)} = <strong>{formatNumber(m1Result)}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mode 2: X is what % of Y? */}
      {activeMode === 'is_what_percent' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
              Tính tỷ lệ phần trăm giữa hai số
            </h3>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Số thành phần (X)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={m2Part}
                onChange={(e) => setM2Part(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Là bao nhiêu % của tổng số (Y)?</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={m2Total}
                onChange={(e) => setM2Total(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col justify-between bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Kết quả tỷ lệ</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => copyResult(`${m2Part} chiếm ${m2Result}% của ${m2Total}`)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-600 font-medium hover:text-blue-800"
                >
                  {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#10B981]" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copied ? 'Đã chép' : 'Sao chép'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1">
                  {formatNumber(m2Part)} chiếm:
                </span>
                <span className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-[#3B82F6] font-mono tracking-tight">
                  {m2Result}%
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mt-1">trong tổng số {formatNumber(m2Total)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-600 mt-4 font-mono">
              Công thức: ({formatNumber(m2Part)} ÷ {formatNumber(m2Total)}) × 100 = <strong>{m2Result}%</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mode 3: Increase / Decrease */}
      {activeMode === 'change' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
              Tính phần trăm tăng trưởng hoặc sụt giảm
            </h3>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Giá trị ban đầu (X)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={m3From}
                onChange={(e) => setM3From(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Giá trị sau khi đổi (Y)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={m3To}
                onChange={(e) => setM3To(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col justify-between bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Mức độ thay đổi</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => copyResult(`Thay đổi từ ${m3From} sang ${m3To}: ${m3Result.isIncrease ? 'Tăng' : 'Giảm'} ${m3Result.percent}%`)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-600 font-medium hover:text-blue-800"
                >
                  {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#10B981]" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copied ? 'Đã chép' : 'Sao chép'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg ${m3Result.isIncrease ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-[#10B981]' : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-600'}`}>
                    {m3Result.isIncrease ? <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" /> : <TrendingDown className="w-5 h-5" />}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-600">
                    {m3Result.isIncrease ? 'TĂNG TRƯỞNG' : 'SỤT GIẢM'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-2">
                  <span className={`text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight ${
                    m3Result.isIncrease ? 'text-[#10B981]' : 'text-rose-600'
                  }`}>
                    {m3Result.isIncrease ? '+' : '-'}{m3Result.percent}%
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mt-1">
                    Chênh lệch: {m3Result.isIncrease ? '+' : '-'}{formatNumber(m3Result.diff)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-600 mt-4 font-mono">
              Công thức: [({formatNumber(m3To)} – {formatNumber(m3From)}) ÷ {formatNumber(m3From)}] × 100
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mode 4: Discount & Tax */}
      {activeMode === 'discount' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Tag className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
              <span>Máy tính giá khuyến mãi & thuế VAT</span>
            </h3>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Giá gốc ban đầu (VNĐ)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="10000"
                value={m4Price}
                onChange={(e) => setM4Price(Math.max(0, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0))}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">% Giảm giá (Sale)</label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    max="100"
                    value={m4Discount}
                    onChange={(e) => setM4Discount(Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)))}
                    className="w-full h-12 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-base font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
                  />
                  <span className="w-10 h-12 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-700 text-xs">%</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">% Thuế VAT</label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    max="50"
                    value={m4Tax}
                    onChange={(e) => setM4Tax(Math.max(0, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0))}
                    className="w-full h-12 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-base font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
                  />
                  <span className="w-10 h-12 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-700 text-xs">%</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick sale chips */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
              {[10, 15, 20, 30, 50, 70].map((d) => (
                <button
                  key={d}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setM4Discount(d)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                    m4Discount === d ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  Giảm {d}%
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col justify-between bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Giá thanh toán cuối cùng</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => copyResult(`Giá thanh toán: ${formatNumber(m4Result.finalPrice)} đ (Tiết kiệm ${formatNumber(m4Result.discountAmount)} đ)`)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-600 font-medium hover:text-blue-800"
                >
                  {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#10B981]" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copied ? 'Đã chép' : 'Sao chép'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3">
                <span className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-[#10B981] font-mono tracking-tight">
                  {formatNumber(m4Result.finalPrice)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-600 ml-1">VNĐ</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200">

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { CircleDot, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { PerimeterVisualizer } from './geometry/PerimeterVisualizer';

type ShapeType = 'rectangle' | 'triangle' | 'circle' | 'polygon';

export const PerimeterCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [shape, setShape] = useState<ShapeType>('rectangle');
  const [v1, setV1] = useState<number>(10);
  const [v2, setV2] = useState<number>(6);
  const [v3, setV3] = useState<number>(8);
  const [polygonSides, setPolygonSides] = useState<number>(5);
  const [polygonSideLength, setPolygonSideLength] = useState<number>(4);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    let perimeter = 0;
    let formula = '';

    if (shape === 'rectangle') {
      perimeter = 2 * (v1 + v2);
      formula = `2 × (Dài + Rộng) = 2 × (${v1} + ${v2})`;
    } else if (shape === 'triangle') {
      perimeter = v1 + v2 + v3;
      formula = `a + b + c = ${v1} + ${v2} + ${v3}`;
    } else if (shape === 'circle') {
      perimeter = 2 * Math.PI * v1;
      formula = `2 × π × r = 2 × 3.14159 × ${v1}`;
    } else if (shape === 'polygon') {
      perimeter = polygonSides * polygonSideLength;
      formula = `Số cạnh × Độ dài cạnh = ${polygonSides} × ${polygonSideLength}`;
    }

    return {
      perimeter: Number(perimeter.toFixed(4)),
      formula
    };
  }, [shape, v1, v2, v3, polygonSides, polygonSideLength]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

            <CircleDot className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Perimeter Calculator – Tính Chu Vi Các Hình</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính chu vi hình chữ nhật, tam giác, đường tròn và đa giác đều</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="peri-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setShape('rectangle'); setV1(10); setV2(6); setV3(8); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Baby, Calendar, RotateCcw, Heart } from 'lucide-react';

export const PregnancyCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  // Method: lmp (Last Menstrual Period), conception (Conception Date), ivf (IVF Transfer)
  const [calcMethod, setCalcMethod] = useState<'lmp' | 'conception'>('lmp');
  
  // Default to 8 weeks ago
  const defaultLmp = new Date(Date.now() - 56 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
  const [inputDate, setInputDate] = useState<string>(defaultLmp);
  const [cycleLengthDays, setCycleLengthDays] = useState<number>(28);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const baseDate = new Date(inputDate);
    if (isNaN(baseDate.getTime())) {
      return null;
    }

    let dueDate = new Date(baseDate);
    let gestationalDays = 0;

    if (calcMethod === 'lmp') {
      // Naegele's rule: LMP + 280 days + (cycleLength - 28) days
      const cycleAdjustment = cycleLengthDays - 28;
      dueDate.setDate(dueDate.getDate() + 280 + cycleAdjustment);
      
      const today = new Date();
      gestationalDays = Math.floor((today.getTime() - baseDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    } else {
      // Conception date: Conception + 266 days
      dueDate.setDate(dueDate.getDate() + 266);
      
      const today = new Date();
      // Conception is gestational day 14 approximately
      gestationalDays = Math.floor((today.getTime() - baseDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 14;
    }

    const currentWeeks = Math.floor(gestationalDays / 7);
    const currentDays = gestationalDays % 7;
    const daysRemaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor((dueDate.getTime() - Date.now()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));

    // Trimester
    let trimester = 'Tam cá nguyệt thứ nhất (Tuần 1 - 13)';
    let trimesterColor = 'text-amber-400';
    if (currentWeeks >= 28) {
      trimester = 'Tam cá nguyệt thứ ba (Tuần 28 - 40+)';
      trimesterColor = 'text-rose-400';
    } else if (currentWeeks >= 14) {
      trimester = 'Tam cá nguyệt thứ hai (Tuần 14 - 27)';
      trimesterColor = 'text-teal-400';
    }

    return {
      dueDate: dueDate.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }),
      currentWeeks: Math.max(0, currentWeeks),
      currentDays: Math.max(0, currentDays),
      daysRemaining,
      trimester,
      trimesterColor,
      progressPercent: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((gestationalDays / 280) * 100)))
    };
  }, [inputDate, calcMethod, cycleLengthDays]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-pink-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-pink-600/20 text-pink-400 rounded-xl border border-pink-500/30">
            <Baby className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Pregnancy & Due Date Calculator – Tính Ngày Dự Sinh</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Dự đoán ngày sinh nở chính xác theo chu kỳ kinh nguyệt (LMP) hoặc ngày thụ thai</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="pregnancy-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setCalcMethod('lmp'); setInputDate(defaultLmp); setCycleLengthDays(28); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-pink-400" />
            Phương pháp tính toán
          </h2>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              id="calc-method-lmp"
              onClick={() => setCalcMethod('lmp')}
              className={`py-2 px-2 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
                calcMethod === 'lmp' ? 'bg-pink-600 text-white border-pink-500' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              Ngày đầu kỳ kinh cuối (LMP)
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              id="calc-method-conception"
              onClick={() => setCalcMethod('conception')}
              className={`py-2 px-2 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
                calcMethod === 'conception' ? 'bg-pink-600 text-white border-pink-500' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              Ngày thụ thai (Conception)
            </button>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              {calcMethod === 'lmp' ? 'Ngày đầu tiên của kỳ kinh nguyệt cuối cùng' : 'Ngày thụ thai ước tính'}
            </label>
            <input
              id="pregnancy-input-date"
              type="date"
              value={inputDate}
              onChange={(e) => setInputDate(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {calcMethod === 'lmp' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Độ dài chu kỳ kinh nguyệt bình thường (ngày)</label>
              <input
                id="pregnancy-cycle-length"
                type="number"
                value={cycleLengthDays}
                onChange={(e) => setCycleLengthDays(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {calculations && (
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-pink-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-pink-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-pink-300 font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                <Heart className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-pink-400 text-pink-400" />
                NGÀY DỰ SINH ƯỚC TÍNH (DUE DATE)
              </span>
              <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-pink-300 font-sans">
                {calculations.dueDate}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Còn khoảng <span className="text-pink-400 font-bold font-sans">{calculations.daysRemaining} ngày</span> nữa đến ngày đón bé yêu
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Tuổi thai hiện tại</span>
                <div className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold text-white font-sans">
                  {calculations.currentWeeks} tuần {calculations.currentDays} ngày
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Giai đoạn thai kỳ</span>
                <div className={`text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold ${calculations.trimesterColor}`}>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Dices, RotateCcw, Ticket } from 'lucide-react';
import { USLotteryCalculator } from './lottery/USLotteryCalculator';

export const ProbabilityCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  // Tab switcher: 'lottery' (US Lottery & System Bet) vs 'combinatorics' (Classical nPr, nCr, Independence)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'lottery' | 'combinatorics'>('lottery');

  const [n, setN] = useState<number>(10);
  const [r, setR] = useState<number>(3);
  const [probA, setProbA] = useState<number>(0.5);
  const [probB, setProbB] = useState<number>(0.3);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const validN = Math.max(0, Math.floor(n));
    const validR = Math.max(0, Math.min(validN, Math.floor(r)));

    // Permutations nPr = n! / (n - r)!
    let nPr = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < validR; i++) {
      nPr *= (validN - i);
    }

    // Combinations nCr = nPr / r!
    let rFact = 1;
    for (let i = 1; i <= validR; i++) {
      rFact *= i;
    }
    const nCr = nPr / rFact;

    // Two independent events A & B
    const pA = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probA));
    const pB = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probB));

    // P(A and B) = P(A) * P(B)
    const pAnd = pA * pB;
    // P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B)
    const pOr = pA + pB - pAnd;
    // P(not A)
    const pNotA = 1 - pA;

    return {
      nPr: Math.round(nPr),
      nCr: Math.round(nCr),
      pAnd: Number(pAnd.toFixed(4)),
      pOr: Number(pOr.toFixed(4)),
      pNotA: Number(pNotA.toFixed(4))
    };
  }, [n, r, probA, probB]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* Top Primary Navigation Tabs */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3 bg-slate-900/90 p-2 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 shadow-lg">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            id="tab-lottery-btn"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('lottery')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
              activeTab === 'lottery'
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 via-rose-600 to-indigo-600 text-white border-amber-400/50 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20'
                : 'text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 border-transparent'
            }`}
          >
            <Ticket className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-300" />
            <span>Xác Suất Xổ Số Mỹ & Đánh Bao Số</span>
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] bg-amber-400/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-400/30 font-sans uppercase tracking-wider font-extrabold">
              Mới
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            id="tab-combinatorics-btn"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('combinatorics')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
              activeTab === 'combinatorics'
                ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-400 shadow-md'
                : 'text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 border-transparent'
            }`}
          >
            <Dices className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            <span>Tổ Hợp (nCr, nPr) & Biến Cố</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {activeTab === 'combinatorics' && (
          <button
            id="prob-reset-btn"
            onClick={() => { setN(10); setR(3); setProbA(0.5); setProbB(0.3); }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ml-auto"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Variable, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { InteractiveGraphPlotter, KeyPoint } from './geometry/InteractiveGraphPlotter';
import { formatExactMath } from '../../utils/mathParser';

export const QuadraticCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [a, setA] = useState<number>(1);
  const [b, setB] = useState<number>(-5);
  const [c, setC] = useState<number>(6);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    if (a === 0) {
      // Linear equation bx + c = 0
      if (b === 0) {
        return {
          type: 'invalid',
          message: c === 0 ? 'Phương trình vô số nghiệm (0 = 0).' : 'Phương trình vô nghiệm.'
        };
      }
      const x = -c / b;
      const xExact = formatExactMath(x);
      return {
        type: 'linear',
        x1: xExact.exact || xExact.formatted,
        rawX1: x,
        message: `Đây là phương trình bậc nhất bx + c = 0 có nghiệm duy nhất x = ${xExact.exact || xExact.formatted}.`
      };
    }

    // Discriminant Delta = b^2 - 4ac
    const delta = b * b - 4 * a * c;
    const vertexX = -b / (2 * a);
    const vertexY = a * vertexX * vertexX + b * vertexX + c;
    const vxExact = formatExactMath(vertexX);
    const vyExact = formatExactMath(vertexY);

    if (delta > 0) {
      const sqrtDelta = Math.sqrt(delta);
      const x1 = (-b + sqrtDelta) / (2 * a);
      const x2 = (-b - sqrtDelta) / (2 * a);
      const x1Exact = formatExactMath(x1);
      const x2Exact = formatExactMath(x2);
      return {
        type: 'two_real',
        delta,
        x1: x1Exact.exact || x1Exact.formatted,
        x2: x2Exact.exact || x2Exact.formatted,
        rawX1: x1,
        rawX2: x2,
        vertexX: vxExact.exact || vxExact.formatted,
        vertexY: vyExact.exact || vyExact.formatted,
        rawVx: vertexX,
        rawVy: vertexY,
        message: `Biệt thức Δ = ${delta.toFixed(2)} > 0: Phương trình có 2 nghiệm thực phân biệt.`
      };
    } else if (delta === 0) {
      const x = -b / (2 * a);
      const xExact = formatExactMath(x);
      return {
        type: 'double_real',
        delta: 0,
        x1: xExact.exact || xExact.formatted,
        x2: xExact.exact || xExact.formatted,
        rawX1: x,
        rawX2: x,
        vertexX: vxExact.exact || vxExact.formatted,
        vertexY: vyExact.exact || vyExact.formatted,
        rawVx: vertexX,
        rawVy: vertexY,
        message: 'Biệt thức Δ = 0: Phương trình có nghiệm kép.'
      };
    } else {
      const realPart = -b / (2 * a);
      const imagPart = Math.sqrt(-delta) / (2 * a);
      const rpExact = formatExactMath(realPart);
      const ipExact = formatExactMath(Math.abs(imagPart));
      const rpStr = rpExact.exact || rpExact.formatted;
      const ipStr = ipExact.exact || ipExact.formatted;
      return {
        type: 'complex',
        delta,
        x1: `${rpStr} + ${ipStr}i`,
        x2: `${rpStr} - ${ipStr}i`,
        vertexX: vxExact.exact || vxExact.formatted,
        vertexY: vyExact.exact || vyExact.formatted,
        rawVx: vertexX,
        rawVy: vertexY,
        message: `Biệt thức Δ = ${delta.toFixed(2)} < 0: Phương trình không có nghiệm thực (2 nghiệm phức liên hợp).`
      };
    }
  }, [a, b, c]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Variable className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Quadratic Formula Calculator – Giải Phương Trình Bậc Hai</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Giải ax² + bx + c = 0, tính biệt thức Delta (Δ), nghiệm thực/phức và tọa độ đỉnh parabol</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="quad-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setA(1); setB(-5); setC(6); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Hệ số ax² + bx + c = 0</h2>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Hệ số a</label>
              <input
                id="quad-a"
                type="number"
                value={a}
                onChange={(e) => setA(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Hệ số b</label>
              <input
                id="quad-b"
                type="number"
                value={b}
                onChange={(e) => setB(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Hệ số c</label>
              <input
                id="quad-c"
                type="number"
                value={c}
                onChange={(e) => setC(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1">
            <div className="font-semibold text-blue-400">Phương trình đang xét:</div>
            <div className="font-mono text-white text-sm">
              {a}x² {b >= 0 ? `+ ${b}` : `- ${Math.abs(b)}`}x {c >= 0 ? `+ ${c}` : `- ${Math.abs(c)}`} = 0
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold block text-center">
              Nghiệm của phương trình
            </span>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-center">
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Nghiệm x₁</span>
                <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{calculations.x1}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Nghiệm x₂</span>
                <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{calculations.x2 || calculations.x1}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-center text-slate-300">{calculations.message}</p>
          </div>

          {calculations.vertexX !== undefined && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-300">
              <span>Tọa độ Đỉnh Parabol:</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white text-sm">
                I({calculations.vertexX}; {calculations.vertexY})
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          <InteractiveGraphPlotter
            expression={`${a}*x^2 ${b >= 0 ? `+ ${b}` : `- ${Math.abs(b)}`}*x ${c >= 0 ? `+ ${c}` : `- ${Math.abs(c)}`}`}
            title={`Đồ thị Parabol y = ${a}x² ${b >= 0 ? `+ ${b}` : `- ${Math.abs(b)}`}x ${c >= 0 ? `+ ${c}` : `- ${Math.abs(c)}`}`}
            keyPoints={useMemo(() => {
              const pts: KeyPoint[] = [];
              if (calculations.rawVx !== undefined && calculations.rawVy !== undefined) {
                pts.push({
                  x: calculations.rawVx,
                  y: calculations.rawVy,
                  label: `Đỉnh I(${calculations.vertexX}; ${calculations.vertexY})`,
                  type: 'vertex',
                  color: a > 0 ? '#fbbf24' : '#34d399'
                });
              }
              if (calculations.type === 'two_real' && calculations.rawX1 !== undefined && calculations.rawX2 !== undefined) {
                pts.push({
                  x: calculations.rawX1,
                  y: 0,
                  label: `x₁ = ${calculations.x1}`,
                  type: 'root',
                  color: '#38bdf8'
                });
                pts.push({
                  x: calculations.rawX2,
                  y: 0,
                  label: `x₂ = ${calculations.x2}`,
                  type: 'root',
                  color: '#38bdf8'
                });
              } else if (calculations.type === 'double_real' && calculations.rawX1 !== undefined) {
                pts.push({
                  x: calculations.rawX1,
                  y: 0,
                  label: `Nghiệm kép x = ${calculations.x1}`,
                  type: 'root',
                  color: '#38bdf8'
                });
              }
              // y-intercept (0, c): only if non-zero
              if (Math.abs(c) > 1e-4) {
                const cExact = formatExactMath(c);
                pts.push({
                  x: 0,
                  y: c,
                  label: `Oy (0; ${cExact.exact || cExact.formatted})`,
                  type: 'y-intercept',
                  color: '#c084fc'
                });
              }
              return pts;
            }, [calculations, a, c])}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Dice5,
  Shuffle,
  RotateCcw,
  Check,
  Copy,
  Trophy
} from 'lucide-react';

export const RandomNumberCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'range' | 'dice' | 'picker'>('range');

  // Mode 1: Range
  const [minVal, setMinVal] = useState<number>(1);
  const [maxVal, setMaxVal] = useState<number>(100);
  const [count, setCount] = useState<number>(5);
  const [allowDuplicates, setAllowDuplicates] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [sortResult, setSortResult] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [generatedNumbers, setGeneratedNumbers] = useState<number[]>([7, 23, 42, 68, 91]);

  // Mode 2: Dice
  const [diceSides, setDiceSides] = useState<number>(6);
  const [diceCount, setDiceCount] = useState<number>(2);
  const [diceRolls, setDiceRolls] = useState<number[]>([4, 6]);

  // Mode 3: Picker
  const [namesText, setNamesText] = useState<string>('Nguyễn Văn A\nTrần Thị B\nLê Hoàng C\nPhạm Minh D\nVũ Thu Trang\nĐặng Quốc Tuấn');
  const [winner, setWinner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const generateRandomNumbers = () => {
    const effectiveMin = Math.min(minVal, maxVal);
    const effectiveMax = Math.max(minVal, maxVal);
    const rangeSpan = effectiveMax - effectiveMin + 1;

    let results: number[] = [];
    if (!allowDuplicates && count <= rangeSpan) {
      const pool = Array.from({ length: rangeSpan }, (_, i) => effectiveMin + i);
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const randIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length);
        results.push(pool[randIdx]);
        pool.splice(randIdx, 1);
      }
    } else {
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        results.push(Math.floor(Math.random() * rangeSpan) + effectiveMin);
      }
    }

    if (sortResult) {
      results.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    }
    setGeneratedNumbers(results);
  };

  const rollDice = () => {
    const rolls = Array.from({ length: diceCount }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * diceSides) + 1);
    setDiceRolls(rolls);
  };

  const pickWinner = () => {
    const list = namesText.split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (list.length === 0) return;
    const rand = Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length);
    setWinner(list[rand]);
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    let text = '';
    if (tab === 'range') {
      text = `Dãy số ngẫu nhiên [${minVal} - ${maxVal}]: ${generatedNumbers.join(', ')}`;
    } else if (tab === 'dice') {
      const sum = diceRolls.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      text = `Tung ${diceCount} xúc xắc d${diceSides}: ${diceRolls.join(' + ')} = ${sum}`;
    } else {
      text = `Người may mắn trúng thưởng: ${winner || 'Chưa quay'}`;
    }
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="random-number-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 border border-amber-100">
              <Dice5 className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Random Number Generator (Quay Số Ngẫu Nhiên)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Bộ công cụ tạo số ngẫu nhiên chuẩn mật mã, tung xúc xắc đa diện và bốc thăm quay thưởng.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 p-1.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl w-fit">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setTab('range')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            tab === 'range' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Tạo số trong khoảng (Min - Max)
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setTab('dice')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            tab === 'dice' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Tung xúc xắc (Dice Roller)
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setTab('picker')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            tab === 'picker' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Bốc thăm may mắn (Lucky Draw)
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1: Range */}
      {tab === 'range' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">Cấu hình khoảng số</h3>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Số nhỏ nhất (Min):</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={minVal}

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { PiggyBank, RotateCcw, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

export const RetirementCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [currentAge, setCurrentAge] = useState<number>(30);
  const [retireAge, setRetireAge] = useState<number>(60);
  const [lifeExpectancy, setLifeExpectancy] = useState<number>(85);

  const [currentSavings, setCurrentSavings] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 500000000 : 20000;
  });
  const [monthlyContribution, setMonthlyContribution] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 10000000 : 500;
  });
  const [preRetireReturn, setPreRetireReturn] = useState<number>(7.0);
  const [postRetireReturn, setPostRetireReturn] = useState<number>(5.0);
  const [desiredMonthlyIncome, setDesiredMonthlyIncome] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 25000000 : 2500;
  });

  // Synchronize when currency changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      setCurrentSavings((prev) => (prev < 100000 ? 500000000 : prev));
      setMonthlyContribution((prev) => (prev < 5000 ? 10000000 : prev));
      setDesiredMonthlyIncome((prev) => (prev < 10000 ? 25000000 : prev));
    } else {
      setCurrentSavings((prev) => (prev >= 1000000 ? 20000 : prev));
      setMonthlyContribution((prev) => (prev >= 100000 ? 500 : prev));
      setDesiredMonthlyIncome((prev) => (prev >= 100000 ? 2500 : prev));
    }
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const yearsToSave = Math.max(1, retireAge - currentAge);
    const monthsToSave = yearsToSave * 12;
    const monthlyRate = (preRetireReturn / 100) / 12;

    // Future Value of current savings: PV * (1 + r)^n
    const fvCurrentSavings = currentSavings * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, monthsToSave);

    // Future Value of monthly contributions: PMT * [((1 + r)^n - 1) / r]
    let fvContributions = 0;
    if (monthlyRate > 0) {
      fvContributions = monthlyContribution * ((Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, monthsToSave) - 1) / monthlyRate);
    } else {
      fvContributions = monthlyContribution * monthsToSave;
    }

    const totalNestEggAtRetire = fvCurrentSavings + fvContributions;

    // 4% Safe Withdrawal Rule per year / month
    const safeMonthlyWithdrawal = (totalNestEggAtRetire * 0.04) / 12;

    // Years in retirement
    const yearsInRetirement = Math.max(1, lifeExpectancy - retireAge);
    const postMonthlyRate = (postRetireReturn / 100) / 12;
    const postMonths = yearsInRetirement * 12;

    // Present value of desired monthly income during retirement
    let requiredNestEgg = 0;
    if (postMonthlyRate > 0) {
      requiredNestEgg = desiredMonthlyIncome * ((1 - Math.pow(1 + postMonthlyRate, -postMonths)) / postMonthlyRate);
    } else {
      requiredNestEgg = desiredMonthlyIncome * postMonths;
    }

    const surplusOrShortfall = totalNestEggAtRetire - requiredNestEgg;

    return {
      yearsToSave,
      yearsInRetirement,
      totalNestEggAtRetire,
      safeMonthlyWithdrawal,
      requiredNestEgg,
      surplusOrShortfall
    };
  }, [currentAge, retireAge, lifeExpectancy, currentSavings, monthlyContribution, preRetireReturn, postRetireReturn, desiredMonthlyIncome]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setCurrentAge(30);
    setRetireAge(60);
    setLifeExpectancy(85);
    setCurrentSavings(currency === 'VND' ? 500000000 : 20000);
    setMonthlyContribution(currency === 'VND' ? 10000000 : 500);
    setPreRetireReturn(7.0);
    setPostRetireReturn(5.0);
    setDesiredMonthlyIncome(currency === 'VND' ? 25000000 : 2500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-amber-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-amber-600/20 text-amber-400 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30">
            <PiggyBank className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Retirement Calculator – Lập Kế Hoạch Nghỉ Hưu</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Dự phóng quỹ hưu trí, số tiền rút an toàn theo quy tắc 4% và mục tiêu tiết kiệm</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="retirement-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
            Độ tuổi & Tiết kiệm
          </h2>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Tuổi hiện tại</label>
              <input
                id="retire-current-age"
                type="number"
                value={currentAge}
                onChange={(e) => setCurrentAge(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Tuổi nghỉ hưu</label>
              <input
                id="retire-target-age"
                type="number"
                value={retireAge}
                onChange={(e) => setRetireAge(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Kỳ vọng sống</label>
              <input
                id="retire-life-expectancy"
                type="number"
                value={lifeExpectancy}
                onChange={(e) => setLifeExpectancy(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Đã tích lũy ({currencyInfo.symbol})

              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  id="retire-current-savings"
                  type="number"
                  step={currency === 'VND' ? 10000000 : 500}
                  value={currentSavings}
                  onChange={(e) => setCurrentSavings(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full pl-3 pr-10 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 outline-none"
                />
                <span className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Góp mỗi tháng ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  id="retire-monthly-contrib"
                  type="number"
                  step={currency === 'VND' ? 500000 : 50}
                  value={monthlyContribution}
                  onChange={(e) => setMonthlyContribution(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full pl-3 pr-10 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 outline-none"
                />
                <span className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Triangle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { RightTriangleVisualizer } from './geometry/RightTriangleVisualizer';

export const RightTriangleCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [legA, setLegA] = useState<number>(3);
  const [legB, setLegB] = useState<number>(4);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const a = Math.max(0.0001, legA);
    const b = Math.max(0.0001, legB);

    // Hypotenuse c = sqrt(a^2 + b^2)
    const c = Math.sqrt(a * a + b * b);

    // Angles
    const angleARad = Math.atan(a / b);
    const angleBRad = Math.atan(b / a);

    const angleADeg = (angleARad * 180) / Math.PI;
    const angleBDeg = (angleBRad * 180) / Math.PI;

    // Area and Perimeter
    const area = 0.5 * a * b;
    const perimeter = a + b + c;

    // Altitude to hypotenuse
    const altitudeC = (a * b) / c;

    return {
      c: c.toFixed(4),
      angleA: angleADeg.toFixed(2),
      angleB: angleBDeg.toFixed(2),
      area: area.toFixed(4),
      perimeter: perimeter.toFixed(4),
      altitudeC: altitudeC.toFixed(4)
    };
  }, [legA, legB]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Triangle className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Right Triangle Calculator – Tính Tam Giác Vuông</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Định lý Pytago, cạnh huyền c, 2 góc nhọn, diện tích và đường cao hạ từ đỉnh góc vuông</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="rt-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setLegA(3); setLegB(4); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Độ dài hai cạnh góc vuông</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cạnh góc vuông a</label>
            <input
              id="rt-leg-a"
              type="number"
              value={legA}
              onChange={(e) => setLegA(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cạnh góc vuông b</label>
            <input
              id="rt-leg-b"
              type="number"
              value={legB}
              onChange={(e) => setLegB(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1">
            <div className="font-semibold text-blue-400">Định lý Pytago:</div>
            <div className="font-mono text-white">c = √(a² + b²) = √({legA}² + {legB}²)</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">CẠNH HUYỀN (HYPOTENUSE c)</span>
            <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {calculations.c}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Góc α đối diện cạnh a: <span className="text-white font-bold">{calculations.angleA}°</span> | Góc β đối diện cạnh b: <span className="text-white font-bold">{calculations.angleB}°</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Diện tích</span>
              <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.area}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Chu vi</span>
              <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.perimeter}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Đường cao hc</span>
              <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.altitudeC}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <RightTriangleVisualizer
            legA={legA}
            legB={legB}
            hypotenuse={calculations.c}
            angleA={calculations.angleA}
            angleB={calculations.angleB}
            altitudeC={calculations.altitudeC}
            area={calculations.area}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Radical, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const RootCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [radicand, setRadicand] = useState<number>(64);
  const [degree, setDegree] = useState<number>(2);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const x = radicand;
    const n = degree === 0 ? 1 : degree;

    if (x < 0 && n % 2 === 0) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Căn bậc chẵn của một số âm không phải là số thực (kết quả thuộc tập số phức).'
      };
    }

    let result = 0;
    if (x < 0) {
      result = -Math.pow(Math.abs(x), 1 / n);
    } else {
      result = Math.pow(x, 1 / n);
    }

    return {
      isValid: true,
      result: Number(result.toFixed(8)),
      exponentialForm: `${x}^(1/${n})`
    };
  }, [radicand, degree]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Radical className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Root Calculator – Máy Tính Căn Bậc Hai & Bậc N</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Khai căn chính xác cho mọi bậc n (căn bậc 2, căn bậc 3, căn bậc n)</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="root-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setRadicand(64); setDegree(2); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Thông số căn thức</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Bậc của căn (n)</label>
            <input
              id="root-degree"
              type="number"
              value={degree}
              onChange={(e) => setDegree(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Số dưới dấu căn (x)</label>
            <input
              id="root-radicand"
              type="number"
              value={radicand}
              onChange={(e) => setRadicand(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
            {[2, 3, 4, 5].map((d) => (
              <button
                key={d}
                type="button"
                id={`preset-root-${d}`}
                onClick={() => setDegree(d)}
                className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg border transition-colors ${
                  degree === d ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 font-bold' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Bậc {d}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {!calculations.isValid ? (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200 text-sm">
              {calculations.message}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">
                ^{degree}√({radicand})
              </span>
              <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                {calculations.result}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Dưới dạng lũy thừa số mũ hữu tỉ: <span className="text-white font-mono">{calculations.exponentialForm}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
