import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Receipt,
  Users,
  Check,
  Copy
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

export const TipCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  // Base bill amount in selected currency ($85 USD base)
  const [billAmount, setBillAmount] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 500000 : 85;
  });
  const [tipPercent, setTipPercent] = useState<number>(18);
  const [peopleCount, setPeopleCount] = useState<number>(3);
  const [roundUp, setRoundUp] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Sync default bill amount when switching currency
  useEffect(() => {
    setBillAmount((prev) => {
      if (currency === 'VND' && prev < 1000) return 500000;
      if (currency !== 'VND' && prev >= 10000) return 85;
      return prev;
    });
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const rawTip = (billAmount * tipPercent) / 100;
    let totalBill = billAmount + rawTip;

    if (roundUp) {
      totalBill = Math.ceil(totalBill);
    }

    const finalTip = Math.max(0, totalBill - billAmount);
    const tipPerPerson = peopleCount > 0 ? finalTip / peopleCount : 0;
    const totalPerPerson = peopleCount > 0 ? totalBill / peopleCount : 0;
    const billPerPerson = peopleCount > 0 ? billAmount / peopleCount : 0;

    return {
      finalTip,
      totalBill,
      tipPerPerson,
      totalPerPerson,
      billPerPerson
    };
  }, [billAmount, tipPercent, peopleCount, roundUp]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const text = `Chia hóa đơn & Tiền Tip:
- Hóa đơn gốc: ${formatMoney(billAmount)}
- Tiền tip (${tipPercent}%): ${formatMoney(calculations.finalTip)}
- Tổng hóa đơn: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalBill)}
- Chia ${peopleCount} người:
  + Mỗi người trả: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalPerPerson)}
  + (Tiền món: ${formatMoney(calculations.billPerPerson)} + Tip: ${formatMoney(calculations.tipPerPerson)})`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="tip-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 border border-emerald-100">
              <Receipt className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Tip Calculator (Tính Tiền Tip &amp; Chia Bill)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính toán tiền tip theo chuẩn quốc tế và chia đều hóa đơn cho nhóm bạn hoặc gia đình.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            onClick={handleCopy}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
            <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Form Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Bill Amount */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Tổng hóa đơn ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
              </label>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600 font-mono">
                {formatMoney(billAmount)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400 font-bold text-base">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 10000 : 1}
                value={billAmount}
                onChange={(e) => setBillAmount(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value)))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-2xl text-lg font-black text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-4 top-3 text-slate-400 font-bold text-xs">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pt-1">
              {(currency === 'VND' 
                ? [100000, 200000, 500000, 1000000, 2000000]
                : [25, 50, 85, 120, 200]
              ).map((v) => (
                <button
                  key={v}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setBillAmount(v)}
                  className={`text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    billAmount === v
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-600'
                      : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {currency === 'VND' ? `${v / 1000}k` : `${currencyInfo.symbol}${v}`}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tip Percentage Selection */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Chọn mức tiền Tip (%)
              </label>
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-600 font-mono">
                {tipPercent}%
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1.5">
              {[10, 15, 18, 20, 25].map((pct) => (
                <button
                  key={pct}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTipPercent(pct)}
                  className={`py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    tipPercent === pct
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-xs scale-102 font-black'
                      : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {pct}%
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">Tùy chỉnh:</span>
              <input
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={50}
                value={tipPercent}
                onChange={(e) => setTipPercent(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="flex-1 accent-emerald-600 cursor-pointer"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Number of People */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" /> Số người chia tiền
              </label>
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono">
                {peopleCount} người
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPeopleCount(Math.max(1, peopleCount - 1))}
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-300 font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                -
              </button>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={100}
                value={peopleCount}
                onChange={(e) => setPeopleCount(Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)))}
                className="flex-1 p-2 text-center bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-black text-slate-900 outline-none"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPeopleCount(peopleCount + 1)}
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-300 font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                +
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Round up checkbox */}
            <div className="pt-2">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none text-xs text-slate-700 font-semibold">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={roundUp}
                  onChange={(e) => setRoundUp(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-emerald-600 accent-emerald-600 cursor-pointer"
                />
                <span>Làm tròn tổng hóa đơn lên số nguyên gần nhất</span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output Receipt */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Main Per Person Hero */}
          <div className="hero-result-card bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-900 via-slate-900 to-teal-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300">
              Số tiền mỗi người cần trả ({peopleCount} người)
            </span>

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-white">
                {formatMoney(calculations.totalPerPerson)}
              </span>
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-200">/ người</span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800 text-xs">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-700/50">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block mb-0.5">Tiền món mỗi người</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-mono">
                  {formatMoney(calculations.billPerPerson)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-700/50">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block mb-0.5">Tiền tip mỗi người</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-400 font-mono">
                  {formatMoney(calculations.tipPerPerson)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Grand Totals */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Tổng kết toàn bộ bàn ăn
            </span>

            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-2 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-600">Hóa đơn ban đầu:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono">{formatMoney(billAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-2 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Triangle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { TriangleVisualizer } from './geometry/TriangleVisualizer';

export const TriangleCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [sideA, setSideA] = useState<number>(5);
  const [sideB, setSideB] = useState<number>(6);
  const [sideC, setSideC] = useState<number>(7);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const a = Math.max(0.001, sideA);
    const b = Math.max(0.001, sideB);
    const c = Math.max(0.001, sideC);

    // Triangle inequality theorem check
    const isValid = (a + b > c) && (a + c > b) && (b + c > a);

    if (!isValid) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Ba cạnh không thỏa mãn bất đẳng thức tam giác (tổng độ dài 2 cạnh bất kỳ phải lớn hơn cạnh còn lại).'
      };
    }

    // Law of Cosines: cos(A) = (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) / (2bc)
    const cosA = (b * b + c * c - a * a) / (2 * b * c);
    const cosB = (a * a + c * c - b * b) / (2 * a * c);
    const cosC = (a * a + b * b - c * c) / (2 * a * b);

    const angleARad = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosA)));
    const angleBRad = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosB)));
    const angleCRad = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosC)));

    const angleADeg = (angleARad * 180) / Math.PI;
    const angleBDeg = (angleBRad * 180) / Math.PI;
    const angleCDeg = (angleCRad * 180) / Math.PI;

    // Perimeter & Semi-perimeter
    const perimeter = a + b + c;
    const s = perimeter / 2;

    // Heron's Formula for Area: sqrt(s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c))
    const area = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c)));

    // Altitudes
    const heightA = (2 * area) / a;
    const heightB = (2 * area) / b;
    const heightC = (2 * area) / c;

    // Type of triangle
    let type = 'Tam giác thường (Scalene)';
    if (Math.abs(a - b) < 1e-4 && Math.abs(b - c) < 1e-4) {
      type = 'Tam giác đều (Equilateral)';
    } else if (Math.abs(a - b) < 1e-4 || Math.abs(b - c) < 1e-4 || Math.abs(a - c) < 1e-4) {
      type = 'Tam giác cân (Isosceles)';
    }

    if (Math.abs(angleADeg - 90) < 0.05 || Math.abs(angleBDeg - 90) < 0.05 || Math.abs(angleCDeg - 90) < 0.05) {
      type += ' & Vuông (Right-angled)';
    } else if (angleADeg > 90 || angleBDeg > 90 || angleCDeg > 90) {
      type += ' & Tù (Obtuse)';
    } else {
      type += ' & Nhọn (Acute)';
    }

    return {
      isValid: true,
      angleA: angleADeg.toFixed(2),
      angleB: angleBDeg.toFixed(2),
      angleC: angleCDeg.toFixed(2),
      perimeter: perimeter.toFixed(2),
      semiPerimeter: s.toFixed(2),
      area: area.toFixed(2),
      heightA: heightA.toFixed(2),
      heightB: heightB.toFixed(2),
      heightC: heightC.toFixed(2),
      type
    };
  }, [sideA, sideB, sideC]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Triangle className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Triangle Calculator – Tính Toán Hình Tam Giác</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Giải tam giác theo 3 cạnh (SSS): tính diện tích Heron, 3 góc, chu vi và đường cao</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="triangle-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setSideA(5); setSideB(6); setSideC(7); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Độ dài 3 cạnh tam giác</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cạnh a</label>
            <input
              id="triangle-side-a"
              type="number"
              value={sideA}
              onChange={(e) => setSideA(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cạnh b</label>
            <input
              id="triangle-side-b"
              type="number"
              value={sideB}
              onChange={(e) => setSideB(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cạnh c</label>
            <input
              id="triangle-side-c"
              type="number"
              value={sideC}
              onChange={(e) => setSideC(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {!calculations.isValid ? (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200">
              {calculations.message}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">Diện tích tam giác (Công thức Heron)</span>
                <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.area}
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  Phân loại hình học: <span className="text-white font-semibold">{calculations.type}</span>
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Góc A</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.angleA}°</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Góc B</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.angleB}°</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Góc C</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.angleC}°</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Chu vi tam giác</span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.perimeter}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Nửa chu vi (p)</span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.semiPerimeter}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <TriangleVisualizer
                sideA={sideA}
                sideB={sideB}
                sideC={sideC}
                isValid={calculations.isValid}
                angleA={calculations.angleA}
                angleB={calculations.angleB}
                angleC={calculations.angleC}
                area={calculations.area}
                type={calculations.type}
              />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

  300: { sin: '-√3/2', cos: '1/2', tan: '-√3', cot: '-√3/3', sec: '2', csc: '-2√3/3' },
  315: { sin: '-√2/2', cos: '√2/2', tan: '-1', cot: '-1', sec: '√2', csc: '-√2' },
  330: { sin: '-1/2', cos: '√3/2', tan: '-√3/3', cot: '-√3', sec: '2√3/3', csc: '-2' },
  360: { sin: '0', cos: '1', tan: '0', cot: 'Không xác định', sec: '1', csc: 'Không xác định' },
};

export const TrigonometryCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TrigTab>('functions');
  const [angleUnit, setAngleUnit] = useState<AngleUnit>('deg');
  const [angleInput, setAngleInput] = useState<number>(30);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Right Triangle Solver inputs
  // a: adjacent/side 1, b: opposite/side 2, c: hypotenuse, angleA: acute angle in deg
  const [sideA, setSideA] = useState<number>(3);
  const [sideB, setSideB] = useState<number>(4);

  // Waveform Graph inputs
  const [waveFunc, setWaveFunc] = useState<'sin' | 'cos' | 'tan'>('sin');
  const [waveAmp, setWaveAmp] = useState<number>(1);
  const [waveFreq, setWaveFreq] = useState<number>(1);
  const [wavePhase, setWavePhase] = useState<number>(0);

  // Angle in radians for math functions
  const angleInRad = useMemo(() => {
    return angleUnit === 'deg' ? (angleInput * Math.PI) / 180 : angleInput;
  }, [angleInput, angleUnit]);

  // Check if angle corresponds to a special degree angle modulo 360
  const specialKey = useMemo(() => {
    const deg = angleUnit === 'deg' ? angleInput : (angleInput * 180) / Math.PI;
    const rounded = Math.round(deg);
    if (Math.abs(deg - rounded) < 1e-4) {
      const normalized = ((rounded % 360) + 360) % 360;
      if (SPECIAL_TRIG_TABLE[normalized]) {
        return normalized;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }, [angleInput, angleUnit]);

  // Trig function values (both exact formula & decimal values)
  const trigValues = useMemo(() => {
    const sinVal = Math.sin(angleInRad);
    const cosVal = Math.cos(angleInRad);
    
    // Tan undefined near 90 + k*180 deg
    const isTanUndefined = Math.abs(cosVal) < 1e-12;
    const tanVal = isTanUndefined ? Infinity : Math.tan(angleInRad);

    // Cot undefined near k*180 deg
    const isCotUndefined = Math.abs(sinVal) < 1e-12;
    const cotVal = isCotUndefined ? Infinity : 1 / tanVal;

    const secVal = Math.abs(cosVal) < 1e-12 ? Infinity : 1 / cosVal;
    const cscVal = Math.abs(sinVal) < 1e-12 ? Infinity : 1 / sinVal;

    const formatVal = (v: number) => {
      if (!isFinite(v)) return 'Không xác định (∞)';
      const rounded = Number(v.toFixed(6));
      return rounded.toString();
    };

    const special = specialKey !== null ? SPECIAL_TRIG_TABLE[specialKey] : null;

    const makeResult = (val: number, specialExact?: string): TrigResult => {
      const isUndef = !isFinite(val) || specialExact === 'Không xác định';
      return {
        exact: specialExact && specialExact !== 'Không xác định' ? specialExact : null,
        decimal: isUndef ? 'Không xác định (∞)' : formatVal(val),
        isUndefined: isUndef
      };
    };

    return {
      sin: makeResult(sinVal, special?.sin),
      cos: makeResult(cosVal, special?.cos),
      tan: makeResult(tanVal, special?.tan),
      cot: makeResult(cotVal, special?.cot),
      sec: makeResult(secVal, special?.sec),
      csc: makeResult(cscVal, special?.csc),
      isSpecialAngle: special !== null,
      specialDegree: specialKey
    };
  }, [angleInRad, specialKey]);

  // Triangle solver calculation (from a and b)
  const triangleData = useMemo(() => {
    const a = Math.max(0.1, sideA);
    const b = Math.max(0.1, sideB);
    const c = Math.sqrt(a * a + b * b); // hypotenuse

    const angleADeg = (Math.atan2(b, a) * 180) / Math.PI;
    const angleBDeg = 90 - angleADeg;

    const area = (a * b) / 2;
    const perimeter = a + b + c;

    return {
      a: Number(a.toFixed(3)),
      b: Number(b.toFixed(3)),
      c: Number(c.toFixed(3)),
      angleA: Number(angleADeg.toFixed(2)),
      angleB: Number(angleBDeg.toFixed(2)),
      area: Number(area.toFixed(3)),
      perimeter: Number(perimeter.toFixed(3)),
    };
  }, [sideA, sideB]);

  const copyResult = (text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6">
      
      {/* Sub-tabs: Functions vs Triangle Solver */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-xl">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('functions')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all ${
              activeTab === 'functions' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
            }`}
          >
            Bảng tính Sin / Cos / Tan
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('triangle_solver')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all ${
              activeTab === 'triangle_solver' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
            }`}
          >
            Giải tam giác vuông trực quan
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('waveform_graph')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'waveform_graph' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
            }`}
          >
            <LineChart className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đồ thị Sin / Cos / Tan</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {activeTab === 'functions' && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-xl">
            <button
              onClick={() => setAngleUnit('deg')}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all ${
                angleUnit === 'deg' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
              }`}
            >
              Độ (Degrees °)
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setAngleUnit('rad')}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all ${
                angleUnit === 'rad' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600'
              }`}
            >
              Radian (rad)
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1: Functions View */}
      {activeTab === 'functions' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block">
                Nhập góc α ({angleUnit === 'deg' ? 'Độ °' : 'Radian'})
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step={angleUnit === 'deg' ? '1' : '0.01'}
                value={angleInput}
                onChange={(e) => setAngleInput(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                className="w-full h-14 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Quick angle presets */}
            <div className="pt-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-medium">Góc đặc biệt phổ biến:</span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-1.5">
                {[0, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180, 270, 360].map((deg) => (
                  <button
                    key={deg}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setAngleUnit('deg');
                      setAngleInput(deg);
                    }}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                      angleUnit === 'deg' && angleInput === deg ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {deg}°
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 bg-blue-50/60 rounded-xl border border-blue-100 text-xs text-blue-900 space-y-1">
              <span className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                Hệ thức lượng cơ bản
              </span>
              <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
                sin²(α) + cos²(α) = 1 &nbsp;|&nbsp; tan(α) × cot(α) = 1 &nbsp;|&nbsp; 1 + tan²(α) = 1 / cos²(α)
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600">
                  Giá Trị Các Hàm Lượng Giác (α = {angleInput}{angleUnit === 'deg' ? '°' : ' rad'})
                </span>
                {trigValues.isSpecialAngle && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-700 bg-blue-100/90 border border-blue-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                    Góc đặc biệt chuẩn SGK
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => copyResult(`sin(${angleInput}) = ${trigValues.sin.exact || trigValues.sin.decimal}, cos(${angleInput}) = ${trigValues.cos.exact || trigValues.cos.decimal}, tan(${angleInput}) = ${trigValues.tan.exact || trigValues.tan.decimal}`)}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-600 font-semibold hover:text-blue-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer self-start sm:self-auto"
              >
                {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#10B981]" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                <span>{copied ? 'Đã chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              {/* sin */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 block">sin(α)</span>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-[#10B981] font-mono tracking-tight block">
                    {trigValues.sin.exact || trigValues.sin.decimal}
                  </span>
                  {trigValues.sin.exact && trigValues.sin.exact !== trigValues.sin.decimal && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                      ≈ {trigValues.sin.decimal}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* cos */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 block">cos(α)</span>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-blue-600 font-mono tracking-tight block">
                    {trigValues.cos.exact || trigValues.cos.decimal}
                  </span>
                  {trigValues.cos.exact && trigValues.cos.exact !== trigValues.cos.decimal && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                      ≈ {trigValues.cos.decimal}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* tan */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 block">tan(α)</span>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-purple-600 font-mono tracking-tight block">
                    {trigValues.tan.exact || trigValues.tan.decimal}
                  </span>
                  {trigValues.tan.exact && trigValues.tan.exact !== trigValues.tan.decimal && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                      ≈ {trigValues.tan.decimal}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* cot */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 block">cot(α)</span>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono tracking-tight block">
                    {trigValues.cot.exact || trigValues.cot.decimal}
                  </span>
                  {trigValues.cot.exact && trigValues.cot.exact !== trigValues.cot.decimal && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                      ≈ {trigValues.cot.decimal}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* sec */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 block">sec(α) = 1/cos</span>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono tracking-tight block">
                    {trigValues.sec.exact || trigValues.sec.decimal}
                  </span>
                  {trigValues.sec.exact && trigValues.sec.exact !== trigValues.sec.decimal && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                      ≈ {trigValues.sec.decimal}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* csc */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 block">csc(α) = 1/sin</span>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono tracking-tight block">
                    {trigValues.csc.exact || trigValues.csc.decimal}
                  </span>
                  {trigValues.csc.exact && trigValues.csc.exact !== trigValues.csc.decimal && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                      ≈ {trigValues.csc.decimal}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Explanation Note for Mathematical vs Decimal representations */}
            {trigValues.isSpecialAngle && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/90 rounded-xl border border-blue-200/80 text-xs text-slate-700 space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-blue-900">
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 shrink-0" />
                  <span>Quy đổi căn thức chính xác trong SGK Toán ({trigValues.specialDegree}°):</span>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-800 pl-1">
                  <div>• cos({trigValues.specialDegree}°) = <strong>{trigValues.cos.exact}</strong> ≈ {trigValues.cos.decimal}</div>
                  <div>• tan({trigValues.specialDegree}°) = <strong>{trigValues.tan.exact}</strong> ≈ {trigValues.tan.decimal}</div>
                  <div>• sin({trigValues.specialDegree}°) = <strong>{trigValues.sin.exact}</strong> ≈ {trigValues.sin.decimal}</div>
                  <div>• cot({trigValues.specialDegree}°) = <strong>{trigValues.cot.exact}</strong> ≈ {trigValues.cot.decimal}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: Right-Triangle Solver with Dynamic SVG */}
      {activeTab === 'triangle_solver' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
              Nhập kích thước 2 cạnh góc vuông
            </h3>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Cạnh đáy a (Kề)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.5"
                min="0.1"
                value={sideA}
                onChange={(e) => setSideA(Math.max(0.1, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0.1))}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Cạnh đứng b (Đối)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.5"
                min="0.1"
                value={sideB}
                onChange={(e) => setSideB(Math.max(0.1, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0.1))}
                className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Quick Pythagorean triples */}
            <div className="pt-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-medium">Bộ 3 số Pythagoras kinh điển:</span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { setSideA(3); setSideB(4); }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-lg"
                >
                  3 - 4 - 5
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { setSideA(5); setSideB(12); }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-lg"
                >
                  5 - 12 - 13
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { setSideA(8); setSideB(15); }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-lg"
                >
                  8 - 15 - 17
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 border border-slate-200 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4">
            
            {/* SVG Visual Right Triangle */}
            <div className="h-44 w-full bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center p-3 relative overflow-hidden shadow-inner">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 240 140" className="w-full h-full max-w-xs">
                {/* Right Triangle: vertices at (30, 110), (190, 110), (190, 30) */}
                <polygon
                  points="40,115 200,115 200,25"
                  className="fill-blue-500/10 stroke-blue-600"
                  strokeWidth="2.5"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                />
                {/* Right angle square indicator at (200, 115) */}
                <path
                  d="M 185,115 L 185,100 L 200,100"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="#3B82F6"
                  strokeWidth="1.5"
                />
                {/* Labels */}
                <text x="120" y="130" textAnchor="middle" className="text-[11px] fill-slate-700 font-bold font-mono">
                  a = {triangleData.a}
                </text>
                <text x="210" y="75" textAnchor="start" className="text-[11px] fill-slate-700 font-bold font-mono">
                  b = {triangleData.b}
                </text>
                <text x="110" y="60" textAnchor="middle" className="text-[11px] fill-emerald-600 font-bold font-mono">
                  c = {triangleData.c}
                </text>
                {/* Angle α at bottom left */}
                <text x="55" y="110" className="text-[10px] fill-purple-600 font-bold">
                  {triangleData.angleA}°
                </text>
              </svg>
            </div>

            {/* Results Grid */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 pt-1">
              <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-semibold block">Cạnh huyền (c)</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-black text-[#10B981] font-mono block mt-0.5">
                  {triangleData.c}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-semibold block">Góc đáy A</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-bold text-purple-600 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                  {triangleData.angleA}°
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-semibold block">Diện tích (S)</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                  {triangleData.area}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-semibold block">Chu vi (P)</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                  {triangleData.perimeter}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 3: Waveform Graph with InteractiveGraphPlotter */}
      {activeTab === 'waveform_graph' && (
        <div className="space-y-5 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1.5">Hàm sóng</label>
              <div className="flex gap-1 bg-slate-200/70 p-1 rounded-xl">
                {(['sin', 'cos', 'tan'] as const).map((fn) => (
                  <button
                    key={fn}
                    onClick={() => setWaveFunc(fn)}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all ${
                      waveFunc === fn ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {fn.toUpperCase()}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1.5">Biên độ (A)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.5"
                value={waveAmp}
                onChange={(e) => setWaveAmp(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 1)}
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1.5">Tần số góc (ω)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.5"
                value={waveFreq}
                onChange={(e) => setWaveFreq(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 1)}
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1.5">Độ lệch pha φ (rad)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.25"
                value={wavePhase}
                onChange={(e) => setWavePhase(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <InteractiveGraphPlotter
            expression={`${waveAmp === 1 ? '' : `${waveAmp}*`}${waveFunc}(${waveFreq === 1 ? '' : `${waveFreq}*`}x ${wavePhase > 0 ? `+ ${wavePhase}` : wavePhase < 0 ? `- ${Math.abs(wavePhase)}` : ''})`}
            title={`Đồ thị sóng y = ${waveAmp === 1 ? '' : waveAmp}${waveFunc}(${waveFreq === 1 ? 'x' : `${waveFreq}x`}${wavePhase ? ` + ${wavePhase}` : ''})`}
            initialXRange={[-Math.PI * 2, Math.PI * 2]}
            initialYRange={waveFunc === 'tan' ? [-5, 5] : [-Math.abs(waveAmp) * 1.5 - 0.5, Math.abs(waveAmp) * 1.5 + 0.5]}
            isTrig={true}
          />
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  ArrowLeftRight,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Coins,
  Ruler,
  Weight,
  Square,
  ThermometerSun
} from 'lucide-react';

type UnitCategory = 'currency' | 'length' | 'weight' | 'area' | 'temperature';

interface UnitDef {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  symbol: string;
  factorToBase: number; // For non-temp: multiplier to convert to base unit
}

// Currency reference rates (Base = USD)
const CURRENCIES: Record<string, { name: string; symbol: string; rateToUSD: number }> = {
  VND: { name: 'Đồng Việt Nam', symbol: '₫', rateToUSD: 25450 },
  USD: { name: 'Đô la Mỹ', symbol: '$', rateToUSD: 1 },
  EUR: { name: 'Euro Châu Âu', symbol: '€', rateToUSD: 0.92 },
  JPY: { name: 'Yên Nhật', symbol: '¥', rateToUSD: 154.5 },
  GBP: { name: 'Bảng Anh', symbol: '£', rateToUSD: 0.79 },
  CNY: { name: 'Nhân dân tệ', symbol: '¥', rateToUSD: 7.24 },
  KRW: { name: 'Won Hàn Quốc', symbol: '₩', rateToUSD: 1380 },
  SGD: { name: 'Đô la Singapore', symbol: 'S$', rateToUSD: 1.35 },
  AUD: { name: 'Đô la Úc', symbol: 'A$', rateToUSD: 1.52 },
  CAD: { name: 'Đô la Canada', symbol: 'C$', rateToUSD: 1.37 },
};

// Length (Base = meter)
const LENGTH_UNITS: UnitDef[] = [
  { id: 'm', name: 'Mét', symbol: 'm', factorToBase: 1 },
  { id: 'km', name: 'Kilômét', symbol: 'km', factorToBase: 1000 },
  { id: 'cm', name: 'Xentimét', symbol: 'cm', factorToBase: 0.01 },
  { id: 'mm', name: 'Milimét', symbol: 'mm', factorToBase: 0.001 },
  { id: 'inch', name: 'Inch', symbol: 'in', factorToBase: 0.0254 },
  { id: 'foot', name: 'Foot / Feet', symbol: 'ft', factorToBase: 0.3048 },
  { id: 'yard', name: 'Yard', symbol: 'yd', factorToBase: 0.9144 },
  { id: 'mile', name: 'Dặm (Mile)', symbol: 'mi', factorToBase: 1609.344 },
];

// Weight (Base = kilogram)
const WEIGHT_UNITS: UnitDef[] = [
  { id: 'kg', name: 'Kilôgam', symbol: 'kg', factorToBase: 1 },
  { id: 'g', name: 'Gam', symbol: 'g', factorToBase: 0.001 },
  { id: 'mg', name: 'Miligam', symbol: 'mg', factorToBase: 0.000001 },

// Area (Base = square meter)
const AREA_UNITS: UnitDef[] = [
  { id: 'm2', name: 'Mét vuông', symbol: 'm²', factorToBase: 1 },
  { id: 'km2', name: 'Kilômét vuông', symbol: 'km²', factorToBase: 1000000 },
  { id: 'ha', name: 'Hécta', symbol: 'ha', factorToBase: 10000 },
  { id: 'ft2', name: 'Square Foot', symbol: 'ft²', factorToBase: 0.092903 },

  { id: 'sao_trung', name: 'Sào Trung Bộ', symbol: 'sào TB', factorToBase: 500 },
  { id: 'cong_nam', name: 'Công (Sào Nam Bộ)', symbol: 'công', factorToBase: 1000 },
  { id: 'mau_vn', name: 'Mẫu (Nam Bộ)', symbol: 'mẫu', factorToBase: 10000 },
];

export const UnitConverter: React.FC = () => {
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<UnitCategory>('currency');
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState<number>(100);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Currency states
  const [fromCurrency, setFromCurrency] = useState<string>('USD');
  const [toCurrency, setToCurrency] = useState<string>('VND');

  // Other units states
  const [fromUnit, setFromUnit] = useState<string>('km');
  const [toUnit, setToUnit] = useState<string>('m');

  // Temperature states
  const [fromTemp, setFromTemp] = useState<string>('C');
  const [toTemp, setToTemp] = useState<string>('F');

  // Reset units when category changes
  const handleCategoryChange = (cat: UnitCategory) => {
    setCategory(cat);
    if (cat === 'currency') {
      setInputValue(100);
    } else if (cat === 'length') {
      setInputValue(5);
      setFromUnit('km');
      setToUnit('m');
    } else if (cat === 'weight') {
      setInputValue(10);
      setFromUnit('kg');
      setToUnit('lb');
    } else if (cat === 'area') {
      setInputValue(2);
      setFromUnit('ha');
      setToUnit('m2');
    } else if (cat === 'temperature') {
      setInputValue(37);
      setFromTemp('C');
      setToTemp('F');
    }
  };

  // Convert
  const resultValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (category === 'currency') {
      const fromRate = CURRENCIES[fromCurrency]?.rateToUSD || 1;
      const toRate = CURRENCIES[toCurrency]?.rateToUSD || 1;
      // Convert to USD, then to target
      const inUSD = inputValue / fromRate;
      return inUSD * toRate;
    }

    if (category === 'temperature') {
      let c = inputValue;
      if (fromTemp === 'F') c = (inputValue - 32) * (5 / 9);
      if (fromTemp === 'K') c = inputValue - 273.15;

      if (toTemp === 'C') return c;
      if (toTemp === 'F') return (c * 9) / 5 + 32;
      if (toTemp === 'K') return c + 273.15;
      return c;
    }

    let unitList = LENGTH_UNITS;
    if (category === 'weight') unitList = WEIGHT_UNITS;
    if (category === 'area') unitList = AREA_UNITS;

    const fromDef = unitList.find(u => u.id === fromUnit);
    const toDef = unitList.find(u => u.id === toUnit);

    if (!fromDef || !toDef || toDef.factorToBase === 0) return 0;

    const baseValue = inputValue * fromDef.factorToBase;
    return baseValue / toDef.factorToBase;
  }, [category, inputValue, fromCurrency, toCurrency, fromUnit, toUnit, fromTemp, toTemp]);

  const handleSwap = () => {
    if (category === 'currency') {
      setFromCurrency(toCurrency);
      setToCurrency(fromCurrency);
    } else if (category === 'temperature') {
      setFromTemp(toTemp);
      setToTemp(fromTemp);
    } else {
      setFromUnit(toUnit);
      setToUnit(fromUnit);
    }
  };

  const formatDisplay = (num: number) => {
    if (category === 'currency' && toCurrency === 'VND') {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(num);
    }
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', { maximumFractionDigits: 4 }).format(num);
  };

  const copyResult = () => {
    let text = '';
    if (category === 'currency') {
      text = `${inputValue} ${fromCurrency} = ${formatDisplay(resultValue)} ${toCurrency}`;
    } else if (category === 'temperature') {
      text = `${inputValue}°${fromTemp} = ${formatDisplay(resultValue)}°${toTemp}`;
    } else {
      text = `${inputValue} ${fromUnit} = ${formatDisplay(resultValue)} ${toUnit}`;
    }
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6">
      
      {/* Category Nav Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl">
        <button
          onClick={() => handleCategoryChange('currency')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all ${
            category === 'currency' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          <Coins className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Tiền tệ ngoại tệ</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => handleCategoryChange('length')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all ${
            category === 'length' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          <Ruler className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Chiều dài</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => handleCategoryChange('weight')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all ${
            category === 'weight' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          <Weight className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Khối lượng</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => handleCategoryChange('area')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all ${
            category === 'area' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          <Square className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Diện tích (Sào/Mẫu)</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => handleCategoryChange('temperature')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all ${
            category === 'temperature' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          <ThermometerSun className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Nhiệt độ</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Converter Body */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 items-center">
        
        {/* Input Side (Col 1-5) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-3">
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block">Số lượng cần chuyển đổi</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            value={inputValue}
            onChange={(e) => setInputValue(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
            className="w-full h-14 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none"
          />

          {/* From Select */}
          {category === 'currency' ? (
            <select
              value={fromCurrency}
              onChange={(e) => setFromCurrency(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full min-h-[50px] px-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-base sm:text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 bg-white focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
            >
              {Object.entries(CURRENCIES).map(([code, cur]) => (
                <option key={code} value={code}>
                  {code} – {cur.name} ({cur.symbol})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          ) : category === 'temperature' ? (
            <select
              value={fromTemp}

              className="w-full min-h-[50px] px-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-base sm:text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 bg-white focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none cursor-pointer shadow-xs"

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Box, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { VolumeVisualizer } from './geometry/VolumeVisualizer';

type SolidShape = 'cuboid' | 'cylinder' | 'sphere' | 'cone';

export const VolumeCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [solid, setSolid] = useState<SolidShape>('cuboid');
  const [d1, setD1] = useState<number>(10);
  const [d2, setD2] = useState<number>(5);
  const [d3, setD3] = useState<number>(4);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    let volume = 0;
    let surfaceArea = 0;

    if (solid === 'cuboid') {
      // l, w, h
      volume = d1 * d2 * d3;
      surfaceArea = 2 * (d1 * d2 + d2 * d3 + d1 * d3);
    } else if (solid === 'cylinder') {
      // r, h
      volume = Math.PI * d1 * d1 * d2;
      surfaceArea = 2 * Math.PI * d1 * d2 + 2 * Math.PI * d1 * d1;
    } else if (solid === 'sphere') {
      // r
      volume = (4 / 3) * Math.PI * Math.pow(d1, 3);
      surfaceArea = 4 * Math.PI * d1 * d1;
    } else if (solid === 'cone') {
      // r, h
      volume = (1 / 3) * Math.PI * d1 * d1 * d2;
      const slant = Math.sqrt(d1 * d1 + d2 * d2);
      surfaceArea = Math.PI * d1 * slant + Math.PI * d1 * d1;
    }

    return {
      volume: Number(volume.toFixed(4)),
      surfaceArea: Number(surfaceArea.toFixed(4))
    };
  }, [solid, d1, d2, d3]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Box className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Volume Calculator – Tính Thể Tích Khối Hình Không Gian</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính thể tích và diện tích toàn phần của khối hộp, hình trụ, hình cầu và hình nón</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="volume-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setSolid('cuboid'); setD1(10); setD2(5); setD3(4); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {[
          { id: 'cuboid', label: 'Hình hộp chữ nhật' },
          { id: 'cylinder', label: 'Hình trụ tròn' },
          { id: 'sphere', label: 'Hình cầu' },
          { id: 'cone', label: 'Hình nón' },
        ].map((s) => (
          <button
            key={s.id}
            id={`volume-shape-${s.id}`}
            onClick={() => setSolid(s.id as SolidShape)}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
              solid === s.id
                ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 font-bold'
                : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-700'
            }`}
          >
            {s.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Kích thước hình khối</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              {solid === 'cuboid' ? 'Chiều dài' : 'Bán kính đáy r'}
            </label>
            <input
              id="volume-d1"
              type="number"
              value={d1}
              onChange={(e) => setD1(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {solid !== 'sphere' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                {solid === 'cuboid' ? 'Chiều rộng' : 'Chiều cao h'}
              </label>
              <input
                id="volume-d2"
                type="number"
                value={d2}
                onChange={(e) => setD2(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {solid === 'cuboid' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Chiều cao h</label>
              <input
                id="volume-d3"
                type="number"
                value={d3}
                onChange={(e) => setD3(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">THỂ TÍCH KHỐI (VOLUME)</span>
            <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {calculations.volume.toLocaleString()}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Diện tích toàn phần bề mặt: <span className="text-white font-bold font-sans">{calculations.surfaceArea.toLocaleString()}</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          <VolumeVisualizer
            solid={solid}
            d1={d1}
            d2={d2}
            d3={d3}
            volume={calculations.volume}
            surfaceArea={calculations.surfaceArea}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Weight, RotateCcw, ArrowRightLeft } from 'lucide-react';

const WEIGHT_UNITS: Record<string, { name: string; factor: number }> = {
  kg: { name: 'Kilôgam (kg)', factor: 1 },
  g: { name: 'Gam (g)', factor: 0.001 },
  mg: { name: 'Miligam (mg)', factor: 0.000001 },
  t: { name: 'Tấn (Metric Ton)', factor: 1000 },
  lb: { name: 'Pound (lb)', factor: 0.45359237 },
  oz: { name: 'Ounce (oz)', factor: 0.028349523125 },
  st: { name: 'Stone (st)', factor: 6.35029 },
  ct: { name: 'Carat (ct)', factor: 0.0002 }
};

export const WeightConverter: React.FC = () => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<number>(75);
  const [fromUnit, setFromUnit] = useState<string>('kg');
  const [toUnit, setToUnit] = useState<string>('lb');

  const result = useMemo(() => {
    const fromFactor = WEIGHT_UNITS[fromUnit]?.factor || 1;
    const toFactor = WEIGHT_UNITS[toUnit]?.factor || 1;
    const inKg = value * fromFactor;
    return inKg / toFactor;
  }, [value, fromUnit, toUnit]);

  const allConversions = useMemo(() => {
    const fromFactor = WEIGHT_UNITS[fromUnit]?.factor || 1;
    const inKg = value * fromFactor;
    return Object.entries(WEIGHT_UNITS).map(([key, item]) => ({
      key,
      name: item.name,
      val: inKg / item.factor
    }));
  }, [value, fromUnit]);

  const handleSwap = () => {
    setFromUnit(toUnit);
    setToUnit(fromUnit);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Weight className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Weight Converter – Chuyển Đổi Đơn Vị Khối Lượng</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Chuyển đổi tức thì giữa kg, gram, pound (lb), ounce (oz), tấn và carat</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="weight-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setValue(75); setFromUnit('kg'); setToUnit('lb'); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-7 gap-3 items-center">
          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Giá trị ban đầu</label>
            <input
              id="weight-val-input"
              type="number"
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => setValue(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
            <select
              id="weight-from-select"
              value={fromUnit}
              onChange={(e) => setFromUnit(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            >
              {Object.entries(WEIGHT_UNITS).map(([k, u]) => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>{u.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-1 flex justify-center">
            <button
              id="weight-swap-btn"
              onClick={handleSwap}
              className="p-3 rounded-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 text-blue-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Đảo chiều"
            >
              <ArrowRightLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Đơn vị đích</label>
            <div className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-blue-400 font-bold font-sans tabular-nums truncate">
              {result.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 6 })}
            </div>
            <select
              id="weight-to-select"
              value={toUnit}
              onChange={(e) => setToUnit(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            >
              {Object.entries(WEIGHT_UNITS).map(([k, u]) => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>{u.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* All units grid */}
        <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-800">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-3">
            Quy đổi đồng thời sang các đơn vị khác
          </h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            {allConversions.map((conv) => (
              <div key={conv.key} className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800/40 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-slate-400">{conv.name}</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-white font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {conv.val.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 4 })}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef, useMemo, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  ZoomIn,
  ZoomOut,
  RotateCcw,
  Eye,
